title: Project Manager - Source to Pay (S2P)
description:
**Mid-Level Project Manager – AmpliFi ERP Upgrade Program**
**Project Manager – Source to Pay (S2P)**
**Program:**
AmpliFi ERP Transformation Program Location: India (Onsite/Hybrid, per program requirements) Engagement Type: Contract (Contingent Worker) Experience Level: Mid-Level (10+ years)
**Certificate:**
PMP®-certified
  
  
**Position Overview**
TIAA is undertaking AmpliFi, a large-scale ERP transformation program, and is seeking an experienced, hands-on Project Manager to assist in managing the Source to Pay (S2P) workstream. This workstream includes the migration of Strategic Sourcing to Oracle, the replacement of the Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) system from Coupa to Aravo, and the implementation of a new Zip orchestration layer designed to unify and simplify the end-to-end sourcing, procurement, and payment experience for business users.
  
  
This is a highly visible role requiring a proactive self-starter who can manage complex, interdependent workstreams while communicating clearly and confidently with senior TIAA stakeholders, including steering committee members and executive sponsors. The ideal candidate combines strong technical understanding of source-to-pay processes with the polish and presence needed to lead discussions with senior audiences.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the project plan, milestones, RAID log, and deliverables for the S2P workstream, spanning Strategic Sourcing (PeopleSoft), TPRM (Aravo), and the Zip orchestration layer.
* Partner with Strategic Sourcing, Accounts Payable, Purchasing, and TPRM teams to define future-state processes, requirements, and system configurations.
* Coordinate configuration, testing, and validation activities across PeopleSoft Sourcing, Aravo TPRM, and Zip orchestration, ensuring seamless integration and a cohesive end-to-end user experience.
* Manage vendor master data cleanup, mapping, and migration activities in close coordination with the Data workstream.
* Proactively identify gaps, dependencies, and risks across the three underlying platforms before they impact timelines, and drive resolution through appropriate program channels.
* Schedule and facilitate S2P status meetings, domain working sessions, workshops, and steering committee updates.
* Prepare clear, executive-ready status reports and presentation materials, and confidently present progress, risks, and decisions to senior TIAA leadership and steering committee members.
* Track, escalate, and drive resolution of risks and issues per program governance standards.
* Coordinate UAT planning and execution with business process owners across sourcing, AP, and TPRM functions.
* Support organizational change management, stakeholder communications, and training for S2P end users, ensuring adoption of new processes and the Zip orchestration experience.
* Demonstrate meticulous attention to detail in tracking deliverables, documenting decisions, and validating configuration and testing outcomes.

**Program-Level Responsibilities**

* Adhere to AmpliFi program governance, PMO standards, and reporting templates/cadence.
* Participate in cross-workstream coordination meetings to proactively identify and manage interdependencies with other AmpliFi workstreams.
* Escalate risks and issues through defined program governance channels in a timely manner.
* Support overall cutover planning, go-live readiness, and post-go-live stabilization for the S2P domain.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or a related field.
* 6–10 years of project management experience, including at least 3 years leading procurement, sourcing, accounts payable, or TPRM transformation initiatives.
* Direct, hands-on familiarity with at least two of the following: PeopleSoft (Sourcing/Procurement), Coupa, Aravo, Zip, or comparable sourcing, TPRM, or orchestration platforms.
* Strong working knowledge of end-to-end source-to-pay processes, including strategic sourcing, purchase order creation, three-way matching, invoice-to-pay, and third-party/vendor risk management, ideally within a large international financial services organization.
* Demonstrated experience managing multi-system, multi-stakeholder workstreams with significant interdependencies.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification preferred.
* Proven ability to communicate effectively and with authority to senior/executive audiences, including experience preparing and delivering steering committee-level presentations.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust and drive alignment across Sourcing, AP, TPRM, Vendor Management, IT, and Data teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to translate complex technical topics into clear business language.
* High attention to detail, particularly in tracking configuration decisions, testing outcomes, and data migration accuracy across multiple platforms.
* Proficiency in project management and collaboration tools (e.g., Jira, Smartsheet, MS Teams, SharePoint).
* Ability to work proactively and independently across time zones with global stakeholders (onshore/offshore coordination).
* Strong facilitation, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience with ERP transformation programs, particularly upgrades or replacements involving sourcing, procurement, or TPRM systems.
* Experience with orchestration or workflow layers designed to unify disparate procurement systems into a single user experience.
* Experience working within regulated financial services environments, with an understanding of associated compliance and audit requirements.

title: Professional Services Program Manager
description:
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**Who We Are**
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Professional Services Program Manager will lead services programs and projects as part of the delivery cycle, including handling all deployment resources and ensuring that all deliverables are met and delivered on-time and under budget. The Program Manager will drive customer deployment programs and projects including program, process initiatives, as well as partner with IT on systems and infrastructure processes.
  
  
**Your Impact**

* Determine project partners and team structure/organization partners will include technical and business resources
* In conjunction with project partners, help ensure the definition of project scope, requirements, and deliverables
* Develop project timeline and landmarks using appropriate tools and techniques
* Build and execute project work plans and revise as appropriate to meet changing needs and requirements
* Identify resources needed and assign individual responsibilities and tasks
* Run day-to-day operational aspects of a project and scope
* Work on services operational projects that target new services IP delivery, partner communications, scheduling, etc.
* Review deliverables prepared by team before passing to client
* Effectively apply Palo Alto Networks Project Management methodology and implement project standards
* Minimize our exposure and risk on all projects
* Ensure project documents are complete, current, and stored appropriately
* Track and report team hours and expenses on a weekly basis

**Qualifications**
**Your Experience**

* BS in Computer Science, MIS, Business, or equivalent education/training/experience or equivalent military experience required
* 5+ years of related work experience or leading complex projects desired
* Analyze project profitability, revenue, margins, bill rates, and utilization
* Good presentation skills including written, oral, presentation
* Good organizational skills including tool utilization (spreadsheets, project management tools etc), information collection, attention to detail, and prioritization
* Strong interpersonal skills including appreciation and the ability to elicit collaboration from a wide variety of sources, including upper management, clients, and other departments
* Flexible to shifting priorities, demands, and timelines - able to promptly and expertly react to project adjustments and alterations
* Experience managing large scale (Global) deployments with multiple projects, teams and resources
* Experience with Google’s G Suite (Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Slides) is a plus

**Our Commitment**
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
  
  
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
  
  
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
  
  
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

description:
Whether you’re at the start of your career or looking to discover your next adventure, your story begins here. At
**Citi**

We’re fully committed to supporting your growth and development from the start with extensive on-the-job training and exposure to senior leaders, as well as more traditional learning. You’ll also have the chance to give back and make a positive impact where we live and work through volunteerism.
  
  
**Shape your Career with Citi**
**Citibank**
serves as a trusted advisor to our retail, mortgage, small business and wealth management clients at every stage of their financial journey. Through Citi's Access Account, Basic Banking, Citi Priority, Citigold and Citigold Private Client, we offer an array of products, services and digital capabilities to clients across the full spectrum of consumer banking needs worldwide.
  
  
We’re currently looking for a high caliber professional to join our team as
**Program Advisory, Consulting & Execution, Vice President**
based in
**Mumbai, India**
. Being part of our team means that we’ll provide you with the resources to meet your unique needs, empower you to make healthy decision and manage your financial well-being to help plan for your future. For instance:
  
  

* Citi provides programs and services for your physical and mental well-being including access to telehealth options, health advocates, confidential counseling and more. Coverage varies by country.
* We believe all parents deserve time to adjust to parenthood and bond with the newest members of their families. That’s why in early 2020 we began rolling out our expanded Paid Parental Leave Policy to include Citi employees around the world.
* We empower our employees to manage their financial well-being and help them plan for the future.
* Citi provides access to an array of learning and development resources to help broaden and deepen your skills and knowledge as your career progresses.
* We have a variety of programs that help employees balance their work and life, including generous paid time off packages.
* We offer our employees resources and tools to volunteer in the communities in which they live and work. In 2019, Citi employee volunteers contributed more than 1 million volunteer hours around the world.

The Program Advisory, Consulting & Execution (PACE) organization is Citi’s internal consulting and program execution team. Operating from Finance with a firmwide mandate, PACE serves as a strategic internal partner delivering management consulting, program advisory, and end-to-end execution support for Citi’s high-value initiatives and business transformation priorities. The organization partners closely with functional and business leadership to deliver significant, measurable business outcomes while retaining critical knowledge and reducing reliance on external consulting firms.
  
  
The PACE team is a global, interdisciplinary team comprised of seasoned professionals with deep financial services, program advisory, and management consulting expertise. With team members located in eight cities across five countries—Canada, Costa Rica, India, the United Kingdom, and the United States—PACE provides continuous global support, accelerated delivery, and rapid mobilization to solve the firm's most critical challenges.
  
  
**Summary:**

* Lead the end-to-end execution of high-impact workstreams in cross-functional programs, driving process transformation, and operational improvements across the firm.
* Act as a subject matter expert in program and project management, leveraging structured PM practices to guide execution and proactively identify opportunities for improvement.
* Build and manage strong partnerships with senior project stakeholders and clients, serving as a key liaison to ensure alignment and facilitate collaboration.
* Drive accountability for project performance, holding both yourself and the team responsible for the quality of deliverables and adherence to established procedures.
* Operate effectively within a matrix management structure, reporting to senior leadership while collaborating closely with day-to-day engagement managers.
* Serve as an example of program management excellence, leveraging your experience to influence outcomes.

**In this role, you are expected to:**

* Drive analysis of complex data and business processes, developing initial hypotheses and turning ambiguous inputs into actionable, data-driven solutions.
* Support target operating model and process transformation initiatives by partnering with stakeholders to define business requirements and target states
* Work closely with Technology teams throughout delivery, helping teams apply business requirements in solution design, implementation, and testing.
* Define program requirements, objectives, and plans, establishing the structure and controls necessary to ensure successful delivery and mitigate ambiguity.
* Lead direct cross-functional teams within a complex global matrix environment, mobilizing diverse stakeholders toward a common goal. May assist on the program with training and coaching of junior staff with development needs.
* Collaborate and consult with executive leadership, stakeholders, project leads, executive leadership, sponsors, and business partners to clarify and define project requirements.
* Provide objective review and challenge for program deliverables, plans and other requirements.
* Prepare and deliver clear, impactful communications for project sponsors and senior stakeholders regarding analyses, project outcomes, and strategic recommendations.
* Act as a change catalyst by identifying opportunities for improvement and helping stakeholders understand how new ideas and solutions can benefit program objectives.
* Build and manage relationships with all key stakeholders, collaborating closely to define scope, manage expectations, and ensure alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
* Continuously develop re-usable intellectual capital, contributing relevant content and research to the team’s knowledge base to be leveraged across the organization.

**As a successful candidate, you’d ideally have the following skills and exposure:**

* A minimum of 7 years of experience in management consulting and financial services, with a proven track record of managing complex, end-to-end projects and programs using a structured methodology.
* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience is required; PMP or PRINCE2 certification is also preferred.
* Advanced proficiency in the MS Office Suite, including Excel for data analysis and PowerPoint for creating compelling, data-driven presentations.
* Experience working with complex financial services organizations delivering operating model and process transformation initiatives, authoring business requirements across Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid methodologies, and defining future-state operating models.
* Experience working with Technology teams across the delivery lifecycle, including requirements development, solution implementation, and testing support.
* Expertise in a range of analytical and project management competencies, including hypothesis generation, root cause identification, process mapping & improvement, operating model design, and business case development, applied within an Agile or similarly structured delivery framework.
* Strong familiarity with digitalization concepts, emerging technology trends including AI, and their practical application to transform business processes within a financial services context.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and influence a team-based, collaborative model, effectively guiding diverse stakeholders and project teams toward common goals in a complex, matrixed environment.
* A self-starter with a strong ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, and solve complex problems by structuring analyses and turning incomplete or conflicting inputs into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively distill complex information and impactfully present analyses, plans, and recommendations to all levels of the organization.
* An innovative and curious mindset with a passion for improving the employee and customer experience.

The Program Advisory, Consulting & Execution (PACE) organization is Citi’s internal consulting and program execution team. Operating from Finance with a firmwide mandate, PACE serves as a strategic internal partner delivering management consulting, program advisory, and end-to-end execution support for Citi’s high-value initiatives and business transformation priorities. The organization partners closely with functional and business leadership to deliver significant, measurable business outcomes while retaining critical knowledge and reducing reliance on external consulting firms.
  
  
The PACE team is a global, interdisciplinary team comprised of seasoned professionals with deep financial services, program advisory, and management consulting expertise. With team members located in eight cities across five countries—Canada, Costa Rica, India, the United Kingdom, and the United States—PACE provides continuous global support, accelerated delivery, and rapid mobilization to solve the firm's most critical challenges.
  
  
**Summary:**

* Leads the end-to-end delivery of large-scale, complex initiatives, from strategic definition and planning through to hands-on tactical execution and successful implementation.

* Proactively identify and manage program risks by simplifying processes, eliminating redundancies, and anticipating necessary changes to business systems and tools.

**As a successful candidate, you’d ideally have the following skills and exposure:**

* A minimum of 14 years of experience managing complex, end-to-end programs and process transformation projects, with required experience in management consulting and within the financial services industry.
* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience is required.

* Demonstrated experience working with Technology teams to oversee delivery activities, support requirements implementation, helping achieve business objectives across delivery methodologies including Agile, Waterfall
* Proven expertise in a range of methodologies including Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, and structured PM frameworks; PMP or PRINCE2 certification is preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor program managers on high-risk, cross-functional initiatives, driving accountability and ensuring alignment with broader firm-wide strategy.

* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a demonstrated ability to articulate complex recommendations and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
* Functional knowledge in one or more financial services domains such as Consumer/Institutional Banking, Risk Management, Compliance, Finance, or Operations.
* Comfortable with ambiguity, brings a high sense of urgency to goals, and balances analytical and creative abilities to drive change.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
Fynd is a frontier technology company. We started at the intersection of technology and retail because that is where technology was the least available. Over the years, we became one of India’s largest retail technology platforms. But retail was the entry point, not the boundary.
  
  
Today, Fynd builds intelligent software that runs business operations. Not tools that help people work faster, but systems that absorb entire functions: manufacturing, marketing, logistics, commerce, quality control. We sit inside our customers’ businesses, harvest deep domain context, and build AI systems that operate autonomously. We are expanding from retail into manufacturing, generative media, physical AI, and healthcare.
  
  
We are looking for an AI-forward
**Customer Success & Implementation Lead**
to manage the complete post-sales journey for our enterprise customers—from contract handover and implementation to adoption, retention, and growth.
  
  
In this role, you will lead the Implementation and Onboarding team, drive successful enterprise deployments, and build scalable customer success processes. You will also use AI-powered development tools to prototype client requirements, automate workflows, analyse technical issues, and accelerate integrations without being completely dependent on the core engineering team.
  
  
**What will you do at Fynd?**
**Lead Implementation and Delivery**

* Lead and mentor a team of Implementation Managers and Onboarding Specialists.
* Own key implementation metrics, including time-to-go-live, catalog migration, deployment success, and user adoption.
* Manage the complete handover process from Sales to Implementation and Customer Success.
* Oversee the integration of store locations, ERPs, marketplaces, inventory systems, and supply chain workflows.
* Identify implementation risks, resolve delivery bottlenecks, and ensure projects are completed within committed timelines.
* Build scalable playbooks for onboarding, system configuration, customer training, escalation management, and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).

**Drive AI-Assisted Technical Solutions**

* Use AI development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Bolt, Lovable, or similar platforms to build functional prototypes, front-end mock-ups, and custom widgets.
* Demonstrate client-specific use cases and Fynd API capabilities through working prototypes.
* Build scripts or lightweight applications to clean and transform retail catalog data, automate customer health scores, and improve onboarding workflows.
* Analyse API logs, JSON payloads, client-side code, and integration issues to identify potential root causes.
* Translate business and technical challenges into clear, actionable specifications for Product and Engineering teams.
* Use AI tools to reduce dependency on engineering teams for routine technical tasks and accelerate customer resolution timelines.

**Own Customer Retention and Growth**

* Build trusted relationships with CXOs, founders, e-commerce leaders, and senior stakeholders across enterprise accounts.
* Act as a strategic advisor and help customers achieve measurable business outcomes through Fynd’s solutions.
* Partner with Account Management and Sales teams to identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities across Fynd’s product portfolio.
* Own key commercial and customer success metrics, including renewals, Net Revenue Retention (NRR), adoption, and customer health.
* Conduct regular business reviews and proactively address risks that could affect customer satisfaction or retention.
* Consolidate customer feedback and share actionable insights with Product and Engineering teams to influence the product roadmap.

**What We're Looking For**

* 6–10+ years of experience in B2B SaaS Customer Success, Enterprise Implementation, Technical Account Management, or a related role.
* At least 2 years of experience leading an implementation, onboarding, customer success, or engineering-adjacent team.
* Strong experience in Retail Technology, E-commerce, Omnichannel Commerce, Order Management Systems, logistics, or supply chain platforms.
* Understanding of how storefronts, warehouses, ERPs, marketplaces, inventory systems, and physical stores work together.
* Hands-on experience using AI development tools to create functional code, prototypes, scripts, automations, or internal applications.
* Working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, JSON payloads, databases, and basic data transformation.
* Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with experience managing complex enterprise implementations.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both business and technical stakeholders.
* Experience managing senior stakeholders, including CXOs, founders, and e-commerce leaders.
* A metrics-driven approach with a proven record of improving onboarding timelines, customer adoption, retention, or NRR.
* Strong ownership, problem-solving, leadership, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**What do we offer?**
**Growth**
At Fynd, growth is limitless. We nurture a culture that encourages innovation, embraces challenges, and supports continuous learning. As we expand into new product lines and global markets, we’re seeking talented individuals eager to grow with us.
  
  
We believe in empowering our people to take ownership, lead with confidence, and shape their careers.
  
  

* Learning Wallet: Enrol in external courses or certifications to upskill—we’ll reimburse the costs to support your development.

**Culture**
We believe in building strong teams and lasting connections.
  
  

* Regular community engagement and team-building activities
* Biannual events to celebrate achievements, foster collaboration, and strengthen our workplace culture

**Wellness**
Your well-being is our priority. Comprehensive Mediclaim policy for you, your spouse, children, and parents
  
  
**Work Environment**
We thrive on collaboration and creativity. Our teams work from the office five days a week to encourage open communication, teamwork, and innovation.
  
  
Join us to be part of a dynamic environment where your ideas make an impact!

title: Consultant/AM - Internal Audit
description:
**Job Title : Assistant Manager**

**Function : Governance, Risk and Compliance Services (GRCS)**

**Location : Mumbai**

**OVERVIEW**

KPMG is a global network of professional firms providing Audit, Tax and Advisory services. We operate in 156 countries and have 152,000 people working in member firms around the world.

KPMG in India, a professional services firm, is the Indian member firm of KPMG International and was established in September 1993. Our professionals leverage the global network of firms, providing detailed knowledge of local laws, regulations, markets and competition. KPMG in India provide services to over 4,500 international and national clients, in India. KPMG has offices across India in Delhi, Chandigarh, Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Pune, Chennai, Bangalore, Kochi, Hyderabad and Kolkata. The Indian firm has access to more than 7,000 Indian and expatriate professionals, many of whom are internationally trained. We strive to provide rapid, performance-based, industry-focused and technology-enabled services, which reflect a shared knowledge of global and local industries and our experience of the Indian business environment.

KPMG Advisory professionals provide advice and assistance to enable companies, intermediaries and public sector bodies to mitigate risk, improve performance, and create value. KPMG firms provide a wide range of Risk Consulting, Management Consulting and Transactions & Restructuring services that can help clients respond to immediate needs as well as put in place the strategies for the longer term.

With increasing regulatory requirements, the need for greater transparency in operations, and disclosure norms, stakeholders require assurance beyond the traditional critique of numbers. Hence assurance is being increasingly required on industry issues, business risks and key business processes. The Governance, Risk & Compliance Services practice assists companies and public sector bodies to mitigate risk, improve performance and create value.

We assist our clients to effectively manage business and process risks by providing a full spectrum of corporate governance, risk management, and Compliance Services. These services are tailored to meet client’s individual needs, and provide effective support to management in meeting the challenges and opportunities presented by today's complex business environment.

Our professionals provide the experience to help companies stay on track and deal with risks that could unhinge their business survival. Our services enable clients to effectively co-ordinate their key growth, quality and operational challenges and working in partnership with us, clients have the benefits of KPMG's experienced, objective, and industry-grounded viewpoints.

**Following are some of our key service offerings:**

* Risk Based Internal Audit
* Enterprise Risk Management
* Risk Assessment
* Model Business Process Development
* Sarbanes – Oxley 404 Assistance
* Compliance Assistance – Contracts and regulations
* Corporate Governance Advisory– Review and Assessment
* Revenue Assurance
* Control Self Assessment
* Continuous Auditing / Continuous Monitoring
* Apart from the above service offerings, we also assist client organizations around various aspects viz. Accounting Manuals, Capital Projects Audits, Project focused Control Assessment, setting up IA function, etc.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Assistant Managers are project leaders/project team members who will be involved in conducting process consulting/ internal audit/ risk consulting and execution of other solutions of GRCS
* Assistant Managers may pay the role of team leader on engagements with 1-3 team members reporting to them for the project. AMs have responsibility of reviewing the work done (Deliverables) by the team members
* Interact with the client representatives for the ongoing requirements of the project
* Proactively does sales oriented reporting during projects. These would include identifying possible business opportunities for various practices within KPMG
* Consistently deliver quality client services and take charge of the project area assigned to him/her
* Monitor progress, manage risk and verify key stakeholders are kept informed about progress and expected outcomes
* Demonstrate in-depth technical capabilities and professional knowledge. Demonstrate ability to assimilate to new knowledge
* Possess good business acumen. Remain current on new developments in advisory services capabilities and industry knowledge
* The job would require travel to client locations within India and abroad

**THE INDIVIDUAL**

* Have experience in process consulting/ internal audit/ risk consulting
* Possess strong domain knowledge, understanding of business processes and possible risks in operations of at least one industry sector
* Ability to perform and interpret process gap analysis
* Ability to identify risks in business processes
* Understanding of control rationalization, optimization, effectiveness and efficiency
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills. Possess strong data analytics skills and knowledge of advanced data analytical tools will be an advantage
* Strong written and verbal communication skills (presentation skills)
* Consistent display of leadership skills
* Ability to work well in teams
* Understanding of IT systems, Knowledge of MS office ( MS Excel, PowerPoint, Word etc)
* Have the ability to work under pressure – stringent deadlines and tough client conditions which may demand extended working hours
* Willingness to travel within India or abroad for continuous long periods of time
* Demonstrate integrity, values, principles, and work ethic and lead by example

**Qualification**

* Qualified CAs with articleship from Big-4 firms, MBAs from top 10 Business Schools with 3-5 years of experience in risk consulting/ operations or compliance function role in the industry (Understanding of internal audit, business processes, sector understanding).
* Qualified CAs (non Big4 firms) / MBAs (non top 10 B-Schools) with 3 – 6 years OR Graduates (BE/B.Tech, BCom, BBM) with 6 - 8 years of relevant experience as above
* Graduates with CS/ ICWA with 5 – 7 years of relevant experience as above
* Certifications like Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) would be an added advantage.

**SELECTION PROCESS**

* Candidates should expect 2 - 3 rounds of personal or telephonic interviews to assess fitment and communication skills

**Compensation**

* Compensation is competitive with industry standards
* Details of the compensation breakup will be shared with short-listed candidates only

**People BENEFITS**

* Continuous learning program

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection.  Responsible Growth is how we run our company and how we deliver for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  
  
One of the keys to driving Responsible Growth is being a great place to work for our teammates around the world. We’re devoted to being a diverse and inclusive workplace for everyone. We hire individuals with a broad range of backgrounds and experiences and invest heavily in our teammates and their families by offering competitive benefits to support their physical, emotional, and financial well-being.
  
  
Bank of America believes both in the importance of working together and offering flexibility to our employees. We use a multi-faceted approach for flexibility, depending on the various roles in our organization.
  
  
Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting & Reconciliations, Management Reporting & Analysis, Research & Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support & Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
  
  
The FCPS (Finance Change and Production Services) team, which is part of the (GFC) Global Financial Control organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications.  The Finance Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities. The Production Services function ensures all financial accounting & regulatory reporting systems and applications are operating smoothly from a functional perspective.
  
  
**Job Description\***
This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1) understanding the Change, (2) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams & Users until implementation of the Change.  It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements.  The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
  
  
**Responsibilities\***

* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements.  This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc.  Collaborate with the Users & procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in-house GRIFFIN & AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology & Testing Teams where relevant.

We are looking for an entrepreneurial, highly execution-oriented individual to work directly with the Founder on building new consumer brands from the ground up.

This is not a conventional Brand Manager or Business Development role.

You will identify promising consumer opportunities, evaluate categories, develop brand and product concepts, work with manufacturers and suppliers, define unit economics, coordinate branding and packaging, plan go-to-market strategy, launch new brands, and track their early performance.

* Develop initial marketing hypotheses and customer acquisition strategies.

Launch, Testing & Validation

* Launch new concepts with controlled budgets and inventory.
* Track early indicators such as:
* CAC
* Conversion rate
* AOV
* Gross margin
* Contribution margin
* Repeat purchase
* Customer feedback
* Product-market fit signals
* Identify what needs to be improved across product, pricing, proposition, creative or customer experience.
* Recommend whether a concept should be scaled, modified or discontinued.

Portfolio Management

* Manage multiple brand and product initiatives simultaneously.

* Strong understanding of consumer behaviour, pricing, positioning and unit economics.
* Experience working with manufacturers, suppliers or product development teams is highly desirable.

* Strong project management skills with the ability to coordinate multiple internal and external stakeholders.
* Ability to conduct detailed research while also moving quickly into execution.
* Strong Excel / Google Sheets and presentation skills.
* High ownership mentality and ability to work independently.

The Kind of Person Who Will Do Well Here

You will enjoy this role if you:

* Constantly notice interesting consumer products, brands and business models.
* Naturally ask, “Could we build this better?”
* Enjoy researching categories but are equally comfortable calling suppliers and getting things done.
* Think commercially rather than only creatively.

description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.
  
  
For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.
  
  
Role - Project Engineer - IBMS, Mumbai (1-Year Contract Role)
  
  
Johnson Controls delivers innovative building technologies that support smarter, healthier, and more sustainable environments. In this role, you will support project execution and project management activities for IBMS delivery in Mumbai, with hands-on involvement in
**IBMS, CCTV, and ACS**
.
  
  
This is a one-year contractual opportunity, renewable annually based on performance. It is well suited to candidates with a strong background in project execution or project management and practical experience in IBMS site delivery.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
As a Project Engineer, you will help drive the execution of IBMS projects from planning through site delivery, coordination, testing, and handover. You will work closely with internal teams, contractors, vendors, and stakeholders to help ensure work is delivered safely, on time, and to the expected technical and quality standards.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Support end-to-end execution of IBMS projects, including CCTV and ACS systems.
* Coordinate with project managers, site teams, contractors, vendors, and clients to support smooth project delivery.
* Monitor site progress against project plans, timelines, and execution requirements.
* Review technical drawings, specifications, and work instructions to support installation readiness and site execution.
* Track material availability, site requirements, and execution dependencies to help avoid delays.
* Support installation, testing, commissioning, and handover activities for IBMS systems.
* Raise and follow up on site issues, technical concerns, and coordination gaps in a timely manner.
* Prepare and maintain project documentation, progress updates, and handover records.
* Support quality checks and help ensure work is completed in line with project and safety expectations.

How You Will Do It
  
  

* Stay close to the site execution work and understand what is needed to keep IBMS delivery moving forward.
* Own tasks and follow-ups with accountability, integrity, and a clear focus on delivering the right outcome.
* Use practical problem-solving and candid communication to remove obstacles and improve execution every day.
* Work as one team with project management, engineering, vendors, and site stakeholders, building trust through collaboration and shared standards.
* Keep documentation, progress tracking, and coordination updates accurate so that work remains visible and controllable.

**Qualifications**

* Diploma or bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field.
* Background in project execution or project management within IBMS projects.
* Hands-on experience in IBMS, CCTV, and ACS.
* Experience supporting site-based project delivery, installation, testing, commissioning, or handover activities.
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications, and site documentation.
* Strong coordination, communication, and follow-up skills.
* Good problem-solving mindset with attention to quality and execution detail.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Exposure to large-scale commercial, infrastructure, or facility-related projects.
* Experience coordinating with multiple contractors and vendors on active project sites.
* Additional exposure to integrated building systems or ELV project environments.

Why Join Us
  
  
This role gives you the opportunity to build strong IBMS project delivery experience with a global leader in smart and sustainable building solutions. You will gain hands-on exposure to project execution, strengthen your domain knowledge in IBMS, CCTV, and ACS, and contribute to meaningful work in a performance-based contractual role.
  
  
If you are ready to bring your project execution or project management experience to a hands-on IBMS role in Mumbai, we encourage you to apply.

title: Installation Manager - NI Elevator
description:
**Company Description**
ICARE Lift System is a specialized provider of customized lift and elevator solutions, focused on projects where space constraints and design challenges require tailored systems. With over 50 years of combined leadership experience, the company delivers end-to-end services including design, supply, installation, modernization, and after-sales support across residential, commercial, hospitality, healthcare, and construction sectors. ICARE works closely with homeowners, builders, architects, and consultants to design lifts that fit seamlessly into diverse layouts and site conditions. Its product portfolio spans compact home lifts, customized passenger lifts, car and goods lifts, glass capsule lifts, temporary construction lifts, fire evacuation lifts, machine room-less and pit-less lifts, mobility solutions, and imported hydraulic/vacuum lifts, backed by repair and maintenance services. ICARE has installed more than 5,000 lifts in collaboration with over 500 architects, builders, and partners across Mumbai, Pune, Bengaluru, and Hyderabad, with a strong focus on safety, reliability, durability, and real-world performance.
  
**Role Description**
The Installation Manager – NI Elevator is a full-time, on-site role based in Mumbai, responsible for overseeing new installation projects from planning through final handover. This role includes coordinating site assessments, reviewing technical drawings and specifications, and planning installation schedules and resources. The Installation Manager supervises installation teams, ensures adherence to safety standards and quality checks, and liaises with clients, architects, contractors, and internal engineering teams to resolve site-related issues. Day-to-day tasks involve monitoring project progress, managing timelines and budgets, documenting installation activities, and ensuring compliance with regulatory and company standards. The role also includes supporting snag resolution, conducting final inspections, and contributing to continuous improvement of installation processes and practices.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Experience in elevator or lift installation management, including site supervision, project coordination, and vendor/contractor management.
* Strong technical understanding of elevator systems, installation methods, safety norms, and relevant standards or regulations.
* Proficiency in reading and interpreting engineering drawings, layout plans, and technical documentation.
* Skills in project planning, scheduling, resource allocation, and monitoring timelines and budgets.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills to work with clients, architects, builders, and internal teams.
* Capability to perform site assessments, identify constraints, and propose practical installation solutions.
* Attention to detail and commitment to quality, with experience implementing checklists, inspections, and documentation.
* Ability to lead and mentor installation teams, promote a safety-first culture, and manage on-site training when needed.
* Comfort working in a dynamic, field-based environment with multiple ongoing projects in urban construction settings.

title: MSET & COO Support, Vice President, Institutional Equity Division
description:
Morgan Stanley Electronic Trading (“MSET”) is a global leader in equity and derivatives electronic trading. The Vice President, MSET & COO Support, is responsible for leading business management, operational risk, regulatory response, commission management support, client onboarding coordination, and process governance across the MSET COO organization. The role partners with senior stakeholders, coverage teams, technology, risk managers, and regional teams to strengthen controls, execute business priorities, and deliver scalable operating solutions.
  
  
The position also includes leading a team supporting Request for Information (RFI), Commission Management Group (CMG), Client Onboarding for Cash and Listed Derivatives, management reporting, automation, and data maintenance activities.
  
  
From global institutions to hedge funds, investors come to Morgan Stanley for sales, trading, and market-making services in almost every type of financial instrument in all the world’s financial markets. Morgan Stanley professionals use our network and technology to provide liquidity and sophisticated analysis, to manage risk and execute reliably in the fast-changing markets.
  
  
Morgan Stanley’s Institutional Equity Division (IED) is a world leader in the origination, distribution and trading of equity, equity-linked and equity-derivative securities. Our broad and deep client relationships, market-leading platform and intellectual insights enable us to be a world-class service provider to our clients for their financing, market access and portfolio management needs.
  
  
MSET is the offshoring arm of Morgan Stanley’s Sales & Trading businesses in India. It covers functions across IED and Fixed Income Division (FID) ranging from those associated with sales, trading, analytics, strats to risk management.
  
  
**What You’ll Do In The Role**

* Support the MSET COO function through business management, governance, executive reporting, stakeholder engagement, and cross-regional coordination.
* Lead and manage end-to-end Request for Information (RFI) processes, ensuring timely, accurate, and audit-ready responses while driving process improvements and automation.
* Oversee Commission Management Group (CMG) activities, including commission-related requests, data validation, reporting, issue resolution, and control governance.
* Coordinate Client Onboarding for Cash and Listed Derivatives, ensuring efficient onboarding, documentation management, account setup, and stakeholder alignment.
* Lead operational and strategic projects, deliver reporting, analytics, process enhancements, and automation initiatives to improve efficiency and reduce operational risk.
* Manage, develop, and mentor a high-performing team while building strong partnerships across COO teams.

**What You’ll Bring To The Role**

* Bachelor’s degree from any stream with 8 - 12 years of relevant experience. A master’s degree specialized in Finance will be advantageous
* Exposure to / knowledge of different equity and equity derivatives asset classes is desirable
* Relevant experience in financial services operations, COO support, business management, risk management, or client onboarding.
* Experience leading teams, managing BAU deliverables, and supporting transformation or automation projects.
* Advanced Excel and Microsoft Office skills, with experience in Python, Power BI and SAP BusinessObjects reporting preferred.

title: Associate Director, Sports & Entertainment, India
description:
****About WPP Media****
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.
  
  
WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.
  
  
For more information, visit wppmedia.com.
  
  
****About WPP Media****
WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.
  
  
WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com
  
  
At WPP Media, We Believe In The Power Of Our Culture And Our People. It’s What Elevates Us To Deliver Exceptional Experiences For Both Our Clients And Each Other. In This Role It Will Be Critical To Embrace WPP & WPP Media’s Shared Core Values:
  
  

* Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
* Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
* Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.

WPP Media, is looking for a
**Director – Film & OTT Associations**
to join its Content team, working on one of India’s largest and most diverse FMCG portfolios. The role sits at the intersection of
**brands, entertainment and popular culture**
, identifying and building meaningful partnerships across Bollywood, regional cinema, OTT platforms and streaming content. We are looking for someone who combines
**strong entertainment instincts with strategic, creative and operational rigour**
. The individual should understand how brands can participate naturally within the world of films and streaming content, while ensuring that every association delivers against clearly defined brand and business objectives. This is a high-intensity role involving complex partnerships that can run across three to six months, from opportunity identification and creative development to production, amplification and post-campaign evaluation.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****

* Opportunity Identification & Curation
* Identify relevant upcoming films, OTT shows, talent and entertainment properties based on brand requirements and cultural opportunities.
* Proactively curate opportunities across Bollywood, Hollywood, regional cinema and streaming platforms.
* Evaluate opportunities through a combination of audience fit, cultural relevance, content context, reach and brand objectives.
* Strategy & Creative Development
* Translate brand briefs and business problems into compelling Film and OTT partnership ideas.
* Work closely with production houses, studios, platforms, creators and internal teams to develop data-backed and creatively strong brand integrations.
* Ensure integrations feel authentic to the narrative rather than forced brand placements.
* Partnership & Campaign Management
* Lead projects end to end across negotiations, creative development, production, approvals, asset delivery and amplification.
* Manage multiple stakeholders and complex timelines while ensuring campaigns are delivered to the highest quality standards.
* Build strong relationships across production houses, studios, OTT platforms, talent ecosystems and other entertainment partners.
* Execution Excellence
* Protect the creative integrity of every association while ensuring clear and meaningful brand visibility.
* Work closely with partners during production and post-production to deliver all committed integration and amplification assets.
* Anticipate challenges and solve for changes that may arise during the course of production or campaign rollout.
* Campaign Monitoring & Optimization
* Track campaign performance and recommend interventions or amplification opportunities where relevant.
* Work closely with content, planning and buying teams to maximise the impact of the partnership beyond the core integration.
* Measurement & Learning
* Build comprehensive campaign reports linked back to the objectives defined at the outset.
* Conduct post-campaign evaluations covering brand, media, content and cultural impact.
* Develop learnings and best practices that improve future Film and OTT partnerships.

****What Success Looks Like****
**In the first 3 months**

* Develop a strong understanding of the portfolio of brands, agency ecosystem and ways of working.
* Independently manage Film and OTT campaigns from briefing through execution and reporting.
* Proactively bring new opportunities and thinking to brands rather than responding only to briefs.

**In 6 months**

* Build strategic annual Film and OTT opportunity plans across priority brands.
* Increase the number of brands meaningfully participating in entertainment partnerships.
* Develop a strong understanding of emerging trends across films, streaming, talent and audience behaviour.
* Establish strong working relationships with key studios, production houses, platforms and internal stakeholders.

**In 12 months**

* Establish best practices and frameworks for Film and OTT partnerships.
* Become a trusted thought partner to brands on entertainment and popular culture.
* Build a differentiated pipeline of partnerships across Bollywood, regional cinema and OTT.
* Deliver against agreed annual business, partnership and campaign objectives.

****What We’re Looking For****

* Minimum 5+ years of relevant experience across entertainment marketing, branded content, film partnerships, OTT partnerships, studios, production houses or related businesses.
* Prior experience working on film integrations, movie marketing partnerships, OTT associations or branded entertainment is strongly preferred.
* Graduate degree mandatory; postgraduate qualification preferred.
* Strong understanding of the Indian film, streaming and entertainment ecosystem.
* Strong creative judgement coupled with the ability to evaluate opportunities strategically and commercially.
* Excellent project-management skills and the ability to manage complex, long-gestation campaigns involving multiple stakeholders.
* Strong presentation, communication and interpersonal skills.
* Understanding of social media, digital marketing, content marketing and media amplification.
* Proficiency in at least one Indian regional language is preferred but not mandatory.
* Hands on Experience in pre and post-production will be an added advantage.

**Core expectations from the role**

* Work across some of India’s largest brands Build entertainment partnerships for a diverse portfolio of leading FMCG brands.
* Put brands at the heart of popular culture Work across films, streaming, talent and entertainment to create partnerships audiences genuinely want to engage with.
* Operate at extraordinary scale Be part of Mindshare and WPP Media, working within one of the largest media and marketing ecosystems in India.

****Life At WPP Media & Benefits****
Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.
  
  
WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
  
  
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
  
  
Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: Senior Engineer - PHE&FF
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
Jacobs is seeking a Senior Engineer/ Lead Engineer, who will be able to design & develop PHE & FF services for medium to large scale projects. Candidates should be a graduate Mechanical/Civil engineer with around 8-17 years’ experience in designing the PHE&FF services from Concept stage till IFC stage.
  
  
Daily Duties/Tasks

* Demonstrates strong technical expertise across all fire protection systems, supported by comprehensive knowledge of relevant local codes and advanced proficiency in NFPA standards.
* Excellent knowledge on space planning and ability to coordinate effectively with other stakeholders of the project

If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: Project Director/ Project Manager - Credit Risk Consulting
description:
**Highlight of the engagement opportunity**

* **Nature of role:**
  Full time
* **Number of years of experience expected:**
* **Project Manager:**
  8–13 years, including at least 5 years hands-on in credit risk modelling, credit analytics, credit policy, or regulatory capital.
* **Project Director:**
  13–20 years, including at least 7 years in the above, with proven ownership of delivery, revenue, and client relationships.
* Candidates without direct credit risk modelling / analytics experience will not be shortlisted, regardless of general risk consulting pedigree.
* **Areas of past experience preferred / mandatory:**
* **Credit risk modelling and scorecards:**
  application, behavioural, collection, and bureau scorecards; credit rating and scoring models; PD / LGD / EAD models; scorecard development lifecycle including data preparation, WOE / IV analysis, logistic regression and machine learning models, cut-off setting, calibration, validation, monitoring, and redevelopment.
* **Credit risk policy and framework:**
  credit policy, underwriting and credit appraisal, delegation of authority, credit monitoring, early warning signals (EWS), restructuring, NPA / IRAC classification, provisioning, and write-off policy.
* **Regulatory capital and Basel:**
  credit RWA computation, Standardised and IRB (F-IRB / A-IRB) approaches, capital adequacy (CRAR), capital conservation buffer, leverage ratio, ICAAP, and stress testing.
* **Portfolio analytics:**
  vintage analysis, roll-rate and migration matrix, delinquency analysis, concentration risk, portfolio ECL, collections and recovery analytics.
* **IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109:**
  impairment model design, staging and SICR logic, ECL computation, macro-economic scenario design, and disclosures.
* **Model risk management:**
  model validation, model governance, model inventory, back-testing, benchmarking, sensitivity and outcome analysis, and ongoing monitoring.
* **Regulatory frameworks:**
  RBI guidelines on credit risk, ECL, IRAC, and provisioning; Basel III / IV; Middle East regulatory context (CBUAE, SAMA, CBB, QCB, CBO, CBK / CMA Kuwait) preferred.
* Consulting or in-house risk analytics experience with banks, NBFCs, insurers, or corporates.
* **Educational qualification expected:**
  Graduate / Postgraduate
* **Additional qualifications / certifications required:**
  None
* **Preferable additional certifications:**
  CA / FRM / Actuarial / CQF / PRM / CFA
* **Preferred geography of previous work experience:**
  India / Europe / APAC / US / Middle East
* **Language requirements:**
  Ability to write and speak fluently in English
* **Application experience preferable:**
  MS Excel, VBA, Python, R, SAS, SQL

**Key responsibility areas:**

A. Engagement delivery and project leadership

* Independently lead and manage consulting engagements with leading banks, financial institutions, NBFCs, insurance companies, and corporates across credit risk modelling, credit policy, regulatory capital, IFRS 9, and model risk management.
* Own end-to-end delivery: scoping, project planning, resourcing, risk identification, mitigation, stakeholder coordination, and sign-off.
* Lead client conversations on methodology, assumptions, model design, policy interpretation, regulatory expectations, and business impact.
* Drive day-to-day execution of assigned client projects and produce regular status reporting for management on progress, challenges, and key milestones.
* Manage audit, internal review, and regulator interactions related to models, credit policy, capital computation, ECL, and provisioning.

B. Credit risk modelling and scorecards

* Lead development, review, and redevelopment of credit scorecards across the customer lifecycle: application, behavioural, collection, and bureau scorecards.
* Lead development and review of credit rating and scoring models, including PD, LGD, and EAD models for retail and wholesale portfolios.
* Own the full model development lifecycle: data preparation, treatment of missing values and outliers, WOE / IV analysis, variable selection, segmentation, model building (logistic regression, decision trees, gradient boosting, and other ML techniques), scaling, cut-off setting, and calibration.
* Define and implement model monitoring frameworks: PSI, CSI, Gini / AUC, KS, lift, vintage and stability analysis, and trigger-based redevelopment.
* Support credit strategy design, including approval / rejection / limit assignment strategies and risk-based pricing inputs.
* Produce clear, defensible model documentation and validation-ready model development reports.

C. Credit risk policy, framework, and regulatory capital

* Review, design, and draft credit risk policies covering credit appraisal, underwriting, delegation of authority, collateral management, credit monitoring, EWS, restructuring, NPA / IRAC classification, provisioning, and write-off.
* Assess policy effectiveness against regulatory requirements and internal risk appetite, and recommend enhancements.
* Lead credit RWA computation under Standardized and IRB (F-IRB / A-IRB) approaches.
* Support capital adequacy (CRAR), capital conservation buffer, leverage ratio, ICAAP, and stress testing exercises.
* Build and review stress testing and scenario analysis frameworks for credit risk, including portfolio-level impact assessment.
* Interpret and apply RBI, Basel III / IV, and Middle East regulatory expectations on credit risk, capital, and provisioning.

D. Portfolio analytics

* Lead portfolio analytics covering vintage analysis, roll-rate and migration matrix, delinquency and bucket movement, concentration risk, and portfolio ECL.
* Build collections and recovery analytics, including recovery rate modelling and prepayment behaviour analysis.
* Develop portfolio dashboards and MIS for risk committees, boards, and regulators.
* Identify emerging risk trends and recommend corrective actions at portfolio level.

E. IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109 impairment

* Lead IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109 impairment workstreams covering staging, SICR assessment, ECL computation, and enhancement of ECL and provisioning approaches.
* Design and review macro-economic scenario design, satellite models, and forward-looking overlay adjustments.
* Support IFRS 9 transition and implementation, including parallel run, impact assessment, and disclosure requirements.
* Align IFRS 9 ECL with credit policy, provisioning policy, and regulatory capital frameworks.

F. Model risk management

* Lead model validation and independent review: conceptual soundness, data quality, methodology review, back-testing, benchmarking, sensitivity analysis, and outcome analysis.
* Design and strengthen model risk management frameworks, including model governance, model inventory, model tiering, validation standards, and ongoing monitoring.
* Define model risk appetite, model risk reporting, and escalation protocols.
* Support regulatory and audit reviews on model risk management practices.

G. Practice, people, and business (Project Director emphasis)

* Lead and be responsible for team mentoring, project management, and client delivery.
* Own project revenue, margin, and resource utilization for assigned engagements.
* Generate business from existing clients and support pre-sales, proposals, and solutioning for new clients.
* Build and scale the credit risk consulting practice, including hiring, capability building, and reusable methodologies, scorecard templates, and accelerators.
* Represent Acies in client leadership forums and industry discussions on credit risk, IFRS 9, capital, and model risk.

**Other important information:**

* **Work permit requirements:**
  Either Indian Citizen or having valid works in India
* **Period of engagement:**
  Full time
* **Probation period:**
  6 months
* **Compensation:**
  Compensation varies depending on the skill, fitment and role played by the person. Compensation discussions will take place post the selection process.
* **Performance incentives:**
  Typically, all roles at Acies have a performance incentive. Specific aspects will be discussed during the compensation discussion
* **Leave:**
  19 working days a year. Additional leaves for national holidays, sick leaves, maternity and paternity, bereavement and studies vary based on the city and country of engagement.
* **Other benefits:**
  Other employment benefits including medical insurance will be informed during the compensation discussion.
* **Career growth for full-time roles:**
  Acies believes in a transparent and data-based performance evaluation system. You are encouraged to clarify any questions you have with respect to career growth with Acies personnel you interact with during the selection process.
* **Career opportunities for part-time roles:**
  Conversion of part-time roles to full-time roles depends on both performance of the individual and business needs. You are encouraged to ask about the prospects as you interact with Acies personnel during the selection process.
* **Global mobility:**
  Acies encourages mobility across our offices. Such mobility is, however, subject to business needs and regulations governing immigration and employment in various countries.

**Selection process:**

We seek to be transparent during the selection process. While the actual process may vary from the process indicated below, the key steps involved are as follows:

1. **Technical and modelling interview:**
   Deep-dive assessment of scorecard and rating model development, PD / LGD / EAD modelling, model validation, and credit policy experience.
2. **Case study / modelling round:**
   Practical scenario covering scorecard development, staging and ECL computation, capital computation, or model validation findings.
3. **Delivery and leadership interview:**
   Project ownership, stakeholder management, team leadership, and commercial acumen.
4. **Final discussion on career and compensation:**
   Post final selection, a separate discussion will be set up to discuss compensation and career growth.

The number of interview rounds may increase depending on the criticality and seniority of the role involved.

**Preparation required:**

It is recommended that you prepare on the following aspects before the selection process:

* Understanding of products and exposures in the financial services industry (Banks / NBFC / Insurance).
* Credit risk modelling concepts: PD, LGD, EAD, ECL, default rates, credit scores, recovery rates, and prepayment behaviour.
* Scorecard development lifecycle: data preparation, WOE / IV, segmentation, model building, scaling, cut-off setting, validation, and monitoring.
* Model monitoring metrics: PSI, CSI, Gini / AUC, KS, lift, vintage and stability analysis.
* Credit risk policy and framework: underwriting, credit appraisal, delegation of authority, EWS, restructuring, NPA / IRAC classification, provisioning, and write-off.
* Regulatory capital: credit RWA, Standardised and IRB approaches, CRAR, capital conservation buffer, leverage ratio, ICAAP, and stress testing.
* IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109 standard requirements, including staging, SICR assessment, forward-looking information, and disclosure requirements.
* Model validation techniques: back-testing, benchmarking, sensitivity analysis, and outcome analysis.
* Model risk management frameworks, model governance, and regulatory expectations.
* Regulatory frameworks: Basel III / IV, RBI guidelines on credit risk, ECL, and provisioning; Middle East regulatory context (CBUAE, SAMA, CBB, QCB, CBO, CBK / CMA Kuwait).
* Tools: SQL, Python, R, SAS, VBA, and advanced Excel.

For any additional queries you may have, you can send a LinkedIn InMail to us, connect with us at https://www.acies.consulting/careers-apply.html or e-mail us at careers@acies.holdings.

**How to reach us:**

Should you wish to apply for this job, please reach out to us directly through LinkedIn or apply on our website career page - https://www.acies.consulting/careers-apply.html
