title: Senior Salesforce Project Manager (Salesforce Implementation Experience Mandatory)
description:
**Description**
As a Senior Salesforce Project Manager, you will lead, orchestrate, and own the end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-cloud enterprise Salesforce implementations using Agile methodologies, SAFe frameworks, and modern, AI-enabled delivery practices. You will be directly accountable for delivery excellence across highly visible global accounts, program-level financial performance, strategic governance, and C-suite stakeholder alignment, operating with a mature business-owner, consultative, and customer-first mindset.
  
  
This role requires advanced strategic thinking, exceptional executive presence, and a proven track record of hands-on delivery leadership to turn around complex Salesforce programs, maximise project margins, mitigate systemic risks, and scale best-in-class delivery practices across the organisation.
  
  
**What We Expect**

* AI-First Delivery & Agentic Productivity Strategy: Champion and strategically scale the adoption of authorized AI technologies and prompt engineering across your delivery teams. Actively utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation, eliminate operational friction and compress overall project delivery timelines.
* Performance Evaluation & ROI: "Collaborate with customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance for their specific use cases."
* Enterprise Delivery & P&L Governance: Plan, direct, and oversee the complete enterprise Salesforce delivery lifecycle. Own financial performance at the program level—managing macro-scope, multi-track timelines, systemic risks, and cross-project dependencies while driving high-quality business outcomes and aggressively protecting Sold vs. Delivered margins.
* Scale Agile & Delivery Leadership: Champion and institutionalize Agile delivery architectures using Scrum, Lean, and SAFe frameworks. Drive multi-track sprint execution, rigorous backlog prioritization, predictive flow metrics, and foster high-performing, self-organizing, cross-functional global delivery squads.
* Strategic Planning & Portfolio Roadmap Management: Architect and govern integrated portfolio plans and long-term delivery roadmaps. Ensure transparent, data-driven progress reporting, proactive macro-risk visibility, and complex technical dependency management across the global engagement lifecycle.
* C-Suite & Executive Stakeholder Management: Serve as trusted advisor to senior leaders. Drive alignment across global organizations through executive communication, steering committees, and proactive escalation management.
* Quality Governance & Institutional Excellence: Design and enforce delivery governance, engineering standards, and quality benchmarks. Implement quality checkpoints to ensure compliance and continuous improvement.
* Strategic Resource & Capital Optimization: Orchestrate and optimize multi-shore resource demand planning, manage complex program budgets, accurate forecasts, and financial reconciliation while engineering mitigation strategies for structural delivery risks.
* Global Synchronisation & Timezone Flexibility: Maintain the structural timezone flexibility required to ensure seamless synchronisation, seamless governance, and executive support across global delivery regions (AMER/EMEA/APAC).

**Requirements**
**Must Have**
:
  
  

* 15+ years of total experience in the IT consulting/services industry, with 8+ years of dedicated experience leading complex, enterprise-scale Salesforce implementations.
* Proven track record managing multi-cloud, highly integrated Salesforce transformations across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and/or specialised Industry Clouds.
* Advanced, practical proficiency with AI-augmented productivity suites and LLMs (e.g., Gemini, NotebookLM) alongside a clear, actionable vision for applying an Agentic Delivery approach to project tracking, documentation, and risk forecasting.
* Deep, authoritative understanding of the Salesforce ecosystem architecture and delivery lifecycle, with a demonstrated history of collaborating with Enterprise Architects and Technical Leads to map technical scope to business outcomes (hands-on configuration is not required).
* Stellar executive presence with a demonstrated ability to communicate clearly, confidently, and assertively with C-suite executives, global sponsors, and enterprise steering committees.
* Salesforce Core Consultant Certifications (at least two or higher-tier equivalent):

+ Sales Cloud Consultant
+ Service Cloud Consultant
+ Experience Cloud Consultant

* Advanced Project / Scaled Agile Management Certification (at least one):

+ PMP, PMI-ACP, SAFe Practice Consultant (SPC), SAFe Agilist, PRINCE2 Practitioner, or Senior Scrum Master credentials (CSM, PSM II).

* Expert-level command over modern enterprise project management, portfolio tracking, and collaboration platforms such as JIRA, Azure DevOps (ADO), MS Project, Smart sheet, and Google Workspace.
* Flexibility and willingness to travel internationally or domestically on a need basis.

**Desirable / Nice To Have**

* Extensive experience delivering localised or global Salesforce transformations within highly regulated sectors: Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS), Financial Services (Fins), or Consumer Goods / Retail Cloud.
* Strong functional awareness of data streaming and mid-tier enterprise connectivity strategies, including MuleSoft, Salesforce Data Cloud, and real-time, event-driven architectures.
* Salesforce Agentforce Specialist or Legend certifications, with a proven playbook for managing and delivering Agentforce-enabled autonomous AI agent work-streams.

**Program Advisory Consulting Execution, Assistant Vice President**
based in
**Mumbai, India**

* We empower our employees to manage their financial well-being and help them plan for the future.

* We have a variety of programs that help employees balance their work and life, including generous paid time off packages.
* We offer our employees resources and tools to volunteer in the communities in which they live and work. In 2019, Citi employee volunteers contributed more than 1 million volunteer hours around the world.

The Program Advisory, Consulting & Execution (PACE) organization is Citi’s internal consulting and program execution team. Operating from Finance with a firmwide mandate, PACE serves as a strategic internal partner delivering management consulting, program advisory, and end-to-end execution support for Citi’s high-value initiatives and business transformation priorities. The organization partners closely with functional and business leadership to deliver significant, measurable business outcomes while retaining critical knowledge and reducing reliance on external consulting firms.
  
  
The PACE team is a global, interdisciplinary team comprised of seasoned professionals with deep financial services, program advisory, and management consulting expertise. With team members located in eight cities across five countries—Canada, Costa Rica, India, the United Kingdom, and the United States—PACE provides continuous global support, accelerated delivery, and rapid mobilization to solve the firm's most critical challenges.
  
  
**In this role, you’re expected to:**

* Serves as a key team member supporting highly visible operating model, process improvement, and transformation programs.
* Owns the management of core program management processes, including risk and issue tracking, status reporting, and project plan maintenance.
* Supports all phases of the project lifecycle on complex initiatives, gaining hands-on experience in end-to-end program and project delivery.
* Develops and maintains compliant project artifacts, such as dashboards and issue logs, ensuring data quality and alignment with the firm's control environment.
* Operates within a dynamic matrix structure, reporting to senior leadership while collaborating closely with engagement managers on day-to-day project execution.

**Responsibilities:**

* Drive the analysis of complex data and business processes, developing initial hypotheses to turn ambiguous inputs into actionable solutions.
* Support all phases of the project lifecycle, from initiation to closing, driving project execution and the successful completion of tasks and milestones.
* Own and execute core program management processes, ensuring all activities and artifacts are compliant with firm-wide policies and standards.
* Proactively manage program-level risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies, ensuring timely identification, escalation, and the development of actionable remediation plans.
* Prepare communications for project sponsors and senior stakeholders, including the development of executive-level dashboards and progress reports.
* Manage critical program documentation, such as charters and plans, while also contributing to the team's re-usable intellectual capital and knowledgebase.
* Provide objective review and challenge of project plans and status reports to ensure quality, and drive accountability for deliverables and performance across the team.
* Work with stakeholders to author business requirements, and support technical delivery leveraging waterfall, agile, and/or hybrid methodologies.

**As a successful candidate, you’d ideally have the following skills and exposure:**

* A minimum of 5+ years of experience in a management consulting firm and/or financial services company, in a role supporting complex programs and projects.
* A Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience is required.
* Technical proficiency across the MS Office suite, with advanced skills in Excel for data analysis and PowerPoint for creating impactful communications.
* Demonstrated experience in analyzing complex business processes, including process mapping, root cause identification, and the development of analytical frameworks.
* Experience translating business needs into requirements and partnering with technical teams to deliver solutions across various delivery methodologies.
* Strong organizational, time management, and process management skills, with an ability to handle a high-volume workload in a fast-paced environment.
* Familiarity with modern project delivery concepts like Agile, waterfall, as well as emerging digital trends including AI and process transformation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* A self-starter who brings a sense of urgency to assignments and goals, with an ability to identify issues, structure analyses, and draw conclusions.
* Proven ability to work effectively in a team, demonstrating initiative and the capacity to work independently.
* Experience and ease in interfacing with Senior Management.
* Individuals should be detail-oriented with a strong sense of task ownership, and accustomed to dealing with competing demands, fast pace, and changing directions.

*This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.*

**Work you'll do**

Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. Deloitte's TTC group helps our clients' tax departments move forward from their current state to the next generation of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. Deloitte TTC professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to address our clients' objectives in a seamless fashion. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who help connect our clients' global strategies with the options that exist to turn strategy into an executable plan.
  
  
TTC's Enterprise Tax Transformation (ETT) professionals provide an integrated approach to process improvement that can help the tax department maximize its strategic value to the organization. Companies that have already implemented, or are considering implementing, an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system often overlook the tax benefits these systems can provide or underestimate the impact on the tax department. To be most effective from a tax perspective, a successful ERP implementation requires professionals who specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function's unique needs, requirements, and obligations. Our ETI team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology, and practical experience to help clients avoid the pitfalls of an ERP implementation.

description:
**Job Title: Head of Planning & PMO – AI Datacenters**

**Location: Mumbai**

**Department: Project Management Office (PMO) & Program Governance**

**Reports To: AI Datacenter Head / SVP**

**Position Overview**

We are looking for a strategic, analytical Head of Planning & PMO to establish and drive governance, critical-path master schedules, budget control, and risk management across our portfolio of ultra-high-density AI datacenter developments.

You will orchestrate the end-to-end project lifecycle—synchronizing heavy Civil Core & Shell / PEB execution with complex MEP engineering, liquid cooling infrastructure deployment, and long-lead supply chain deliveries (GPUs, CDUs, transformers) for 100 kW to 150 kW+ per rack hyperscale data halls.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Enterprise Master Scheduling & Critical Path Management

Integrated Master Schedule (IMS): Build and maintain enterprise-level Primavera P6 master schedules covering site acquisition, permits, civil foundations, PEB erection, MEP fit-out, and Level 1–5 commissioning.

Interface Management: Map strict dependencies between fast-track Civil/PEB milestones and specialized high-density MEP installation sequences.

Critical Path Analysis: Track float, model schedule acceleration techniques (crashing/fast-tracking), and prevent bottlenecks on long-lead critical infrastructure.

AI & High-Density Infrastructure Program Controls

Specialized Procurement Tracking: Manage long-lead equipment procurement schedules for high-capacity liquid cooling units (CDUs), direct-to-chip piping arrays, medium-voltage transformers, and high-density UPS units.

Hyperscale Delivery Integration: Align project handoffs with hyperscale / Enterprise customer readiness dates for high-density GPU cluster installations (e.g., NVIDIA H100/B200/GB200 architectures).

Cost & Earned Value Management (EVM): Track baseline budgets, forecast cash flows, analyze S-curves, and monitor Earned Value (CPI/SPI) across multi-megawatt mega-builds.

3. PMO Governance, Risk & Reporting

Portfolio Governance: Establish standardized PMO frameworks, baseline change control procedures, and stage-gate approval protocols across all data center builds.

Executive Dashboards: Prepare real-time KPI reporting, schedule variance analysis, and risk heat maps for C-suite leadership and hyperscale client stakeholders.

Risk Mitigation & Claim Management: Proactively identify constructability, supply chain, and utility energization risks, maintaining mitigation matrices and managing delay/claims exposure.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

Experience:12–15+ years leading planning, project controls, or PMO functions, with 5+ years in multi-megawatt hyperscale or enterprise datacenter developments.

Technical Software Mastery: Advanced expertise in Primavera P6 Professional/EPPM, MS Project, Deltek Cobra, Earned Value Management systems, and BIM 4D (Synchro/Navisworks).

Domain Knowledge: Comprehensive understanding of Civil/PEB build sequences, heavy MEP infrastructure, liquid cooling deployment, and 100 kW–150 kW+ rack environments.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering, or Construction Management (PMP, PgMP, or AACE certification required).

Key Skills: Critical Path Method (CPM), Earned Value Analysis (EVM), multi-project portfolio management, contractor change order control, and executive stakeholder reporting.

title: Technical Team Leader – Electrical Commissioning (CxA)-Datacenter
description:

We are seeking an Electrical Commissioning Technical Team Leader to spearhead the commissioning delivery team for hyperscale and colocation AI data-centre projects.

This role will provide strategic technical leadership, people management and client-facing governance across the complete commissioning lifecycle from L0–L6, with particular emphasis on L3 Energization, L4 Functional Performance Testing (FPT) and L5 Integrated Systems Testing (IST).

* Validate seamless electrical integration with BMS, EPMS, mechanical and fire/life-safety systems to ensure operational coherence.

**Requirements**

* 15+ years overall electrical engineering/commissioning experience.
* 8+ years data-center or mission-critical electrical commissioning experience.
* Proven leadership of at least 3-4 complete L3/L4/L5 commissioning cycles.
* Proven experience of leading at least 2 ISTs in hyperscale projects.
* Experience managing 15–20+ engineers/technicians.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of HV/MV/LV, protection, generators, UPS, EPMS/SCADA and integrated testing.
* Strong understanding of Uptime Institute, TIA-942, IEC, IEEE, NETA, NFPA 70/70E/110 and applicable local codes.

NETA III/IV | CxA/CBCP | CDCP/CDCS | Uptime Institute ATD or equivalent

Ideal background: Hyperscale/colocation data centers, substations, power generation, semiconductor, pharmaceutical/life sciences, or other mission-critical facilities.

**Location: New Mumbai**

**Location: Mumbai & Bhubaneshwar**

**Position Overview**

We are seeking an aggressive, field-proven Head of Execution with deep civil, structural engineering, and fast-track construction expertise to lead the physical site buildout of our high-density AI datacenter facilities.

This role requires a specialist who can execute mega-scale Core & Shell infrastructure, oversee Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEB) and modular steel structures, execute heavy civil foundation works, and seamlessly integrate high-density MEP/liquid cooling infrastructure for 100 kW to 150 kW+ per rack deployments.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Civil, Structural & PEB Construction Leadership

Pre-Engineered Building (PEB) & Fast-Track Steel: Drive the end-to-end erection of large-span Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEB), structural steel superstructures, and composite floor systems optimized for rapid deployment.

Heavy Civil & Foundation Works: Direct mass earthworks, deep foundation systems (piling, grade beams, raft slabs), and structural concrete execution designed to handle extreme localized dynamic and static loads.

High-Density Load Engineering: Ensure strict civil execution compliance for elevated floor loading capacities required by liquid-filled cooling manifolds, heavy transformers, and ultra-dense GPU rack arrays.

Building Envelope & Site Infrastructure: Oversee total shell delivery, including insulated metal panels (IMP), high-rated security perimeters, acoustic barriers, storm-water drainage networks, and heavy-equipment access roads.

2. MEP, Liquid Cooling & AI Density Integration

Piping & Mechanical Integration: Interface civil construction directly with primary/secondary fluid loop installations, heavy chiller yards, and coolant distribution unit (CDU) concrete pads.

High-Density Deployment: Oversee site preparation and infrastructure handoff for GPU clusters (NVIDIA H100/B200/GB200 classes) running at 100 kW to 150 kW+ per rack.

Utility & Substation Works: Drive the civil buildouts for on-site high-voltage substations, generator yards, fuel storage vaults, and underground duct banks.

3. Site Execution, Quality & Contractor Oversight

Contractor Management: Directly manage General Contractors (GCs), structural steel fabricators, PEB vendors, civil subcontractors, and third-party quality control agencies.

Commissioning Support: Lead structural and environmental handovers to MEP teams, supporting Level 1 through Level 5 commissioning protocols.

EHS & Schedule Control: Enforce zero-harm site safety standards (OSHA/local regulations) while leveraging critical-path management to meet tight fast-track schedules.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

Experience :15 to 20 years in large-scale civil/structural construction management, with 5+ years specifically leading hyperscale datacenter or heavy industrial site execution.

Civil/Structural Expertise: Hands-on mastery of PEB erection, structural steel framing, heavy raft/pile foundation execution, and fast-track civil engineering.

AI Data Center Knowledge: Practical field delivery for 100 kW–150 kW+ rack densities, high-load liquid cooling piping runs, and GPU data hall layouts.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or Structural Engineering (P.E. license or Chartered Engineer status strongly preferred).

Key Skills: Heavy civil QA/QC, PEB vendor delivery management, Primavera P6 / MS Project, Level 1–5 commissioning handoff, and BIM/Navisworks conflict resolution.

description:

We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. The Digital and Technology India, is seeking a Lead Analyst, AIA Activation to join the AI and Automation team. The AI & Automation team is seeking a Lead AIA Analyst to shepherd General Mills’ AI journey into agent-based (agentic) capabilities — planning, delivering, and governing our enterprise AI platforms, custom AI agents, and the processes that support them. * Minimum years of related experience required: 2+ years in AI, analytics, automation, digital product activation, data science, or related technical delivery roles, including experience leading projects or small teams.

* Experience activating AI, automation, analytics, or digital capabilities from pilot or proof of concept into business adoption.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with stakeholders to define business problems, translate needs into delivery plans, and drive measurable outcomes.
* Strong communication and storytelling skills with the ability to explain AI concepts, rollout implications, and recommendations to non-technical audiences.
* Working knowledge of AI governance, responsible AI practices, documentation expectations, and production monitoring disciplines.
* Ability to operate effectively in an environment with global partners and cross-functional D&T teams.
* Technical Skillset - AI / Automation Activation, Adoption & Change Management, Use Case Framing / Business Translation, KPI Tracking / Value Realization,
* Responsible for AI, Security, Governance, Process Design, Workflow Mapping, Visualization / Storytelling, Agile Delivery / Backlog Management, Data Intuition, Analytics, Cloud Platform literacy·

* Aware of adjacent DNA capabilities and knows when to engage experts from other domains.

This role will lead the Key user Community of practice for Warehousing & Inventory Management (WMS & IM) processes to prepare for S4 transformation and drive continuous improvement and harmonisation, bringing together process experts form AMEA plants.

You will assess all current Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) related to Warehousing (CWM/DWM) and IM, to check compatibility and workability within the future S4H design (EWM) and ensure they are aligned with business requirements. Example subprocesses in scope would include, but not limited to:
  
  

* Receive Materials

* Manage Internal Movements

* Write-off Obsolete Materials
* Goods Receipt from Production

**Gap Analysis & Harmonization**
: Identify process gaps, evaluate harmonization opportunities, scoping of flows, and co-ordinate feedback to the regional team. Provide information and explanations to help contextualise any deviations, develop business cases for process standardisation across AMEA and escalate critical issues that may require specific AMEA support to solve.

title: Technical Director - OTT Delivery
description:
*For this role you must be able to work on a hybrid basis with at least 2 days per week working in the Mumbai office in Andheri.*

This role sits within Deltatre's Engineering & Technology function, at the interface between clients — both external (broadcasters, rights holders, OTT operators) and internal (product, delivery, commercial) — and the multi-disciplinary teams building the platforms that power OTT streaming, VOD, digital media, and connected consumer experiences for major international sports and entertainment brands. Technical Directors are the point of technical accountability across the full lifecycle of a project, from architecture and estimation through delivery and post-launch iteration.

As Technical Director, you hold full technical ownership across projects spanning multiple platforms and technologies — web front-end (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React), .NET and C# backend services, and native mobile (Android, iOS). You lead architectural decisions, drive requirements gathering and estimation, and combine hands-on technical practice with the leadership and mentoring that scale a team's engineering standards over time. The role rewards technical breadth, credibility with clients under pressure, and the discipline to keep documentation, code quality, and delivery predictability at the level Deltatre platforms require.

**Requirements**

You have led the technical delivery of large-scale, multi-platform projects before — over months, not sprints — and you can hold both the architecture conversation and the client escalation conversation with the same steadiness. You are credible with engineers because you still do the work, and credible with clients because you can explain what is happening technically without hiding behind jargon.

**Required**

* Demonstrated experience delivering large-scale projects or products over multi-month cycles in a technical leadership role — ideally in OTT streaming, digital agency, or a product-based organisation
* Broad technical fluency across the full delivery stack: web front-end (React, JavaScript, HTML, CSS), .NET / C#, native Android, native iOS
* Deep expertise in at least one core mobile stack — Android (Java / Kotlin, RxJava, Dagger, Gradle) or iOS (Swift, Alamofire, Kingfisher, In-App Purchase)
* Solution architecture experience for digital media platforms, with a working understanding of the trade-offs across the delivery stack
* Requirements gathering, refinement, and estimation for complex multi-stream projects
* Stakeholder management experience — external (clients, partners) and internal (product, delivery, commercial)
* Demonstrated track record of upskilling teams through code review, mentoring, and technical guidance by example
* Hands-on experience setting up and maintaining CI/CD pipelines
* Working experience of Agile delivery in practice — not only in principle
* Documentation discipline — solution architecture records, technical specifications, decision logs
* Fluent written and spoken English

**Valued**

* Experience leading projects across multiple regions and time zones
* Familiarity with performance optimisation techniques and tooling for high-scale consumer platforms
* Comfort with rapid prototyping as a means of validating architectural or interaction decisions
* Exposure to multiple software delivery process styles and project management methodologies
* Background in OTT, VOD, live broadcast, or media technology

**Process and what to expect**

* Introductory conversation: a step for us to get to know each other better, and for us to answer all questions you might have around Deltatre.
* 1-hour Technical round of Interview: we will deep dive on your experience and explore the technical and architectural decisions you have made in your past work.
* 1-hour Competency Based Interview: we will ask you situational questions around how you deal with real-life scenarios at work. Easier doing it, more than explaining it.

*If any of these formats would be difficult for you, tell us - we adjust regularly and can usually accommodate.*

*Accessibility and accommodation questions are welcome at any stage. Tell us what would work for you.*

The role will provide technical leadership, people management and client-facing governance across the complete commissioning lifecycle from L0–L6, with a strong focus on L4 Functional Performance Testing (FPT) and L5 Integrated Systems Testing (IST).

This position is site-centric and requires hands-on leadership through Integrated Systems Testing, including failure mode and fault tolerance validation, ensuring systems meet design intent, availability objectives and operational readiness requirements in line with Uptime Institute, IEC, IEEE, and NFPA standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Electrical Commissioning Leadership**

* Spearhead end-to-end commissioning of mission-critical electrical systems including MV/LV utility and distribution systems, transformers, protection systems, switchgear, busway systems, UPS (static and rotary), battery systems, standby generators, paralleling gear, load bank systems, STS, PDUs, RPPs, and critical power distribution.

**Integrated Systems Testing & Validation**

* Architect and execute IST strategies and scripts aligned with Uptime Institute methodology.
* Lead failure mode testing, redundancy validation, and fault tolerance demonstrations across black-building, partial load, and full load testing scenarios.
* Oversee Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) for major electrical equipment.
* Direct Functional Performance Testing (FPT) to verify system operation under normal, abnormal and failure conditions.

**Design Assurance & Technical Review**

* Conduct design and peer reviews at all project stages from a commissionability and operational resilience perspective.
* Evaluate electrical schematics, single line diagrams, protection philosophies and vendor technical submittals to identify and mitigate commissionability risks.

**Systems Integration & Controls Validation**

* Validate integration of electrical systems with EPMS and BMS platforms, verifying alarms, trending, sequencing, interlocks, and operational visibility during IST.
* Coordinate with mechanical and IT commissioning teams to ensure holistic system integration and performance.

**Project Coordination & Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with project managers, construction teams, MEP contractors, OEMs, and client representatives to ensure seamless commissioning delivery.
* Facilitate resolution of technical issues and coordinate across disciplines to maintain programme momentum.

**Documentation, Compliance & Handover**

* Develop and manage commissioning plans, execution strategies, test scripts, procedures, checklists, issue logs, punch lists, risk registers, and final commissioning reports.
* Ensure strict compliance with Uptime Institute Tier Standards, IEC, IEEE, NFPA, NEC and applicable local codes.
* Support client handover and transition to operations with comprehensive systems documentation.

**Risk Management & Issue Resolution**

* Identify, analyse and resolve electrical system deficiencies during commissioning to mitigate risk to programme, safety and availability objectives.

**Health, Safety & Team Leadership**

* Enforce site HSE compliance including RAMS reviews, toolbox talks and risk assessments.
* Lead, mentor and develop commissioning engineers, subcontractors and vendors to deliver excellence.

**Requirements**

* 15+ years overall mechanical engineering, testing and commissioning experience.
* 8+ years data-center or mission-critical mechanical commissioning experience.
* Proven leadership of at least 2 complete L2 to L5 commissioning cycles.
* Proven experience of leading at least 2 ISTs of hyperscale datacenter projects.
* Experience managing 15–20+ Cx engineers.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of HVAC, chilled-water systems, cooling towers, CRAH/CRAC, BMS/controls, fuel systems, fire protection and utilities.
* Experience with high-density/liquid cooling is highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of Uptime Institute, ASHRAE, NFPA and applicable local codes/standards.
* Strong knowledge of Sequence of Operations, controls integration, TAB, hydronic balancing and failure-mode testing.
* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.
* Strong client-facing communication and technical leadership skills.

**Qualifications**

Preferred Certifications

CxA/CBCP | CDCP/CDCS | Uptime Institute ATD | ASHRAE-related credentials

Ideal Background

Hyperscale/colocation data centers, mission-critical facilities, semiconductor, pharmaceutical/biopharma, advanced manufacturing or other high-availability facilities.

**Additional Information**

At FPC, we’re not just a company—we’re a thriving community where innovation flourishes, ideas are celebrated, and careers are shaped. When you join us, you become part of a dynamic team that:

* Shapes the Future: Work on groundbreaking projects that are redefining industries with sustainability, cutting-edge technology, and bold ambition.
* Supports Your Growth: From leadership training to cross-functional collaboration, we prioritize your professional development and empower you to explore new ideas, take initiative, and grow in your career.
* Values Balance and Inclusion: We celebrate diversity, foster collaboration, and ensure every voice is heard—while maintaining a strong commitment to work-life balance.
* Creates Impact: Contribute to the delivery of iconic, high-performance buildings and innovative solutions that have a lasting, positive impact on the world.

title: Operations Lead
description:
Landeed, a pioneering company at the forefront of transforming land registry and real estate transactions through innovative technology, is seeking an Operations Lead with a strong STEM background. This role is designed for a dynamic leader capable of driving operational excellence, streamlining processes, and overseeing the seamless integration of technology solutions in both office and field settings. The Operations Lead is crucial for ensuring that Landeed’s operations are efficient, effective, and aligned with our strategic vision of making property transactions more transparent, efficient, and accessible.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Comprehensive Operations Oversight: Lead the strategic planning and execution of all operations, including significant fieldwork, to ensure operational coherence and efficiency across the company.
* Field Operations Enhancement: Directly manage and optimize field operations, ensuring the effective implementation and adoption of technology solutions, and maintaining high standards of operational excellence.
* Process Optimization: Utilize technology and data analytics to streamline both in-office and field processes, enhancing operational efficiency and productivity.
* Leadership and Team Development: Mentor and lead the operations team, fostering a culture of high performance, continuous improvement, and alignment with Landeed’s goals. This includes developing training programs for field staff to ensure they are well-equipped to meet operational challenges.
* Project and Technology Management: Oversee cross-functional projects with significant field components and collaborate with the tech team to ensure the successful deployment and integration of new technologies in field operations.
* Data-Driven Decision Making: Analyze operational data from diverse sources to inform strategic decisions, identify efficiency improvements, and forecast operational needs.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Actively collaborate with internal teams, external partners, and stakeholders in the field to ensure seamless operational flow and to address any emerging challenges swiftly.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
Educational Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a STEM field, emphasizing the importance of analytical skills and a technological foundation for this role.
  
  
Experience: At least 3 years of experience in operations management, with substantial experience in managing field operations, ideally within the technology or real estate sectors.
  
  
Leadership Qualities: Demonstrated leadership and team management skills, with the ability to inspire, mentor, and drive the operations team towards excellence.
  
  
Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Exceptional analytical abilities, adept at leveraging data to enhance operational strategies and solve complex problems.
  
  
Technological Proficiency: A strong understanding of technology, particularly in how it can be applied to optimize operations and solve real-world challenges.
  
  
Communication Skills: Outstanding communication abilities, capable of effectively coordinating with both internal teams and external partners, and articulating operational strategies.
  
  
Adaptability and Innovation: Highly adaptable, capable of navigating a fast-paced, evolving environment, and committed to driving innovation within operations.
  
  
Landeed is not just transforming how land and property transactions are managed; we are also redefining workplace dynamics and operational excellence. As our Operations Lead, you will be at the heart of this transformation, leveraging your skills to make a significant impact. If you are passionate about innovation, driven by challenges, and ready to lead operations in a groundbreaking tech environment, we welcome you to apply.

title: Project Manager Construction, BOM
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
The Data Center Construction Manager (CM) is responsible for managing some of the most technical, cost efficient, and fast paced construction project schedules achievable. Amazon Construction Managers are constantly challenged to drive continuous improvement and deliver the highest quality, most technically efficient data centers in the world.
  
  
As a Data Center CM you will be a part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling the most fascinating and challenging problems in building Amazon data facilities. Amazon CM's are always at the forefront of the construction industry in terms of innovation, and maintain a focus to deliver the most innovative products to our customers.
  
  
Our data centers are industry leading facilities in terms of energy efficiency and cost effectiveness. The Data Center CM is ultimately responsible for the day to day construction oversight and management of the contractors. The CM will also be utilized as a leader in their specific discipline (construction management, building services, architectural, electrical or mechanical engineering) and be responsible as a team member for delivering construction of some of the most sophisticated electrical and mechanical systems in the world.
  
  
At Amazon we leverage unique opportunities presented to us by owning everything from the substation, to the server, and back to the cooling towers. We are diverse, upbeat, creative, team-oriented construction professionals working on a daily basis to develop data centers that are changing the face of data facilities
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**The Data Center CM Will Be Responsible For**

* Assist in project management and oversight of construction-related activities for new builds or general capital projects in Hydrabad area, under guidance from senior team members.
* Support efforts to drive costs down and shorten schedules while maintaining quality.
* Contribute to Construction Management for specific initiatives aimed at increasing the resiliency of our data centers.
* Participate in reviews of construct-ability of electrical and mechanical systems and building designs associated with the construction of new data centers or the optimization of existing data centers.
* Assist in creating project scope and equipment requirements, help with request for proposals, and capital requests.
* Support total project quality by assisting with commissioning and integrated system testing, and helping oversee the execution of the project.
* Help manage the Request for Information process during construction and coordinate construction administration with engineers.
* Record and report key metrics to team members and management.
* Learn to manage multiple projects concurrently, including new data center building and capital improvement projects associated with existing data centers.
* Provide operational support of installed facilities, including review of procedures, best practices, and maintenance initiatives.
* Develop leadership skills within the group and in internal and external teams that support the data center.
* Travel to datacenter sites for electrical, mechanical system audits and reviews, construct-ability reviews, startup testing, and full commissioning, as required, under supervision.

A day in the life
  
  
At Amazon we are a global team responsible for the design and operation of industry leading, geographically diverse, large scale critical facilities. Each team member is a highly motivated individual with demonstrated construction management and analytical expertise in the areas of complex, mission critical facilities. Daily responsibilities will include all aspects of the entire data center lifecycle construction starting with the site feasibility, through the procurement of the design teams and design review, daily construction oversight, and commissioning of completed facilities.
  
  
**About The Team**
About AWS
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
* Experience in vendor management
* Experience in a data center or other critical environment

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of construction or project management experience
* Experience in construction or project management
* Knowledge of critical data center equipment

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Global Indians & Transformation Lead, PBWM India
description:
Join us as Global Indians & Transformation Lead, PBWM India, where you will lead and drive critical cross-functional transformation initiatives across Private Bank & Wealth Management, ensuring disciplined execution, client-centric outcomes, and measurable business value. You will work closely with Business, Technology, Operations, Product, Risk, Compliance, and global stakeholders, leveraging agile and hybrid delivery methodologies to execute complex transformation programmes from strategy through implementation.
  
  
**Essential Skills/Basic Qualifications**
To be successful in this role, you should:
  
  
  

* Proven track record in leading and delivering technology-intensive transformation initiatives, business process design and analysis, preferably within the BFSI domain.
* Strong project and programme management experience, with a demonstrated ability to manage complex initiatives from strategy through execution.
* Experience working with senior management and global stakeholders across multiple functions and geographies.
* Strong stakeholder management, influencing, communication, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to build consensus and drive outcomes without relying solely on formal authority.
* Strong understanding of governance, risk management, regulatory requirements, and internal control frameworks within financial services.
* Demonstrated ability to identify and resolve risks, issues, dependencies, and escalations while maintaining delivery timelines and quality.
* Strong strategic and commercial acumen, with the ability to translate business priorities into actionable roadmaps and clear management briefings.
* Graduate in any discipline.

**Desirable Skills/Preferred Qualifications**

* Expert knowledge of project and programme management methodologies, including agile and hybrid delivery approaches.
* Previous experience delivering transformation initiatives within Private Banking, Wealth Management, Investment Banking, or broader financial services.
* Previous experience or exposure to derivatives and investment products.
* Good understanding of investment products and securities market operations.
* Knowledge of emerging technologies and their applications within financial services.
* Practical understanding of relevant regulatory and legal environments.
* Experience driving change management and process optimisation across complex, geographically distributed organisations.
* Strong interest in financial markets and the ability to understand and communicate complex business and technical concepts.
* Ability to operate effectively under pressure, manage competing priorities, and deliver within a high-volume, fast-paced environment.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as:
  
  
  

* Transformation and programme delivery
* Project management and execution discipline
* Strategic thinking and commercial acumen
* Client-centricity and business outcome orientation
* Stakeholder management and influencing
* Agile and hybrid delivery methodologies
* Business process design and optimisation
* Governance, risk and control
* Financial services and investment products
* Problem solving and decision making
* Communication and executive presentation
* Change management
* Emerging technology and digital transformation
* Collaboration across functions and geographies

Job location is Mumbai,.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To lead the portfolio management team in the delivery of successful projects, while ensuring that portfolio management processes and practices are aligned with controls and governance standards and that projects are aligned with the organisation’s strategic objectives.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Leading of portfolio management team, including setting of portfolio vision, management of portfolio performance, and provision of guidance and support to portfolio analysts.
* Monitoring of portfolio performance, including tracking of project progress, managing budgets, identification of thematic risks and issues, and reporting on portfolio status to senior management.
* Management of portfolio documentation, including aggregation of portfolio book of work, schedules, and budgets, and ensuring that portfolio documentation is up-to-date and accurate.
* Facilitation of portfolio governance, including ensuring that projects are aligned with the organisation’s strategic objectives, aligned with the controls and governance standards and that portfolio thematic risks and issues are managed effectively.
* Managing the portfolio Book of Work outlining the sequence and dependencies of change initiatives, considering factors like resource availability, stakeholder buy-in, and potential risks.
* Facilitation of change management activities, to ensure that change initiatives are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.
* Continuous improvement of portfolio management practices, including identification of areas for improvement and implementation of changes to improve portfolio performance.
* Collaboration with stakeholders, including senior management, project teams, and external partners, to ensure that portfolio management practices are aligned with their needs and expectations.
* Development of portfolio management processes that are aligned with controls and governance standards and that support the delivery of successful projects.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Partner Associate (Mornings)
description:
Hey there!
  
  
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.
  
  
Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.
  
  
Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.
  
  
Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?
  
  
To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!
  
  
Ready to be part of the experience?
  
  
Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.
  
  
**What You'll Do:**

* You will be responsible for the entire life cycle management of big events since the sales and legal team has signed the commercial contract till the events' final closing
* You will be the main point of contact between all the stakeholders, from the event organizer to all the internal teams involved.
* Although being the overall owner of the whole process you will work as part of a team, you will be in charge of making things happen in time and form by managing other department's tasks.
* Communicate product needs (Fever usability) and process needs to HQ, and work with product/engineering to deliver on them. to have a consolidated list of all the requirements and prioritize them with the product team.
* Create and maintain exhaustive Q&A to have an answer to potential user incidences managed by our user support team.
* Make sure that all the requirements needed to achieve the project goals have all the necessary documentation
* Depending on the event, your presence on-site might be required during the launch or other important dates
* The person will work from 7:00am to 4:00pm

**Who You Are:**
You are degree qualified, with a project management background. You thrive in a fast-paced environment and pride yourself on your flexible, detail-oriented, analytical, and organized mindset.
  
  
In order to be successful in this role, you will be expected to be an entrepreneurial individual. The role requires a mix of project management and operational experience. You will have to be very comfortable coordinating other departments to ensure the delivery of requirements on time, also delivering results in an ambiguous environment, being exceptionally detail-oriented while looking around corners.
  
  

* 1+ years in a project management role partner management or consulting background. This is not a position for an events background, but having event experience is a plus.
* Fluent level of English, other languages are a plus!
* Huge appetite for learning and the ability to pick up new skills quickly. You will also have strong analytical, relationship management, and organizational skills.
* You'll be solution-focused, identifying problem areas and then creating plans to find resolutions.
* You'll have strong communication skills and a proven track record of building positive working relationships.
* Highly organized and efficient
* Curious and keen to push boundaries and try new concepts
* Able to communicate with events partners, brands, agencies, and talent on efforts
* Ability to think strategically when faced with an events partnership brief or with our proprietary data on what events work
* Able to handle large amounts of work and parallel work-streams
* Collaborative and willing to get hands dirty and work on all required events tasks
* Knowledge of promotional tools such as Facebook and Instagram is a plus
* Strong academic background is a plus

**Why You'll Love It Here**

* Attractive compensation package with room to grow.
* Opportunity to make a real impact in a high-growth global category leader.
* Professional and personal growth from day one with real responsibility.
* 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences + free Candlelight voucher.
* Private health insurance: Niva-Bupa personal coverage fully paid by Fever.
* Language learning support: English and Spanish lessons.
* Hybrid work setup: home office friendly with a central (New Delhi/Mumbai) office location.
* Dynamic international team: a young, talented group creating a great work environment.

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!
  
  
If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch
  
  
Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!
  
  
If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.

title: Data, Cutover & Testing Coordinator – S4 HANA AMEA
description:
**Job Description**
**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**
**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Uniquely Yours.**
You are responsible for ensuring that projects are successfully completed on time and on budget. This includes project governance, budget and timeline development, build quality, testing and operational readiness, and the completed project’s readiness to go live.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**
You will:
  
  

* Drive consistency and quality in the execution of projects using the appropriate methodology and tools
* Identify, assess, and mitigate project-level risks and escalate them to global leads and/ or the program manager when needed
* Provide project reporting and status updates using scorecards, status reports and monthly review meetings and leading stakeholder meetings
* Lead budget management, resource planning and utilization
* Confirm the completion and consistency of projects and their readiness to go live
* Own the relationship with the external vendors including quality assurance in all phases of project delivery

**What You Will Bring**
A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:
  
  

* Proven experience in project management methodology
* Excellent communication skills and able to drive effective discussions with project resources from tactical execution level up to steering committee members
* Excellent project planning and proactiveness in identifying risks and mitigations and managing strict timelines
* Strong focus on cost, schedule and quality of project delivery
* Knowledge of relevant business processes and related technology solutions
* Stakeholder management and ability to influence positively in decision making
* Proven ability in building effective teams across internal and external partners
* Strong conceptual and analytic skills – enjoys problem solving

**More About This Role**
**What you need to know about this position:**

* The Cutover & Testing Coordinator will support the S4 AMEA SAP implementation program by driving structured planning, execution and tracking of cutover activities and testing cycles across markets.
* Coordinate business-side cutover and testing activities across in-scope AMEA markets
* Support transition from legacy systems/processes to S4-enabled ways of working
* Partner with workstream leads and market key users through Fit-Gap, Build, Test, and Cutover phases

**What extra ingredients you will bring:**
**Skills & Experience**

* Prior experience with SAP implementation programs, ideally S/4HANA, in a testing and/or cutover coordination capacity
* Strong understanding of testing methodologies (SIT/UAT/regression) and cutover/go-live planning for large ERP programs
* Experience working across multiple markets/geographies with part-time or matrixed key users
* Excellent tracking, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced Pre-Fit Gap to Go-Live program lifecycle
* Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Asana or equivalent test/defect management tools is a plus
* Good end-to-end supply chain / business process understanding

**Education / Certifications:**
Bachelor's Degree or Post Graduation with 8+ years of relevant experience in Supply Chain and Cutover & Data Testing.
  
  
**Job specific requirements:**
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Testing Coordination**

* Develop and maintain the overall test strategy, test plans and test schedules across workstreams (SIT, UAT, regression, performance)
* Coordinate test case creation, review and sign-off with functional leads and key users
* Track test execution status, defects and resolution progress; drive daily defect triage and escalation
* Consolidate testing metrics and produce status reporting for leadership/governance forums

**Cutover Planning & Execution**

* Build and maintain the master cutover plan, including sequencing, dependencies, timings and responsible owners across markets
* Coordinate mock cutover/dress rehearsal cycles; capture lessons learned and refine the plan iteratively
* Track readiness criteria (data migration, interfaces, environment readiness, business sign-offs) ahead of go-live
* Coordinate rollback planning and contingency scenarios with technical teams Cross-Functional Coordination & Governance
* Act as the central point of contact between workstream leads, technical teams and mkey users on all testing and cutover matters
* Ensure documentation (test plans, cutover runbooks, sign-off logs) is current and audit-ready

**Data Responsibilities**

* Act as the central Data SPOC for MSC within the S4 AMEA program
* Ensure data migration plans are in place and actively tracked for each workstream, aligned to overall cutover timelines
* Drive implementation of the data governance framework (ownership, quality standards, sign-off process) across markets
* Coordinate mock data load cycles and data validation activities with functional teams and market key users
* Track data quality and readiness metrics, escalating risks ahead of testing and cutover milestones
* Partner with MDS/DMLT teams to resolve data defects and gaps identified during testing
* Support market key users in reviewing and signing off on cleansed/migrated data prior to go-live

Country to country Relocation support available through our Global Mobility Policies
  
  
**Business Unit Summary**
Headquartered in Singapore, Mondelēz International’s Asia, Middle East and Africa (AMEA) region is comprised of six business units, has more than 21,000 employees and operates in more than 27 countries including Australia, China, Indonesia, Ghana, India, Japan, Malaysia, New Zealand, Nigeria, Philippines, Saudi Arabia, South Africa, Thailand, United Arab Emirates and Vietnam. Seventy-six nationalities work across a network of more than 35 manufacturing plants, three global research and development technical centers and in offices stretching from Auckland, New Zealand to Casablanca, Morocco. Mondelēz International in the AMEA region is the proud maker of global and local iconic brands such as
*Oreo*
and
*belVita*
biscuits,
*Kinh Do*
mooncakes,
*Cadbury, Cadbury Dairy Milk*
and
*Milka*
chocolate,
*Halls*
candy,
*Stride*
gum,
*Tang*
powdered beverage and
*Philadelphia*
cheese. We are also proud to be named a Top Employer in many of our markets.
  
  
Mondelēz International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
**Job Type**
Regular

title: Sr Consultant-Urban Planner
description:

title: Account Manager
description:
**Account Manager**

**Omnicom Global Solutions, IN**

**About Omnicom Global Solutions**

Omnicom Global Solutions (OGS) is an integral part of Omnicom Group, a leading global marketing and corporate communications company. Omnicom’s branded networks and specialty firms deliver advertising, strategic media planning and buying, digital and interactive marketing, direct and promotional marketing, public relations, and other specialized communication solutions to over 5,000 clients across more than 70 countries.

OGS India serves as a key global capability center for Omnicom, enabling its agencies and group companies with scaled delivery, specialized expertise, and integrated solutions. Our capabilities span Media, Data & Analytics, Technology, MarTech, Commerce, Business Support Solutions, Creative Production, Healthcare, and Strategy & Insights.

With a workforce of over 7,000 professionals in India, OGS continues to expand its capabilities and global impact, supporting the evolving needs of clients and agencies. We are committed to building future-ready talent and delivering high-quality, outcome-driven solutions.

*OGS India continues to expand its scale and capabilities through the integration of additional global operations, further strengthening its position as a strategic solutions engine for Omnicom.*

**Let’s build what’s next.**

**Role Overview:**

This is a brilliant opportunity for an ambitious Account Manager to join the team, working on one of the world’s largest petcare businesses and helping to create work that travels across markets, channels and cultures.

We’re looking for someone who loves making great work happen. You’ll be confident in production and comfortable managing projects and workstreams from brief through to delivery, whether that’s part of a larger integrated campaign or a more non-traditional activation. Working closely with your Account Director and the wider creative, strategy, production and project management teams, you’ll help keep projects moving, anticipate what needs to happen next and make sure the work is delivered brilliantly.

A genuine interest in strategy and creativity is really important. We want someone who is curious about the client’s business, consumers and culture; who asks good questions of a brief; and who wants to understand not just
*what*
we’re making, but
*why*
. You’ll be encouraged to bring your own point of view to the work and contribute to strategic and creative conversations as you continue to build your confidence and experience in these areas.

Ideally, you’ll also have some experience working across markets or supporting the development and rollout of global creative toolkits. You’ll be comfortable coordinating multiple stakeholders and helping ensure markets have the assets, guidance and information they need to successfully deploy work locally.

Most importantly, we’re looking for someone who wants to be part of the team: proactive, collaborative, curious, ambitious for the work and genuinely excited by what we can create together.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Supporting the Account Director in the day-to-day running of projects, taking ownership of defined workstreams from brief through creative development, production and final delivery.
* Building strong day-to-day relationships with clients and becoming a trusted and reliable point of contact across your projects.
* Keeping projects organized and moving forward, managing timings, actions and deliverables and making sure the right people have the information they need.
* Contributing to briefs and strategic conversations, bringing your own point of view informed by culture, consumers, the competitive landscape and the wider category.
* Supporting the creative development process and championing great ideas, helping to maintain the integrity of the work as it moves through different executions and channels.
* Managing production on defined projects and deliverables, working closely with agency producers, production partners, media owners, influencers and other third parties where relevant.
* Supporting the delivery of larger integrated and 360 campaigns, while taking ownership of specific channels, deliverables or workstreams within them.
* Supporting the development and rollout of global creative toolkits, coordinating assets, feedback and market requirements and helping ensure materials are clear, accurate and easy for local teams to use.
* Working at pace without compromising on craft or attention to detail, maintaining high standards across everything you deliver.
* Managing client feedback clearly and constructively, asking questions where needed and helping the wider team understand the key issues and actions.
* Supporting on the day-to-day commercials of your projects, including estimates, production budgets, WIP and reconciliation, with support from your Account Director and finance team.
* Understanding and managing the processes required to deliver work correctly, including usage, legal and regulatory requirements.
* Working collaboratively across account management, strategy, creative, production, project management and partner agencies.
* Thinking one step ahead, solving problems where you can and knowing when to bring in more senior members of the team.
* Guiding Account Executives on projects, helping to provide clear direction and sharing your experience as you continue to develop your own management skills.

**Required Qualifications**

* 4-6yrs experience in Account Management role, preferably with experience in petcare brands
* **Production confident**
  – you’ve had hands-on experience delivering projects and campaigns and understand the practical steps needed to get great work made.
* **Strategically curious**
  – you’re interested in the client’s business, their consumers and the world around them, and want to keep developing your strategic understanding.
* **Creatively ambitious**
  – you love great ideas, enjoy being part of the creative process and are confident contributing your point of view.
* **Integrated in your experience**
  – you’ve worked on projects that form part of larger 360 campaigns across traditional and digital channels, as well as areas such as social, activations or partnerships.
* **Globally minded**
  – experience supporting work across multiple markets or helping to deliver global toolkits would be a real advantage.
* **A strong communicator**
  – clear and concise both verbally and in writing, with good active listening skills and the confidence to communicate with clients and agency teams.
* **A natural relationship builder**
  – able to build positive, trusted relationships with clients, colleagues, partners and suppliers.
* **Proactive and accountable**
  – you take responsibility for your projects, think ahead and follow things through.
* **Calm under pressure**
  – comfortable when plans change and able to work with the team to find a way forward.
* **Highly organized**
  – able to manage multiple projects, deadlines and stakeholders without losing sight of the detail.
* **Commercially aware**
  – understands the importance of managing budgets, scope and resource responsibly.
* **Collaborative and inclusive**
  – you enjoy working across different disciplines and recognize that the best work comes from people working well together.
* **Hungry to learn**
  – curious about strategy, creativity, new platforms, production techniques, technology and culture, and keen to keep broadening your experience.
* **A positive presence**
  – someone who brings energy to the team, gets stuck in and is great to work with.

title: Senior Field Engineer - Lead Civil
description:

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

***As a Senior Field Manager with Worley,***
you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
  
  

* Responsible to lead the team of discipline engineers for construction supervision and management of the respective discipline works at project site.
* Assign/distribute works/work areas to the discipline engineers and ensure that.

+ The process of review of the ‘Issued for Construction’ drawings and seeking clarification based on the established procedure is followed.

+ The engineers understand the requirements specified in the contract agreement of the contractors for respective discipline.

* Supervise for safety to maintain a safe workplace. Ensure that the team of engineers carry out inspections of activities performed by the contractors to confirm compliance to Field HSE Specification. Highlight deficiencies to contractor through formal communication.

* Monitor contractor’s compliance to various requirements indicated under the contract agreement. Highlight non-conformities to the contractor through formal communication and follow up for compliance.

* Knowledge of quality control, safe ways of working, resource requirement, sequence of activities, and supervision of construction activities for the respective discipline. Aware of the requirements of various applicable standards (Indian Standards, ASME etc.) for the respective discipline.
* Aware of the requirements of various applicable standards (Indian Standards, ASME etc.) for the respective discipline. Knowledge of statutory requirements, general contract requirements and interpretation of contract clauses.

**About You**
To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
  
  

* Minimum 15 years of experience for Graduate Engineers/18 years of experience for Diploma Engineers. Experience of working as Lead Engineer/Area Manager/Superintendent in Oil & Gas Sector and Chemicals.
* Graduate in Engineering/Diploma in Engineering in respective discipline.
* Knowledge of safe methods of execution of construction activities for the respective discipline.
* Proficient in MS Office.
* Team Player, interpersonal skills.
* Adaptable, open towards learning and development, person of integrity.

**Moving forward together**
We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
  
  
And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
  
  
And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: Design Manager-Process
description:

* Review & check process design deliverables
* Ensure that all interfaces between disciplines are clearly defined
* Ensure all inputs required for process design are accurately captured

* Participate in technical discussions with owner, licensors, and suppliers to arrive at process schemes, inputs for utility system design. Evaluate & recommend various options for various process schemes to develop the process configuration
