title: Internal Audit Manager
description:
**Job Title : Manager**

**Function : Governance, Risk and Compliance Services (GRCS)**

**Location : Mumbai**

**>> OVERVIEW**

KPMG is a global network of professional firms providing Audit, Tax and Advisory services. We operate in 156 countries and have 152,000 people working in member firms around the world.

KPMG in India, a professional services firm, is the Indian member firm of KPMG International and was established in September 1993. Our professionals leverage the global network of firms, providing detailed knowledge of local laws, regulations, markets and competition. KPMG in India provide services to over 4,500 international and national clients, in India. KPMG has offices across India in Delhi, Chandigarh, Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Pune, Chennai, Bangalore, Kochi, Hyderabad and Kolkata. The Indian firm has access to more than 7,000 Indian and expatriate professionals, many of whom are internationally trained. We strive to provide rapid, performance-based, industry-focused and technology-enabled services, which reflect a shared knowledge of global and local industries and our experience of the Indian business environment.

KPMG Advisory professionals provide advice and assistance to enable companies, intermediaries and public sector bodies to mitigate risk, improve performance, and create value. KPMG firms provide a wide range of Risk Consulting, Management Consulting and Transactions & Restructuring services that can help clients respond to immediate needs as well as put in place the strategies for the longer term.

With increasing regulatory requirements, the need for greater transparency in operations, and disclosure norms, stakeholders require assurance beyond the traditional critique of numbers. Hence assurance is being increasingly required on industry issues, business risks and key business processes. The Governance, Risk & Compliance Services practice assists companies and public sector bodies to mitigate risk, improve performance and create value.

We assist our clients to effectively manage business and process risks by providing a full spectrum of corporate governance, risk management, and Compliance Services. These services are tailored to meet client’s individual needs, and provide effective support to management in meeting the challenges and opportunities presented by today's complex business environment.

Our professionals provide the experience to help companies stay on track and deal with risks that could unhinge their business survival. Our services enable clients to effectively co-ordinate their key growth, quality and operational challenges and working in partnership with us, clients have the benefits of KPMG's experienced, objective, and industry-grounded viewpoints.

**Following are some of our key service offerings:**

* Risk Based Internal Audit
* Enterprise Risk Management
* Risk Assessment
* Model Business Process Development
* Sarbanes – Oxley 404 Assistance
* Compliance Assistance – Contracts and regulations
* Corporate Governance Advisory– Review and Assessment
* Revenue Assurance
* Control Self Assessment
* Continuous Auditing / Continuous Monitoring
* Apart from the above service offerings, we also assist client organizations around various aspects viz. Accounting Manuals, Capital Projects Audits, Project focused Control Assessment, setting up IA function, etc.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Managers are project leaders/project team members who will be involved in conducting process consulting/ internal audit/ risk consulting and execution of other solutions of GRCS
* Assistant Managers may pay the role of team leader on engagements with 1-3 team members reporting to them for the project. AMs have responsibility of reviewing the work done (Deliverables) by the team members
* Interact with the client representatives for the ongoing requirements of the project
* Proactively does sales oriented reporting during projects. These would include identifying possible business opportunities for various practices within KPMG
* Consistently deliver quality client services and take charge of the project area assigned to him/her
* Monitor progress, manage risk and verify key stakeholders are kept informed about progress and expected outcomes
* Demonstrate in-depth technical capabilities and professional knowledge. Demonstrate ability to assimilate to new knowledge
* Possess good business acumen. Remain current on new developments in advisory services capabilities and industry knowledge
* The job would require travel to client locations within India and abroad

**THE INDIVIDUAL**

* Have experience in process consulting/ internal audit/ risk consulting
* Possess strong domain knowledge, understanding of business processes and possible risks in operations of at least one industry sector
* Ability to perform and interpret process gap analysis
* Ability to identify risks in business processes
* Understanding of control rationalization, optimization, effectiveness and efficiency
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills. Possess strong data analytics skills and knowledge of advanced data analytical tools will be an advantage
* Strong written and verbal communication skills (presentation skills)
* Consistent display of leadership skills
* Ability to work well in teams
* Understanding of IT systems, Knowledge of MS office ( MS Excel, PowerPoint, Word etc)
* Have the ability to work under pressure – stringent deadlines and tough client conditions which may demand extended working hours
* Willingness to travel within India or abroad for continuous long periods of time
* Demonstrate integrity, values, principles, and work ethic and lead by example

**Qualification**

* Qualified CAs with articleship from Big-4 firms, MBAs from top 10 Business Schools with 3-5 years of experience in risk consulting/ operations or compliance function role in the industry (Understanding of internal audit, business processes, sector understanding).
* Qualified CAs (non Big4 firms) / MBAs (non top 10 B-Schools) with 3 – 6 years OR Graduates (BE/B.Tech, BCom, BBM) with 6 - 8 years of relevant experience as above
* Graduates with CS/ ICWA with 5 – 7 years of relevant experience as above
* Certifications like Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) would be an added advantage.

**SELECTION PROCESS**

* Candidates should expect 2 - 3 rounds of personal or telephonic interviews to assess fitment and communication skills

**Compensation**

* Compensation is competitive with industry standards
* Details of the compensation breakup will be shared with short-listed candidates only

**People BENEFITS**

* Continuous learning program
* Driving a culture of recognition through ‘ENCORE’ our quarterly rewards and recognition program
* Comprehensive medical insurance coverage for staff and family
* Expansive general and accidental coverage for staff
* Executive Health checkup (Manager & above, and for staff above the age of 30)
* Les Concierge desk
* Internal & Global mobility
* Various other people friendly initiatives
* Strong commitment to our Values such as CSR initiatives

The opportunity is now! If you are interested in being part of a dynamic team, serving clients and reaching your full potential – KPMG Advisory Services is for you!

title: Senior Field Engineer - Lead Mechanical
description:
**About Us**
Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
  
  
**The Role**
***As a Senior Field Engineer with Worley***
, you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
  
  

* Responsible to lead the team of discipline engineers for construction supervision and management of the respective discipline works at project site.
* Assign/distribute works/work areas to the discipline engineers and ensure that

+ The process of review of the ‘Issued for Construction’ drawings and seeking clarification based on the established procedure is followed.
+ Necessary inputs are provided to the Planning Engineer/Team at project site for developing the construction schedule for the respective discipline.
+ The engineers understand the requirements specified in the contract agreement of the contractors for respective discipline.
+ The engineers collaborate with the contractors for development of the detailed construction schedule/review the construction schedule, resource status submitted by contractors.
+ Stage wise inspections are carried out, of works performed by the contractor based on the approved quality plan and necessary documentation for the inspections performed are maintained.
+ The engineers Review JHAs, method statements and lifting plan (if applicable).

* Approval of Quality Plan and Inspection Test Plan of the contractors.
* Lead site walk rounds for the respective discipline and participate in quality audits.
* Supervise for safety to maintain a safe workplace. Ensure that the team of engineers carry out inspections of activities performed by the contractors to confirm compliance to Field HSE Specification. Highlight deficiencies to contractor through formal communication.
* Maintain status of front availability and monitor work progress as compared to the approved schedule and highlight deficiencies to the contractor through formal contractual communications.
* Monitor contractor’s compliance to various requirements indicated under the contract agreement. Highlight non-conformities to the contractor through formal communication and follow up for compliance.
* Lead review meetings with Contractors.
* Review and certify the interim and final measurement records submitted by the contractors.
* Coordinate with the Contractors for submission of ‘As Built’ mark ups and review of the same.

**About You**
To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
  
  

* Knowledge of quality control, safe ways of working, resource requirement, sequence of activities, and supervision of construction activities for the respective discipline. Aware of the requirements of various applicable standards (Indian Standards, ASME etc.) for the respective discipline.
* Aware of the requirements of various applicable standards (Indian Standards, ASME etc.) for the respective discipline. Knowledge of statutory requirements, general contract requirements and interpretation of contract clauses.
* Minimum 15 years of experience for Graduate Engineers/18 years of experience for Diploma Engineers. Experience of working as Lead Engineer/Area Manager/Superintendent in Oil & Gas Sector and Chemicals.
* Graduate in Engineering/Diploma in Engineering in respective discipline.
* Knowledge of safe methods of execution of construction activities for the respective discipline.
* Proficient in MS Office.
* Team Player, interpersonal skills.
* Adaptable, open towards learning and development, person of integrity.

**Moving forward together**
We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
  
  
And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.

In this role, you will support the India team to ensure the timely completion of new lease transactions including renewals, expansions, terminations, and reconfiguration of existing warehouse space. This encompasses the entire process from working with the local management team in defining the requirements, lease negotiations (business and legal terms), on-site surveys, comparative financial analysis of lease transaction, and project management to affect the end result. Your primary objective in this role is to provide adequate, cost effective storage/operation space for Amazon on the continent given the market conditions working to challenging deadlines and budgetary requirements.

Deliver the Real Estate requirements of the assigned region in keeping with the overall strategy for maintaining and developing space requirements of Amazon India Warehouse/storage strategy

* Draft claims submissions, rebuttals, position papers, and sections of expert reports.
* Support formal dispute resolution processes, including adjudication, arbitration, mediation, and litigation.
* Assist senior consultants and expert witnesses in the preparation of evidence and hearing materials.

**Team Leadership & Quality Assurance**

* Provide guidance and technical support to Associates and junior team members.
* Review analyses and deliverables to ensure accuracy, consistency, and quality.
* Contribute to the development of methodologies, tools, and best practices within the Construction Advisory practice.
* Support business development initiatives, proposal preparation, and thought leadership activities as required.

* Working knowledge of FIDIC or similar contract frameworks.
* Experience using Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, and Microsoft Excel.
* Understanding of forensic delay analysis techniques and methodologies.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
* Excellent report-writing and communication skills, with the ability to present complex findings clearly and concisely.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced consulting environment.

**Preferred**

* Experience working on international construction projects across EMEA and/or APAC.
* Exposure to the Middle East construction sector.
* Experience within a contractor, consultant, or construction advisory environment.
* Experience supporting formal dispute resolution proceedings, including arbitration and litigation.
* Progress toward or attainment of professional certifications such as:
  + MRICS

  + Other relevant industry credentials

**Why Join Us?** 




 Take ownership of a critical function at a growing design studio, with the opportunity to shape how projects are planned, coordinated and delivered. This is a role for someone who can bring both execution excellence and structure to a multi\-project environment.

title: Project Manager
description:
**About Us**
 Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
   

  

**The Role**
***As a Project Manager with Worley***
 , you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
   

  

**Technical Expertise And Thought Leadership**
* To plan, co\-ordinate and manage the design, procurement, construction, and commissioning of medium/large projects by directing a project manager or team of project managers/area managers depending upon scope and competency.
* To ensure clear agreement of client objectives and that these are met or exceeded.
* To achieve or better the budgeted gross margin.


**Specific Accountability**
* Direct the Integration of a Medium/Large Project.
* Direct the implementation of all functions of project management.
* Direct the internal company environment to meet the needs of a Medium/large project.
* Direct the project through its development stages.


**Client Relationships**
* Identify, document, and communicate the client requirements.
* Effective management of multiple stakeholders.
* Maintain and build healthy client relationships throughout the project and post completion.
* Proactively resolve performance, scope, cost, and schedule issues with the Client as they arise, in conjunction with the Project Manager(s).


**Commercial Management**
* Effective management of Worley/Client contract, including delivery of the budget gross margin.


**Scope Management**
* Effective handover from Business Development Group.
* Clear definition of scope.
* Compliance with requirements of the contract.
* Effective change control process application.
* Manage and monitor project performance on an ongoing basis to identify issues and opportunities early and take pre\-emptive action.
* Effectively manages project interfaces, in conjunction with the Project Manager(s), including the use of High Value Engineering centres.


**Time Management**
* Direct the planning of all scope elements of the project, with the support of the Project Manager(s).
* Develop resource \& financial requirements from the project plan.
* Direct the management of the design, procurement, and construction activities to meet the project schedule.
* Ownership of the project schedule.
* Routine monitoring of the key reports and development of corrective action plans.
* Timely and effective documentation turnover and project close\-out.


**Cost Control**
* Direct the planning and preparation of accurate project estimates.
* Establish cost report for control of projects.
* Monitoring and control of all cost aspects of the project to forecast costs, obtain approvals, identify trends, and take action to avoid cost overruns and take advantage of opportunities
* Assess performance of cost control system \& personnel.


**Team Collaboration And Supervision**
* Provide clear and focused leadership for the project team to create a vision for project success and a strategy to fit that vision.
* Define roles and responsibilities, in particular the respective roles of the Project Director vis a vis the Project Manager(s).
* Focus team on achievement of milestones and other key project objectives.
* Listen to the team, discuss the issues, resolve problems, and direct activities to remove roadblocks and achieve objectives.
* Participate in staff performance evaluations.
* Identify and implement training requirements.


**Project Execution And Quality Assurance**
* Define the project quality requirements.
* Ensure the right systems are in place and that these are applied on the project.
* Development of a project schedule which allows work to be executed in a logical sequence.
* Compliance with Worley policies and procedures.
* Implement lessons learned system.


**Documentation And Communication**
* Effective communications with the project team.
* Documented communication requirements.
* Accurate, timely \& effective progress reporting to the Client and internally to Worley management.
* Ongoing monitoring of the communication network between project staff, the client and third parties and introduction of changes where required.


**Specifications And Bid Activities**
* Ensure that clear objectives set for the design team.
* Assess the design activities and ensure a 'fit for purpose' design of the plant.
* Monitor design activities, interdisciplinary data flow and communications.


**Constructability, Operability, And Maintainability**
* Ensure that clear objectives set for the procurement and subcontracts team.
* Assess procurement process throughout the project to ensure goods meet specification, are delivered on time and are within budget.
* Set clear objectives for the Construction team.
* Monitor the Construction Management function to ensure safe delivery of the project within cost and schedule objectives.


**About You**
 To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
   

  

**Qualifications / Skill Set**
* Relevant degree or equivalent qualification (Chartered Engineer preferable).
* Proven track record of working as a in the capacity of senior project manager for medium/large scale project (TIC 25 Min US$ and above).


**Professional Experience**
* Minimum of 15 years \+ industry experience.
* Ability to direct a project, with the direct supervision and coordination provided by the Project Manager(s).
* Demonstrable commitment to HSE Management in a project environment.
* Excellent leadership and communication skills.
* High level of customer focus.
* Previous experience as a Senior project manager / project manager on medium/large projects more than US$25m total value.


**Leadership And Project Management**
* Possesses leadership experience, having worked in project leadership roles, emphasizing the ability to drive successful project outcomes.
* Skilled in estimating project costs and writing proposal content, contributing to Worley's goals to be a leader in sustainability solutions.


**Health, Safety, And Environmental (HSE) Commitment**
* Work with project manager(s) to ensure that HSE requirements are documented and understood by all project participants.
* Compliance with HSE procedures.
* Maintain HSE focus for project duration.


**Results\-Oriented And Accountability**
* Achieves results set by self and others, meeting timelines, and pushing for stretch goals, reflecting Worley's commitment to delivering value over the life of assets.
* Demonstrates accountability for work produced, ensuring it is "right the first time," in line with Worley's promise to be the industry's straight\-talking partner.


**Moving forward together**
 We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
   

  

 And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
   

  

 And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWSI, Healthcare and Life Sciences
description:
**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector
   

  

 The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50\+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
   

  

 Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re\-designing software development processes to become AI\-native end\-to\-end (“AI\-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship\-building skills, intrinsic problem\-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands\-on transformation leadership.
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP\+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade\-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time\-to\-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive\-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed\-price, milestone\-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI\-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI\-DLC (AI\-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes\-based governance frameworks for AI\-native builds, and steering multi\-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI\-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale


**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 5\+ years of solving problems with technology in the Healthcare/Life Sciences Industry experience
* Experience delivering results for large, cross\-functional initiatives/projects, or experience in solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits)
* 5\+ years of experience in technology transformation program management, with experience leading complex, multi\-workstream delivery programs ($5M\+/year in professional services revenue) end\-to\-end, including governance, program delivery quality and velocity, and financial health


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience managing executive customer relationships and key business stakeholders
* cloud certification like AWS Cloud Practitioner or AWS Solutions Architect \- Associate
* Experience creating and implementing large\-scale programs
* MBA, or 6\+ years of working with Data \& AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
* 3\+ years of owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Project Management, Director, Portfolio & Change Management
description:
We are seeking someone to join our Project Management team to manage the External Financial, Regulatory \& Capital Reporting function comprising various external filings to the US \& EMEA regulators.
   

  

 In the Finance division, we act as a partner to business units around the globe by providing management, review, analysis and advisory services of the Firm’s financial and capital resources. This is a Director level position within the Project management team
   

  

 Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.
   

  

**What You'll Do In The Role**
 We have built strong techno\-functional teams which partner with our offices globally taking global ownership of systems and products. We have a vibrant and diverse mix of teams working on different technologies and functional areas. There is a large focus on innovation, inclusion, giving back to the community and sharing knowledge.
   

  

 The candidate needs to be able to work with geographically dispersed groups across Finance and IT in a very dynamic, rapidly evolving, and high pressure, high visibility project setting. The candidate will have to focus on user acceptance testing, business analysis responsibilities, including capturing and documenting requirements in the form of user stories, defining acceptance criteria, and liaising with end users to obtain sign off. The candidate is expected to work with technology counterparts as a part of SDLC. Tests include functional new enhancements/ bug fixes and regression testing existing scripts to ensure existing working functionality is not impacted by the introduction of new code.
   

  

* Master’s degree in technology, Accounting, MBA preferred from leading institutions
* Consulting/BA Exp in either of FP\&A, Treasury, Product Control or Regulatory Reporting division with Top tier global Bank preferred
* Experience of working as Functional Business Analyst and have worked upon technology implementation for projects related to any of Axiom Regulatory Reporting (EMEA/AMS), Capital, BASEL III/BASEL III End Game or Product Control.
* Proven experience in automation and digital tooling projects, with a strong understanding of automation technologies and tools.
* Experience in managing a team working on diverse requirements under different project squads
* Experience in managing projects and a strong understanding of project management methodologies.
* Functional understanding of any from EMEA/US Regulatory Reporting, Comprehensive Capital Analysis \& Review (CCAR)/Dodd Frank (DFAST)/14A/Q /FFIEC/LCR Reporting.
* Ability in driving process improvements and efficiencies for reduced time\-to\-market
* Ability to communicate key issues and progress updates in a regular, accurate, timely fashion with stakeholders
* Excellent communication \& interpersonal skills and ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams.
* Strong co\-ordination (across functional groups – stakeholders, IT, SMEs) and organisation skills
* Collaborate with a varied group of colleagues in Finance and across the Firm
* Responsible for and lead aspects of individual and team deliverables and projects, leveraging in\-depth knowledge of Finance functional area, product and/or client segments
* Adhere to the Firm's risk and regulatory standards, policies and controls; proactively identify ways to reduce risk in work
* Act as a culture carrier; embody and set an example of the Firm's values and hold yourself and others accountable to Firm standards


**What You'll Bring To The Role**

title: Project Engineer
description:
**About us**
 Amata Build Care solves critical construction and infrastructure problems where standard repair methods and off\-the\-shelf materials are insufficient. Our projects span India, concentrated in Mumbai, Pune and Delhi.
   

  

**About the role**
 The Project Engineer is the diagnostic layer between our CTO and our project teams. This role is for someone who works out why an intervention will hold, not only how to execute it. For the first six months it is a hands\-on problem\-solving role with no direct reports, growing into leading up to four project coordinators.
   

  

**What you own**
 • Diagnose site conditions where the standard method has already failed.
   

 • Decide interventions and escalate only genuinely novel or high\-risk problems to the CTO.
   

 • Own assigned projects from work\-order handover to technical closure.
   

 • Plan schedules across live sites and allocate people, contractors and materials.
   

 • Track budget against actuals and correct variances early.
   

 • Own delivery\-linked invoicing and track collections against milestones.
   

 • Run kick\-off briefings and post\-project reviews, and keep decisions documented.
   

  

**What you bring**
 • B.E. Civil Engineering. A project\-management qualification is optional.
   

 • 3 to 5 years on site with real diagnostic depth.
   

 • Preferred background in construction chemicals, waterproofing, retrofitting, strengthening, or repair and rehabilitation.
   

 • Comfortable owning budgets, schedules and collections beyond engineering.
   

 • Willing to travel to project sites regularly and to our Mangalore office when required.
   

  

**Compensation**
 ₹12,00,000 to ₹16,00,000 per annum, plus performance incentives. Progression to Technical Manager on demonstrated capability.
   

  

**How to apply**
 Apply here or send your CV to info@amatabuildcare.com with a short note on one project where the standard method would not have worked, and what you did instead.

title: BCM-FINACLE-Techno Functional-Manager-GDSF02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Consulting – Banking \& Capital Markets: Finacle Core Banking**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 This document covers two role profiles for Finacle Core Banking transformation programs: Techno\-Functional Consultant – Manager and Business Analyst – Senior.
   

  

**Role Profile 1: Techno\-Functional Consultant – Manager**
**Role Summary**
 We are seeking a techno\-functional leader with prior experience in Infosys Finacle Core Banking and strong expertise in banking business analysis, requirements management, solution mapping, process design, API and interface analysis, data mapping, integration coordination, and banking data models. The role supports Finacle implementation, transformation, migration, upgrade, and modernization programs.
   

  

**Role Techno\-Functional Consultant – Finacle Core Banking**
**Level Manager**
**Experience 8\+ years in banking; 5\+ years in business analysis or techno\-functional consulting**
**Domain Retail and Corporate Banking, Lending, Payments and Cards, Compliance, Treasury, Investment Banking and Wealth Management**
**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Work as a Lead or Senior Business Analyst and techno\-functional consultant in banking transformation programs.
* Lead requirements workshops, process discovery sessions, and solution discussions with business and technology stakeholders.
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications, solution requirements, and system design inputs.
* Drive requirements analysis, gap assessment, configuration advisory, and solution mapping across Finacle and surrounding banking applications.
* Prepare and review BRDs, FRDs, user stories, use cases, process flows, data mappings, and interface specifications.
* Coordinate across Business, Technology, Development, Testing, Infrastructure, Data Migration and Vendor teams.
* Provide functional and technical clarifications to integration, migration and testing teams.
* Maintain traceability across requirements, specifications, test scenarios and delivered solutions.
* Support SIT, UAT, Simulation, Go\-Live and Hypercare activities.
* Lead functional workstreams, support delivery governance, manage risks and engage senior stakeholders as required.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong understanding of Finacle Core Banking architecture, ecosystem, system configuration and banking data models.
* Experience with APIs, middleware, integration patterns, service\-oriented architecture, data mapping, migration, reconciliation, data quality and interface analysis.
* Understanding of Digital Banking, Mobile Banking, Open Banking, API\-led architectures, microservices, cloud, DevOps and RPA concepts.
* Experience designing Java\-based extensions, services and integration flows using Finacle Integrator and API Hub on Finacle 11x.
* Experience developing and customizing front\-end interfaces, menus and client\-side components for Finacle 11x.
* Strong banking knowledge across deposits, loans, cash management, collections, payments, forex, trade finance, liquidity, KYC, cards, treasury and wealth management.
* Knowledge of payment and settlement systems including SWIFT, TARGET2, EBA and ISO 20022\.
* Strong client\-facing communication, leadership, stakeholder management, analytical and problem\-solving skills.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* MBA, MCA, BE, BTech or equivalent qualification with banking industry experience.
* Experience leading Business Analysis teams and large\-scale core banking transformation, migration or upgrade programs.
* Project or program management, PMO governance, risk management and stakeholder reporting exposure.
* Experience using Generative AI and prompt engineering.
* Relevant certifications such as CBAP, CCBA, PMI\-PBA, PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum, Finacle, TOGAF or ITIL


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Sr. Consultant (Oil / Petrochemical / Crude Products)
description:
Argus is where smart people belong and where they can grow. We answer the challenge of illuminating markets and shaping new futures.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For**

 **Crude, Refined Products or Petrochemicals Markets,**

**What Will You Be Doing**

Companies in 140 countries as well as multilaterals like the International Energy Agency (IEA) use Argus data to index physical trade and as benchmarks in financial derivative markets as well as for analysis and planning purposes.

This division uses industry best practices, expert knowledge and Argus’ proprietary data to provide its clients with in\-depth market analysis, the development of business strategies, evaluation of capital projects and advise on operations across a wide range of commodities and geographies. The division counts the biggest names in energy, petrochemicals, fertilizers and metals as well as governments as its clients.

* Assist research \& analytics teams in the development of in\-house consulting tools, forecast modelling tools and analytics to empower projects with data driven solutions and emerging market trends.
* Foster a culture of continuous learning and growth by nurturing and developing consultants, equipping them with the product knowledge and analytics research skills needed to excel in their roles and contribute to the success of our team.


**Skills And Experience**
**Educational Background:**
* Bachelor’s degree in chemical or mechanical engineering or an MBA (preferred).


**Consulting Expertise**
* Minimum 3 years of consulting experience in Crude, Refined Products, or Petrochemicals markets.
* Proven ability to lead and execute bespoke consulting projects and manage client engagements.


**Leadership \& Collaboration**
* Strong leadership skills to guide project teams and foster a culture of learning and growth.
* Ability to work collaboratively across global teams and engage with stakeholders at all levels.


**Analytical \& Technical Skills**
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
* Experience in developing methodologies, forecast modeling tools, and conducting market research.
* Familiarity with databases and data\-driven solutions.


**Communication \& Presentation**
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to craft compelling presentations and confidently present findings to senior leadership.


**Industry Knowledge**
* Deep understanding of energy markets, including crude, refined products, and petrochemicals.
* Awareness of emerging market trends and ability to translate insights into actionable strategies.


**Additional Attributes**
* Strong problem\-solving and critical\-thinking skills.
* Ability to thrive in a multicultural, global work environment.
* High level of integrity and commitment to Argus’ core values: Excellence, Integrity, Partnership, and Inclusivity.


**Attributes**
* Ability to interact with non\-technical people in plain language
* Innovative thinker with good problem\-solving abilities and attention to detail
* Numerically proficient
* Self\-motivated with ability to work independently, prioritising tasks to meet deadlines
* Customer service focused.


**What’s In It For You**
 Our rapidly growing, award\-winning business offers a dynamic environment for talented, entrepreneurial professionals to achieve results and grow their careers. Argus recognizes and rewards successful performance and as an Investor in People, we promote professional development and retain a high\-performing team committed to building our success.
   

  

* Competitive salary
* Hybrid Working Policy (3 days in Mumbai office/ 2 days WFH once fully inducted)
* Group healthcare scheme
* 18 days annual leave
* 8 days of casual leave
* Extensive internal and external training


**Hours**
 This is a full\-time position operating under a hybrid model, with three days in the office and two days working remotely. Office hours are Monday through Friday from 09:00 to 18:00, with a one\-hour lunch break.
   

  

 Argus is the leading independent provider of market intelligence to the global energy and commodity markets. We offer essential price assessments, news, analytics, consulting services, data science tools and industry conferences to illuminate complex and opaque commodity markets.
   

  

 Headquartered in London with 1,500 staff, Argus is an independent media organisation with 32 offices in the world’s principal commodity trading hubs.
   

  

 Companies, trading firms and governments in 160 countries around the world trust Argus data to make decisions, analyse situations, manage risk, facilitate trading and for long\-term planning. Argus prices are used as trusted benchmarks around the world for pricing transportation, commodities and energy.
   

  

 Founded in 1970, Argus remains a privately held UK\-registered company owned by employee shareholders and global growth equity firm General Atlantic.

title: State M&E - Maharashtra
description:
ABOUT RIGHTWALK
 
 RightWalk Foundation is a public policy implementation and state\-capacity building organisation. We exist to ensure that progressive public policies actually work for people at scale — not just on paper, but in real lives, over time. Our RIGHT model — Redesign, Institutionalize, Ground, Hone, Transition — converts policy intent into sustained government\-owned outcomes. We operate across 4 states, have impacted 2M\+ lives and unlocked $2\.2Bn\+ in public funds.
 


 ROLE PURPOSE
 
 The State Lead – M\&E is RightWalk's eyes and ears on the ground in Maharashtra. Embedded within the state, you will be the primary executor of the organisation's M\&E agenda — ensuring that data from programs in Maharashtra is accurate, timely, and actionable. You will work closely with the Head – Data, M\&E \& Institutional Intelligence to implement frameworks, run data quality systems, and surface field\-level insights that feed into organisational learning and donor reporting. This role demands rigour, independence, and deep familiarity with Maharashtra's government systems and social sector landscape.
 


 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1\. State\-Level M\&E Execution
 * Implement and operationalise the M\&E framework designed by the Head – Data, M\&E \& Institutional Intelligence for all programs in Maharashtra (including the RTE 12\.1(c) initiative and Apprenticeship Policy activation).
* Serve as the primary point of contact for all M\&E activities in Maharashtra — coordinating with program teams, field staff, and implementing partners.
* Ensure M\&E processes are embedded into day\-to\-day program implementation and are consistently followed by all state teams.
* Flag data anomalies, implementation risks, and reporting gaps to the Head – Data, M\&E proactively — with recommended solutions.


 2\. Data Collection, Quality \& Management
 * Oversee all primary data collection across programs in Maharashtra — designing collection instruments, training enumerators, and managing fieldwork.
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and completeness through regular validation, cross\-checks, and collaboration with government counterparts and field teams.
* Maintain and update state\-level MIS, performance dashboards, and databases to reflect real\-time progress against program indicators.
* Conduct routine data integrity audits and mystery beneficiary checks; surface anomalies — do not suppress them.
* Standardise data entry, storage, and management processes across state teams and partners, in alignment with organisational protocols.


 3\. Reporting \& Visualisation
 * Prepare timely, high\-quality narrative and statistical reports for the Head – Data, M\&E, state program leadership, government partners, and donors.
* Contribute state\-level data and insights to organisational dashboards, donor reports, and evidence briefs managed by the Head – Data, M\&E.
* Develop state\-level data visualisations and summary reports that make program performance accessible to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Support donor field visits and reviews in the state, providing accurate and credible data on program performance.


 4\. Government Data Systems \& Alignment
 * Build and maintain working relationships with Maharashtra's School Education, Labour, and Social Welfare Departments to align M\&E data with government MIS and reporting requirements.
* Facilitate seamless data sharing between RightWalk and government counterparts, ensuring co\-ownership of data.
* Track and interpret government data releases relevant to RightWalk's programs in Maharashtra (DISE, HMIS, state MIS, etc.) and integrate them into program reporting.


 5\. Capacity Building \& Field Team Support
 * Train and support program staff, field enumerators, and implementing partners in Maharashtra on M\&E tools, methodologies, and data collection protocols.
* Provide ongoing technical support to ensure effective and consistent implementation of M\&E processes at the field level.
* Promote a culture of data discipline and evidence\-based reflection across state program teams.


 6\. Learning \& Feedback Loops
 * Synthesise field\-level data and observations into learning notes and insight memos for the Head – Data, M\&E and state leadership.
* Participate actively in organisational learning reviews and evaluation exercises, contributing state\-level evidence and field context.
* Identify patterns, outliers, and early warnings in program data and proactively share them with relevant stakeholders.
* Support periodic internal and external evaluation exercises by providing data, coordinating field access, and ensuring the quality of information provided.


 WHAT THIS ROLE DOES NOT DO
 * Design organisation\-wide M\&E architecture or indicator frameworks — that is the Head's mandate.
* Set programmatic targets or manage field delivery operations.
* Represent RightWalk at national\-level policy or donor forums independently.
* Manage the Knowledge Management or Institutional Intelligence function.


 CANDIDATE PROFILE
 * **Experience:** 
  7\+ years in Monitoring \& Evaluation, with at least 3–4 years in mid\-senior roles managing state\-level M\&E functions in the development sector.
* **Methods:** 
  Strong skills in both quantitative and qualitative data collection and analysis; hands\-on experience with DHIS2, ONA, Kobo Toolbox, SPSS, Tableau, MS Excel, and similar tools.
* **Data Discipline:** 
  A rigorous approach to data quality — you surface anomalies rather than smooth them over, and you build systems that others trust.
* **Communication:** 
  Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable reports and presentations for both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* **Language:** 
  Professional proficiency in Marathi — essential for effective engagement with government counterparts, field teams, and community stakeholders in Maharashtra.
* **Government Fluency:** 
  Demonstrated experience working with Maharashtra state government systems, navigating bureaucratic processes, and aligning data with government MIS.
* **Orientation:** 
  You are motivated by accuracy and learning, not by making numbers look good. Independent, resourceful, and calm under pressure.



**Success Traits:** 
  Rigorous, field\-grounded, proactive communicator, allergic to data inflation, trusted by both program teams and government counterparts.
 



**Core Competencies:** 
  M\&E execution, data quality assurance, field data systems, government MIS alignment, capacity building, and state\-level reporting.
 


 COMPENSATION
 
 We offer a competitive salary package matching relevant experience, fitment, and the candidate's existing compensation, at par with the development sector.
 


* RightWalk Foundation is an equal opportunity employer with social inclusion as a core value. We do not discriminate based on gender, sexual orientation, caste, colour, creed, religious beliefs, appearance, or socio\-economic background, and we actively encourage diversity in the workplace.

title: Associate Technical Director - Civil (UK Water)
description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.
   

  

 We are more than 36,000 people, in over 70 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.
   

  

**Role description:**
 We are actively seeking an Associate Technical Director \- Civil to join our Water Civils team. You will be based in our Bangalore/ Hyderabad/ Mumbai/ Noida offices. In this role, you'll play a pivotal role in establishing and consolidating relationships across Arcadis and our client base, managing the technical delivery and design outputs of some of the UK's most complex and stimulating projects in the Water sector.
   

  

 The world is witnessing the impact of climate change, rapid urbanization, loss of biodiversity and more frequent floods and wildfires. The role would sit within our Resilience Global Business Area, where we work to protect our natural environment and water resources, while powering our world for future generations.
   

  

**Role accountabilities:**
 Our Water Design and Engineering team is involved in some of the UK’s most complex and stimulating projects that are diverse and technically demanding. We have an excellent reputation in the delivery of such schemes and are working closely with some of the UK’s most established and recognizable companies, undertaking a vast array of projects to enhance the UK’s water infrastructure and environment.
   

  

 As an Associate Technical Director \- Civil, you will be a key leader within our multidisciplinary delivery teams working on a variety of water and wastewater capital projects, having the opportunity to apply your expertise to projects for our clients regionally and across the UK.
   

  

 Reporting to the Technical Director, you will be responsible for technically leading and/or managing the delivery of project\-related tasks to meet budget, timeframe and quality targets, meeting, or exceeding client expectations, promoting and marketing all facets of Arcadis' services during interfaces with clients and other sectors and disciplines, contributing towards the achievement of the divisional business plan and building networks within the industry.
   

  

 To be considered for a role we are seeking candidates with the following credentials:
   

  

* Lead a team (multidisciplinary/ multiple service lines) being responsible for the teams’ performance, people, culture, innovation and growth.
* Provide multi\-disciplinary leadership for the key account/framework of Arcadis UK water business, establishing and consolidating relationships across Arcadis and our client base, taking ownership for the delivery and associated quality.
* Ensure effective project/program management and financial controls for key account/framework. Develop a strong working relationship with key stakeholders/ clients, establish effective channel of communications and actively influence the growth of your team.
* Actively mentor, coach and develop the wider technical team members.
* Ensure seamless delivery, implementation of Project Management responsibilities and Quality processes.
* Assist the UK with pursuits/ tenders.
* Ensure management and financial controls.
* Act as a technical expert for complex projects/ provide technical guidance to team.
* Drive implementation of the latest developments in relevant design and modelling software.
* Manage resourcing, plan workforce, and proactively identify future recruitment needs.
* Possess strong line management skills to lead, grow and upskill the team.
* Understand and lead the promotion of the HS\&W culture of the business within your discipline.
* Provide guidance to the team members to meet the changing technical needs toward innovation and growth, adoption of future trends and technologies, driving standardization and automation.
* Demonstrate appropriate professional standards, recognizing obligations to society, the profession and the environment and exercise responsibilities in an ethical manner. Ensure effective task delegation within your team.
* Manage training plans considering immediate and long\-term business needs.
* Guide regional team/ clients through the technical decision\-making process and provide alternative solutions as required.
* Engaging in global activities and lead team members for the same.
* Working in collaboration with other design disciplines to ensure the integrity of the overall design.
* Roles at this level provide inspiring leadership to our people and support them to realize their potential
* Compliance of Arcadis business management system.


**Required Competencies:**
 Sound work experience in Design \& Engineering, Design \& Build projects in the UK water sector for the following, but not limited to,
   

  

* Non\-Linear assets (e.g., Treatment Plants, Combined sewer overflows \& Pumping Stations)
* Experience in Linear Assets/ Utilities – clean and waste
* Nature Based Solutions and SUDS will be an added advantage.
* Producing and reviewing hydraulic calculations, specifications, drawings and reports
* Working Knowledge of HADES software will be added advantage
* Ability to review buildability of proposed solutions independently and challenge designs.
* Familiar with British and other international standards and practices.
* Demonstrate ability to lead complex projects.
* Health \& Safety Management, awareness to CDM regulations.
* As an experienced professional you will be professionally qualified or, actively working towards it.
* Awareness and applications of Civil 3D, Revit, BIM and Information management.
* A strong, self\-motivated and assertive person capable of working under pressure.
* Well\-developed interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate effectively at all levels and across regions.
* Flexible to adopt new work /challenging work as per business requirement.
* Awareness of Sustainability best practices.
* Good communication skills.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**
* Around 15\+ years of experience and having a BSc/BEng or MSc/MEng or equivalent in a relevant discipline.
* Chartered Engineer status and membership of a professional institution such as ICE, or CIWEM
* Significant experience and track record in technical delivery of process plant systems on complex engineering projects, preferably related to water and wastewater industry.
* Experience of working on design and construct projects using digital design platforms
* Feasibility to Construction design stage delivery experience


 Why Arcadis?
   

  

 We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills\-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.
   

  

 You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.
   

  

 Together, we can create a lasting legacy.
   

  

 Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion \& Belonging
   

  

 We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day which is why equality and inclusion is at the forefront of all our activities. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. We are an equal opportunity employer; women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply. We are dedicated to a policy of non\-discrimination in employment on any basis including race, caste, creed, colour, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, and gender identity.
   

  

 \#Join Arcadis.
   

  

 \#Create a Legacy.
   

  

 \#Hybrid
   

  

 \#GECResWaterUK

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer - Water
description:
**Job Description**
 The Senior Mechanical Engineer will support for Transaction advisory, Owner’s Engineer FPR off taker / Developer\-side advisory, and lender’s technical advisory (LTA) assignments for water and wastewater infrastructure projects across the Middle East.
   

  

 The role involves conducting independent technical assessments, reviewing project design documents / Drawing and engineering reports, evaluating risks, monitoring project execution, and ensuring compliance with contractual, technical, and regulatory standards under PPP, BOOT, BOO, IWPs, IWPPs, ISTPs, and similar procurement structures.
   

  

 The position requires strong exposure to Water treatment plants (WTPs), Sewage/Wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs), Desalination (RO/Thermal), transmission networks, and related mechanical systems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Owner’s Engineer (OE) Responsibilities
   

  

* Act as the Owner’s technical representative, ensuring EPC Contractor compliance with designs, specifications, QMS/HSE requirements, and project contracts.
* Review and approve Mechanical designs, P\&IDs, equipment datasheets, hydraulic calculations, and vendor documentation.
* Monitor construction progress, conduct site inspections, verify installation quality, and track schedule deviations.
* Witness FAT, SAT, commissioning, reliability testing, and performance guarantee tests on behalf of the Owner.
* Assess change requests, claims, deviations, and support technical decision\-making for the Owner.
* Facilitate interface management between EPC, vendors, authorities, utilities, and third‑party stakeholders.


 Technical Advisory, LTA, and Transaction Advisory
   

  

* Conduct technical due diligence for water and wastewater assets, including assessment of designs, mechanical systems, technology selection, project feasibility, and compliance with Middle East standards.
* Review EPC, O\&M, and Off taker technical documents, performance guarantees, risk allocations, and technical schedules under PPP/BOOT/BOO/IWP/IWPP/ISTP models.
* Evaluate technical assumptions for financial models (capacity, efficiencies, availability, Opex/Capex inputs).
* Prepare concise Due Diligence Reports, LTA Reports, construction monitoring updates, and risk assessments for lenders, off‑takers, and investors.
* Identify key technical, construction, technology, and operational risks and propose mitigation strategies.


 Cross‑Functional Coordination \& Reporting
   

  

* Coordinate with process, civil, electrical, Instrumentation and environmental teams to ensure consistent technical inputs.
* Prepare high‑clarity technical memos, dashboards, and reports for senior stakeholders.
* Participate in client meetings, bid evaluations, and support proposal development for advisory assignments.


**Mandatory Qualifications \& Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering.
* 5–10 years of relevant experience in water, wastewater, or desalination projects.
* Experience working in/with Middle East markets (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Oman, Qatar, Bahrain).
* Strong understanding of PPP, BOOT, BOO, IWP, IWPP, ISTP procurement frameworks.
* Experience preparing or reviewing Technical Due Diligence, LTA Reports, or Independent Engineer Reports.
* Ability to read and interpret large volumes of technical documentation, contracts, and specifications.
* Strong analytical skills and proficiency in risk assessment.
* Excellent technical writing, communication, and presentation skills.

 Desired Skills
   

  

* Master’s degree in engineering, Infrastructure, or Project Management.
* Certifications such as PMP, CEng, or equivalent.

title: Search Engine Optimization Specialist
description:
**SEO Manager** 




**Location: Malad ,** 
 Mumbai, on\-site only
 



**Experience:** 
 3 \- 4 years
 



  





**Work schedule:** 
 Monday to Friday, with alternate Saturdays working. Alternate Saturday is WFH\*
 



**Team responsibility:** 
 Manage an in\-office team of 1 \-2 people
 



**About the role** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on SEO Manager to lead SEO delivery across multiple client accounts. You will manage a small team of 1 – 2 people while personally contributing to strategy, content writing, technical SEO, reporting and client presentations.
 



 The role covers traditional search as well as AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation) and GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation). You should identify useful opportunities, implement practical improvements and measure results without making unsupported visibility claims.
 



**Key responsibilities** 



* Manage the SEO team’s workload, deadlines, output quality and development.
* Audit websites and resolve issues involving crawlability, indexing, redirects, canonicals, site structure, mobile usability and performance.
* Research keywords, competitors, audience questions and search intent. Build keyword clusters and map them to relevant pages.
* Plan SEO\-friendly website architecture, including sitemaps, page hierarchy, URL slugs and internal linking, before development begins.
* Write and optimise website pages, blogs, FAQs, metadata and other SEO content. Prepare briefs and edit work delegated to team members.
* Plan and execute on\-page SEO, local SEO, relevant off\-page activities, AEO and GEO improvements.
* Review website builds before launch, coordinate required fixes and verify SEO and analytics setup after launch.
* Set up and manage Google Search Console, GA4, Google Business Profile and relevant SEO tools.
* Establish account baselines and prepare realistic monthly and quarterly projections for organic visibility, traffic and enquiries, with assumptions clearly stated.
* Track KPIs including keyword visibility, impressions, clicks, CTR, average position, organic traffic, conversions and lead quality where data is available.
* Build dashboards, monthly reports and client\-ready presentations covering performance, work completed, gaps and next priorities.
* Present SEO strategies, projections, progress and recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders.
* Work closely with content, design, development and account teams to get recommendations implemented.



**Must\-have skills** 



* 3 \- 4 years of hands\-on SEO experience across technical, on\-page, content and local SEO.
* Experience managing or supervising a small team while remaining hands\-on.
* Strong content writing and editing skills, with samples of website or SEO content you have written yourself.
* Ability to plan keyword\-to\-page mapping and website structure based on search intent.
* Practical understanding of AEO and GEO, including answer\-led content, entity and topic coverage, structured information and evaluation of search visibility.
* Experience with Google Search Console, GA4, Google Business Profile and SEO research or audit tools.
* Ability to build performance baselines, projections, KPI trackers and clear client presentations.
* Working knowledge of indexing, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonicals, redirects, structured data and internal linking.
* Strong analytical judgement, clear communication and reliable ownership across multiple accounts.



**What success looks like** 




 Client accounts have sound website structures, useful search\-led content and prioritised SEO plans. Your team delivers accurate work on time. Reports and presentations show what changed against the baseline, how results compare with projections, and what actions will improve performance next.

* Escalate critical risks, delays, and customer concerns to the Senior Project Manager in a timely manner.

* Track material availability and installation readiness.
* Monitor resource deployment requirements at project sites.

* Participate in project review meetings and provide accurate project performance updates.
* Ensure compliance with organizational project management processes and documentation requirements.
* Support movement of projects through defined stage gates and successful project closure.

* Knowledge of project management fundamentals including:
+ Planning and Scheduling
+ Cost Monitoring
+ Risk Management
+ Quality Compliance
+ Customer Management

* Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Good communication and negotiation skills.
* Proficiency in MS Project, Excel, ERP, and project tracking tools.
* Strong problem\-solving and follow\-up skills.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline.
* PMP/Project Management certification would be an added advantage.


**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
* On\-time achievement of project milestones.
* Successful movement of projects through toll gates.
* Revenue realization against forecast.
* Timely invoicing and collection performance.
* UBR maintained within target limits.
* Customer satisfaction.
* Schedule adherence.
* Quality and safety compliance.
* Timely closure of project risks and issues.

 work\-flow schedules.

 2\. Billing \& Commercial Control:

 RA Bills, Final Bills, quantity statements and supporting documents.

 completion of the respective work stage.
 



  Coordinate with Project Engineers/Site Supervisors for daily measurement updates
 



 and quantity verification.
 



  Monitor Work Order Quantity vs. Executed Quantity vs. Billed Quantity vs.
 



 Balance Quantity for each project.
 



  Ensure timely submission of RA Bills/Final Bills to clients and follow up for
 



 certification and payment.
 



  Maintain and regularly update the Site Billing \& Collection Status/MIS and report
 



 pending billing and payment matters to management.

 of such work.
 



 3\. Team Management
 



  Lead and guide Project Engineers, Site Engineers, Site Supervisors and Labour
 



 Contractors.

  Review daily work allocation and progress.
 



  Monitor manpower productivity and take corrective action wherever required.
 



  Ensure discipline, coordination and accountability of the site team.

 4\. Site Execution \& Technical Control
 



  Monitor structural repair, rehabilitation, waterproofing, plastering, painting and other
 



 civil repair activities.

 quality standards.
 



  Review site conditions and provide technical guidance to the execution team.
 



  Identify execution problems and ensure timely resolution.

 5\. Planning \& Progress Monitoring
 



  Prepare and monitor Master Project Schedule / Bar Chart for all projects.
 



  Review site\-wise daily, weekly and monthly progress.
 



  Compare planned vs. actual progress and identify delays.
 



  Develop recovery plans for delayed projects.
 



  Conduct regular project review meetings with the site team.
 



 6\. Material \& Procurement Coordination
 



  Review material requirements received from site teams.
 



  Coordinate with the Purchase Department for timely procurement and delivery.
 



  Ensure materials are available at site as per project requirements.
 



  Monitor material consumption and wastage.
 



  Ensure only approved and specified materials are used.
 



 7\. Quality Control
 



  Ensure all work is carried out according to Zindus specifications and approved
 



 methods.
 



  Monitor workmanship and quality at all project sites.
 



  Ensure necessary testing, inspections and approvals are completed.
 



  Identify quality issues and ensure corrective actions are implemented.
 



  Minimize rework and material wastage.
 



 8\. Client Coordination
 



  Act as the primary coordination point between Zindus management and
 



 clients/consultants for project execution matters.
 



  Attend regular/weekly client meetings.
 



  Discuss project progress, technical issues, delays and upcoming activities.
 



  Handle client complaints and ensure timely resolution.
 



  Maintain good professional relationships with clients, consultants and society
 



 representatives.
 



 9\. MIS \& Management Reporting
 



  Review daily site reports and MIS received from all projects.
 



  Prepare/submit consolidated daily, weekly and monthly project progress reports to
 



 management.
 



  Report project delays, manpower shortages, material requirements, quality issues and
 



 client concerns.
 



  Maintain project\-wise status of work, billing, collection and pending approvals.
 



 10\. Safety
 



  Ensure 100% compliance with Zindus safety policies and practices.
 



  Ensure proper PPE, safety equipment and safe working procedures at all sites.
 



  Monitor scaffolding, work\-at\-height and other high\-risk activities.
 



  Take immediate corrective action in case of unsafe practices.
 



 11\. Project Documentation
 



  Ensure all Project Execution Files and project\-related documents are maintained
 



 properly.
 



  Ensure site records, measurements, photographs, approvals, test reports, client
 



 communications and work completion documents are updated.
 



  Ensure proper documentation for project handover.
 



 12\. Project Closure \& Handover
 



  Ensure completion of all work, rectification and snag items.
 



  Coordinate final inspection with the client/consultant.
 



  Obtain completion certification/acceptance from the client.
 



  Coordinate submission of Final Bill and No\-Dues documentation.
 


*  Ensure proper project handover.

description:

 Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. **Additional Responsibilities**
* Own the company budget for delivering the construction phase of the project. Monitor the budget versus expenditure statement periodically and ensure necessary actions to remain within the allocated budget.
* Manage interface between various contractors/vendors.
* Maintain an inclusive environment within the CM team, guide, and mentor the employees for their career growth.


**About You**
 To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
   

  

* Sound and hands on experience on construction management processes, experienced in driving HSE compliances, Sound knowledge and experience of construction quality management, planning and progress monitoring, Knowledge of the construction methods and understanding of the processes, systems and protocols applicable to Oil \& Gas and Chemicals Sector.
* Graduate Engineers with minimum 25 years of experience and should have handled/successfully completed one project as Construction Manager Oil \& Gas or Chemicals Sector.
* Graduate in Engineering in Civil/Mechanical/Electrical Engineering.
* Knowledge of safe methods of execution of construction activities and experienced in driving HSE compliances.
* Proficient in MS Office.
* Leadership skills, Team Player.
* Adaptable, open towards learning and development, person of integrity Org Code.


**Moving forward together**
 We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
   

  

 And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.
