title: Senior Creative Producer
description:
**Company Description** 




  





**Dentsu AMP** 
 is a content\-focused creative agency and integrated production house, built to deliver high\-impact, culture\-led storytelling for brands in the digital and social ecosystem. Part of the dentsu India network, AMP brings together strategy, creativity, and on\-ground execution under one roof, enabling faster, sharper, and more relevant content solutions.
 



 With a strong pulse on pop culture, digital trends, and real\-time content creation, the agency thrives at the intersection of creativity and production. Headquartered in Mumbai, Dentsu AMP operates as a high\-energy, hands\-on environment that values craft, cultural awareness, physical well\-being, and disciplined work ethics, making it a space for ambitious creative talent to grow and do meaningful, visible work.
 



  





**Role Description** 




  





 We are looking for a
 **Creative Producer** 
 who can lead the creative development and end\-to\-end production of high\-quality content across social, digital, branded content, influencer campaigns, films and integrated marketing campaigns.
 



  





 The role requires someone who is equally strong at
 **creative thinking and production execution** 
 —someone who can take an idea from a brief, shape it into a compelling creative proposition, build the right team and production ecosystem around it, and deliver the final output within the required timelines and budgets.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of digital\-first content, production processes, pop culture and emerging content formats, along with the ability to confidently manage clients, creative teams, directors, production partners and multiple projects simultaneously.
 



  





**Experience:** 




 3–8 years of relevant experience in creative production, content development and end\-to\-end production execution.
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities** 




  





 1\. Creative Development \& Ideation
 


* Develop and research creative ideas for campaigns, branded content, social media, influencer campaigns, IPs, digital films and ad films.
* Translate client briefs and business objectives into strong, relevant and executable creative concepts.
* Stay updated with pop culture, social trends, digital formats, brand campaigns, fashion, entertainment and emerging content trends.
* Identify opportunities to turn cultural and digital trends into compelling brand content.
* Collaborate with Creative Directors, Writers, Designers, Directors and Strategists to develop ideas from concept to execution.
* Contribute to pitches and new business opportunities through strong creative thinking and production solutions.



  





 2\. End\-to\-End Production
 


* Own projects from ideation and pre\-production through shoot, post\-production and final delivery.
* Develop production plans, timelines, budgets and execution strategies.
* Coordinate with directors, DOPs, writers, designers, editors, motion artists, stylists, influencers and other creative partners.
* Oversee shoots and ensure the creative vision is translated accurately on\-ground.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality, timelines and budgets.
* Ensure all deliverables are production\-ready and meet the required creative standards.



  





 3\. Client \& Stakeholder Management
 


* Act as a key point of contact for clients across assigned projects.
* Present creative ideas, production approaches and project plans to clients.
* Manage client feedback and translate it into clear actions for internal teams.
* Build strong relationships with clients, production partners and creative talent.
* Ensure clear communication and alignment between clients, creative teams and production teams.



  





 4\. Budget \& Production Management
 


* Prepare and manage production budgets for projects of varying scales.
* Ensure projects are executed within approved budgets and timelines.
* Negotiate with production vendors, freelancers and external creative partners.
* Maintain a strong network of production houses, directors, photographers, DOPs, stylists, editors, freelancers and other creative vendors.
* Identify efficient production solutions without compromising creative quality.
* Manage production risks, dependencies and last\-minute changes effectively.



  





 5\. Post\-Production \& Content Delivery
 


* Oversee the complete post\-production process across editing, colour, sound, VFX, motion graphics and finishing.
* Work closely with editors and post\-production teams to ensure the creative vision is maintained.
* Review and approve content before client submission and final delivery.
* Ensure all content is delivered in the required formats, specifications and timelines.
* Maintain high standards of craft and quality across all final outputs.



  





 6\. Digital \& Social Content
 


* Strong understanding of Instagram, YouTube and other digital platforms and their content formats.
* Develop content that is platform\-first, culturally relevant and audience\-focused.
* Understand short\-form video, reels, branded content, influencer content and social\-first storytelling.
* Identify opportunities to create content that is both creatively strong and relevant to current digital behaviour.
* Understand how content formats and audience expectations differ across platforms.



  





 7\. Team \& Vendor Management
 


* Lead and coordinate internal creative, production and post\-production teams.
* Build and manage a reliable roster of external production partners and freelancers.
* Allocate resources effectively across multiple projects.
* Provide clear briefs, timelines and expectations to internal and external teams.

* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, client\-facing creative environment.

title: Manager- Social Impact & CSR
description:
About Equalifi Foundation
 
  





 Equalifi Foundation is the social impact arm of Equalifi, India’s leading membership network for financial services professionals. We believe that financial knowledge is a fundamental right, not a privilege. Our mission is to democratize access to financial education, empower underserved communities with investment literacy, and build a more inclusive financial ecosystem for India’s next generation.
 



  





 Our key focus areas include:
 


* Financial Literacy: Bringing practical money management and investment education to schools, colleges, and rural communities.
* Financial Inclusion: Enabling access to formal financial services for low\-income households and first\-generation investors.
* Skill Building: Equipping youth from Tier 2/3 cities with industry\-ready skills for careers in BFSI, alternative investments, and wealth management.
* Women in Finance: Creating pathways for women and girls to enter, thrive, and lead in the financial services industry.
* Community Empowerment: Partnering with NGOs, schools, and government bodies to deliver scalable, high\-impact social programs.



  




 Role Overview
 
 As the first employee of Equalifi Foundation, you will be the architect and engine of our social impact strategy. You will design, launch, and scale programs that align with our mission while building partnerships with CSR donors, implementation NGOs, and government stakeholders.
 



  





 This is a high\-ownership, high\-visibility role reporting directly to the Founder/Board of Equalifi Foundation. You will have the unique opportunity to build the foundation’s operations from the ground up and shape its impact narrative for years to come.
 



  




 Key Responsibilities1\. Program Design \& Implementation
 * Design and launch flagship programs in financial literacy, skill building, and women’s empowerment (e.g., school modules, certification scholarships, rural workshops).
* Develop curriculum frameworks, training materials, and impact measurement tools in collaboration with Equalifi’s content team.
* Pilot programs in 3–5 cities in Year 1, with a roadmap to scale to 20\+ cities by Year 3\.
* Ensure programs are cost\-effective, scalable, and aligned with SDGs (Sustainable Development Goals) and BRSR (Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report) frameworks.


 2\. Fundraising \& CSR Partnerships
 * Identify and pitch to corporate CSR committees (BFSI, fintech, tech sectors) for funding and strategic partnerships.
* Draft concept notes, proposals, and impact reports for potential donors (e.g., KFin, BSE, NSE, mutual fund houses).
* Negotiate MOUs and partnership agreements with CSR donors, ensuring alignment on objectives, budgets, and reporting.
* Explore grant opportunities from foundations (e.g., Azim Premji, Tata Trusts) and government schemes (e.g., PMKVY, NSDC).


 3\. Implementation Partnerships
 * Identify and onboard NGOs, schools, colleges, and skill development partners for program delivery.
* Conduct due diligence on partners (financial, operational, compliance) and manage ongoing relationships.
* Coordinate training sessions, workshops, and certification drives across multiple geographies.
* Ensure quality control and adherence to program standards across all implementation sites.


 4\. Impact Measurement \& Reporting
 * Design monitoring \& evaluation (M\&E) frameworks to track program outcomes (e.g., financial literacy scores, job placements, women enrolled).
* Collect and analyze data from field teams, partners, and beneficiaries.
* Prepare quarterly and annual impact reports for donors, board members, and public disclosures.
* Document case studies, testimonials, and success stories for marketing and fundraising.



  




 Qualifications \& Skills
 
  




 Education
 * Bachelor’s degree required (any discipline).
* Master’s degree or PG Diploma in Social Work, Development Studies, Public Policy, or CSR Management (preferred).
* Certifications in Impact Measurement, CSR, or Project Management (e.g., PMD, PRINCE2\) are a plus.



  




 Experience
 * 2–7 years of experience in CSR, social impact, development sector, or foundation management.
* Prior experience in financial literacy, financial inclusion, or skill development programs is highly preferred.
* Experience working with corporate CSR teams, NGOs, or government bodies is essential.
* Track record of designing and launching programs from scratch (startup mindset required).



  




 Skills \& Competencies
 * Program Management: Ability to manage multiple projects across geographies with limited resources.
* Stakeholder Management: Strong communication and negotiation skills for interacting with CSR heads, NGO partners, and government officials.
* Data \& Impact: Comfortable with data collection, analysis, and creating impact dashboards/reports.
* Fundraising: Experience writing concept notes, proposals, and pitching to donors.
* Tech\-Savvy: Proficient in MS Office, Google Workspace, and CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, Ketto, Milaap).
* Travel: Willingness to travel 25–30% of the time to project sites (Tier 2/3 cities, rural areas).



  




 Personal Attributes
 * Mission\-Driven: Passionate about financial inclusion and social impact.
* Self\-Starter: Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision (first hire).
* Problem\-Solver: Resourceful and creative in overcoming operational challenges.
* Empathetic: Ability to connect with beneficiaries from diverse socio\-economic backgrounds.
* Detail\-Oriented: Strong organizational skills for managing budgets, timelines, and compliance.



  




 What We Offer
 * Founding Team Opportunity: Be the first employee and shape the foundation’s strategy, culture, and impact.
* Competitive Compensation: Industry\-aligned salary \+ performance bonuses.
* Growth Path: Fast\-track career growth (e.g., promotion to Head of Foundation within 2–3 years based on performance).
* Learning \& Development: Access to Equalifi’s certifications, events, and network of BFSI leaders.
* Flexibility: Hybrid work model (Mumbai office \+ field travel).
* Purpose: The chance to directly impact 10,000\+ lives in Year 1 and 100,000\+ by Year 3\.



  




 How to Apply
 
 Please mail your resume to foundation@equalifi.org

title: Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering - India
description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth\-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.
   

  

****About The Role****
 We're building a Forward Deployed Engineering team to close the gap between the value our enterprise customers expect from Cursor and the value they're actually getting. FDEs don't advise, they embed directly with customer engineering teams, build production\-grade Cursor workflows, and transfer the habits and culture that compound long after the engagement ends. The measure of success is what's different at day 30, not what got shipped.
   

  

 We're looking for a Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering to lead and help scale this team. You'll manage a growing team of FDEs working across our most strategic enterprise accounts, own what makes a world\-class FDE engagement, and stay close enough to the work to escalate, coach, and course\-correct in real time. You will serve as the primary point of contact for customers, owning both project delivery and the day\-to\-day relationship, while also identifying and scoping new opportunities. You'll also build our partner FDE track — training and enabling GSI and consulting partners who extend this motion at scale.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on leadership role for someone who combines deep technical credibility, strong people management, and the judgment to keep engagements scoped tight, delivered fast, and worth repeating. This role will be based in all 3 cities: Bengaluru, Mumbai and New Delhi.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

* Sell
+ Own the full arc from technical discovery to executive close — partnering with Sales and Account teams to qualify opportunities, leading architecture reviews, surfacing integration complexity and infrastructure constraints, and scoping engagements with enough precision to de\-risk delivery before a line of code is written
+ Build and present proposals that translate ambiguous customer problems into concrete, time\-boxed deliverables with clear ROI
+ Sell the vision and the plan to C\-suite stakeholders who need to believe in both the outcome and the team delivering it
+ Drive deal strategy on strategic accounts; your technical credibility is a direct lever on close rates for six\- and seven\-figure engagements


**Deliver**
* Serve as executive technical sponsor on your region's highest\-priority engagements and manage stakeholder relationships from IC engineers to C\-suite
* Ensure delivery quality across your team's projects: appropriate scoping, milestone tracking, technical standards, and clean handoffs to customer engineering teamsTranslate between business outcomes and technical implementation in both directions
* Identify and escalate product gaps, integration friction, and recurring customer pain back to Product and Engineering with enough specificity to drive roadmap decisions
* Manage active engagements: escalate on complex builds, coach FDEs on scoping and delivery decisions, and step in directly on accounts where the stakes are highest
* Build reusable playbooks that make the broader FDE org more capable over time


**Manage People**
* Lead, develop, and scale a team of 6–8 Forward Deployed Engineers working strategic FDE projects
* Hire top\-tier FDE talent; set clear expectations, technical performance standards, and career growth paths for a team where "excellent" means actually shipping in production
* Coach FDEs through the hardest problems in the field — scoping under deal pressure, building alongside senior technical stakeholders, and knowing when to protect scope vs. when to flex
* Build and scale the partner FDE track — train, enable, and hold the quality bar for GSI and consulting partners who carry the FDE motion forward at volume


 You may be a fit if
   

  

* You have 8\+ years of experience leading technical teams that build and ship in production — Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a similar function where writing and reviewing code is part of the job
* You have experience with software development and coding in Python, Javascript/Typescript
* You’ve built and owned AI\-native workflows in production, not just prototypes, and have debugged real\-world model failures
* You can diagnose a complex enterprise engineering environment quickly, identify the highest\-leverage intervention, and scope a meaningful engagement
* You've built and scaled IC\-level technical teams and know what excellence looks like in the field: sharp scoping, clean delivery, and knowledge that stays at the customer long after the engagement closes

description:
Job description:
   

  

 Customer Service Professional India (Mumbai) \- Industrial Projects
 
 Join CEVA India in our dynamic Project Logistics
 
 Operations department based at Mumbai, as a Customer Service Professional dedicated to Industrial Projects. This role is pivotal in ensuring seamless execution and management of project logistics, supporting our clients with efficient, reliable, and proactive services within the logistics industry.
 


 Role Overview
 
 As a Customer Service Professional, you will play a critical role in managing and coordinating end\-to\-end logistics operations for complex industrial projects, focusing on comprehensive door\-to\-door shipment execution. Your expertise will directly enhance the client experience through meticulous planning, execution, and communication across all shipment stages.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 * **Project Logistics Management:** 
 Oversee project logistics operations, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and efficiency in shipment planning and execution.
* **Shipment Coordination:** 
 Manage sea freight and airfreight shipments, possessing in\-depth knowledge of the complete shipment lifecycle including booking, transportation, and delivery.
* **OOG (Out Of Gauge) Operations:**

* **Packing List Analysis:**

* **Stakeholder Engagement:**

* **Global Business Execution:** 
 Manage door\-to\-door shipments globally, maintaining real\-time Daily Shipment Reports (DSR) and sharing status updates promptly with clients and network offices.
* **Financial Administration:** 
 Ensure timely booking of vendor invoices related to sea freight, airfreight, and transportation services. Facilitate prompt and accurate invoicing to clients and network offices post shipment execution.
* **Continuous Improvement and Compliance:** 
 Assist in developing and improving internal processes to enhance service delivery while ensuring compliance with relevant industry standards and company policies.


 Candidate Profile
 
 The ideal candidate will be proactive, detail\-oriented, and skilled at multitasking within a fast\-paced logistics environment. Collaboration skills are essential to coordinate between customers, vendors, and internal teams effectively. Strong organisational abilities and a commitment to meeting deadlines will be crucial for success in this role.
 


 What We Offer
 
 CEVA  fosters a supportive and inclusive work culture where all team members are valued. Employees receive opportunities for professional development within a global logistics leader, with the ability to gain expertise in project logistics and build a rewarding career in the industrial projects sector.

title: Open Secret - Senior Manager Supply Chain
description:
**About Us:** 




  






 Open Secret is a fast\-growing, innovation\-driven food \& beverage brand making snacks for new India. We are on a mission to transform the way India snacks by creating a range of "unjunked" food options that are delicious, healthier, and guilt\-free. We blend food science, great taste, and transparency to create better\-for\-you products families love.
 




  






 Our Founder and CEO, Ahana Gautam, is a graduate from IIT Bombay and Harvard Business School, and has a strong FMCG background \- Procter \& Gamble and General Mills.
 




  






 We are backed by a stellar group of investors \- including Matrix, Sixth Sense, Ananta Capital, Vijay Shekhar Sharma, and other prominent leaders.
 




  






 Join us in the Unjunked Revolution.
 




  





**Location:** 

 Bhandup \- Mumbai (in office)
 




  





**Experience Level:** 

 3 \- 4 years
 




  





**About the Role:** 




  






 As a Manager (Supply Chain) at Open Secret, you will be at the heart of our logistics and distribution strategy. We currently fulfil all orders from our Mumbai warehouse, and this role will own two critical mandates: (1\) build and scale a multi\-city warehouse and last mile network across India, and (2\) improve the current supply chain performance. You will be the link between demand signals, inventory planning, and on\-ground logistics execution.
 




  






 You will report to the Head of Operations and also work closely with founder and senior leadership from day one, owning metrics that directly drive revenue on India's top e\-commerce and quick\-commerce platforms \- Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, FK, Amazon, etc.
 




  






 This is not just another desk job! If you enjoy getting your hands dirty with data, vendors, and real operational challenges \- this will be fun.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  






 \- Own end\-to\-end PO lifecycle: Supply planning, PO creation, GRN tracking, and fill\-rate analysis across channels.
 




  






 \- Drive warehouse network expansion: Analyse city\-level sales and inventory data to identify and stand up new fulfilment nodes beyond Mumbai.
 




  






 \- Build and manage a last\-mile vendor ecosystem: Onboard 3PL partners, define delivery SLAs, and track TAT performance rigorously.
 




  






 \- Monitor On\-Shelf Availability (OSA) daily across all SKUs and cities; diagnose availability drops and trigger replenishment actions proactively.
 




  






 \- Build inventory health dashboards tracking Days of Inventory (DOI), frontend/backend stock levels, Daily Run Rate (DRR) trends, and expiry risk.
 




  






 \- Collaborate with sales and demand planning teams to align PO scheduling with platform promotional calendars.
 




  






 \- Root\-cause fulfilment gaps: Analyse deficit quantities, diagnose PO state failures, and drive on\-time delivery improvements with vendors.
 




  






 \- Set up SOPs for new warehouse nodes covering inbound, storage, and dispatch protocols.
 




  






 \- Take ownership of evolving supply chain priorities, demonstrating agility and adaptability in addressing new or ambiguous challenges with speed and impact.
 




  





**Key Metrics You Will Own:** 




  






 \- OSA (On\-Shelf Availability): Weighted % of SKUs in\-stock across dark stores; directly drives offtake and platform ranking.
 




  






 \- PO Fill Rate: Units delivered (GRN) vs. units ordered; reflects fulfilment accuracy and reliability.
 




  






 \- Lead Time: Days from PO creation to GRN; impacts replenishment cadence and stock\-out risk.
 




  






 \- DOI (Days of Inventory): Determines reorder frequency and working capital.
 




  






 \- Fulfilment Gap: Delta between ordered and received quantity, by city and SKU.
 




  






 \- Inventory Value: Working capital tied up in front\-end and back\-end inventory across the warehouse network.
 




  





**Qualifications:** 




  






 \- Bachelor's in engineering or related field from a tier\-1 institution \- IIT or BITS.
 




  






 \- 3 \- 4 years of total work experience.
 




  






 \- Prior stints at companies such as Delhivery, Ecom Express, Dunzo, Shadowfax, Loadshare, Porter, or similar q\-commerce / last\-mile / logistics\-tech startups.
 




  






 \- High proficiency in MS Office/Google Suite (especially Excel).
 




  






 \- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare concise documents.
 




  






 \- Fast learner, detail\-oriented, and excited to work in a high\-growth, dynamic startup.
 




  






 \- Positive attitude, strong sense of ownership, and willingness to go beyond the job description as needed.
 




  





**What's in It for You?:** 




  






 \- Greenfield mandate \- you design and build the supply chain network from scratch, not maintain someone else's legacy system.
 




  






 \- Direct exposure to q\-commerce operations at scale across India's top platforms.
 




  






 \- Exposure to business strategy and decision\-making at top leadership level.
 




  






 \- Chance to work across diverse functions and fast\-track your learning.
 




  






 \- Direct mentorship from founders and senior leaders.
 




  






 \- Accelerated growth opportunities in a growing F\&B startup.

**Role Overview** 




  





 We are looking for an execution oriented
 **Assistant Manager – Administration \& Facilities** 
 to independently manage Mumbai \& PAN India office administration and facilities operations, while also supporting the Director’s Office and residence related requirements.
 



  





**This is a dual scope role requiring strong experience in:** 




  




* Office administration and facilities management
* Vendor, procurement, and budget management
* Team supervision and process improvement
* Director’s residence, fleet, travel, and personal administrative support



  





**Both aspects of the role are essential. Candidates with only corporate administration experience or only EA/PA experience will not be suitable.** 




  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





**Administration \& Facilities Management** 



* Manage office operations, including housekeeping, security, maintenance, pantry, stationery, parking, access control, and workplace readiness.
* Monitor preventive maintenance for HVAC, DG, lifts, fire systems, electrical, plumbing, UPS, CCTV, water purifiers, and related systems.
* Manage snag resolution:
* Critical issues: closure within 24 hours
* Noncritical issues: closure within 72 hours
* Manage the complete AMC lifecycle, including vendor selection, contracts, service tracking, renewals, and performance reviews.
* Coordinate office moves, seating changes, space planning, refurbishment, and construction related requirements.
* Ensure all office areas remain operational, professionally maintained, and audit compliant.



  





**Vendor and Procurement Management** 



* Manage vendor identification, evaluation, onboarding, negotiation, performance monitoring, and exit processes.
* Obtain a minimum of three quotations for relevant purchases and prepare comparison sheets with recommendations.

* Prepare monthly vendor scorecards and initiate corrective action when required.
* Ensure contracts are renewed at least 30 days before expiry.
* Track invoices, coordinate with Finance, and resolve vendor payment queries within defined timelines.



  





**Budget and Cost Management** 



* Maintain the administration budget tracker and monitor monthly expenditure against the approved budget.
* Maintain budget variance within ±5%.
* Process accurate and timely expense entries in Farvision or a similar ERP.
* Maintain at least 98% expense booking accuracy and complete month end closure.
* Review quotations, benchmark prices, negotiate commercial terms, and identify cost saving opportunities.
* Prepare reports on location wise expenses, vendor rate trends, and savings initiatives.



  





**Team and Stakeholder Management** 



* Supervise the Mumbai administration, front desk, and support teams.
* Allocate responsibilities, manage priorities, ensure coverage, and review team performance.
* Conduct weekly team meetings and monthly performance reviews.
* Coordinate with HR, Finance, IT, Procurement, Security, and business teams.
* Manage the administration helpdesk, including ticket logging, assignment, escalation, SLA tracking, and closure.



  





**Process Improvement, Compliance and Reporting** 



* Develop and improve administration SOPs.
* Identify process gaps, document corrective actions, and train team members.
* Maintain the following records:
* Snag register
* Vendor scorecards
* AMC tracker
* Expense tracker
* Asset register
* Compliance calendar
* Helpdesk tracker
* Identify recurring issues and implement preventive measures.
* Submit weekly and monthly MIS reports on time.
* Ensure monthly FAR reconciliation and zero audit findings.



  





**Director’s Office, Residence and Personal Support** 



* Provide discreet and reliable administrative support to the Director’s Office.
* Manage calendar requirements, meeting logistics, and administrative coordination.
* Arrange domestic and international travel, accommodation, transportation, and related logistics.
* Coordinate visitor management for Directors, board members, senior stakeholders, and important meetings.
* Support the Director’s residence, fleet, household, and personal administrative requirements as needed.
* Liaise with HR, Finance, IT, Legal, vendors, drivers, household staff, and other stakeholders.
* Handle confidential and urgent matters with complete discretion.
* Anticipate time sensitive requirements and execute them within committed timelines.



  





**Required Qualifications and Experience** 



* Graduate degree is mandatory.
* Postgraduate qualification in Management, Facilities, or a related field is preferred.
* 7–10 years of progressive experience in administration, facilities management, workplace operations, or a related function.
* Experience independently managing office operations at a site or location level.
* Experience managing and supervising a team of at least three members.
* Strong experience in vendor management, contract negotiation, SLA enforcement, compliance audits, and vendor lifecycle management.
* Proficiency in MS Excel or Google Sheets, including pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, dashboards, and data driven reporting.
* Working knowledge of ERP or expense management systems such as Farvision, SAP, Tally, or similar platforms.
* Experience supporting senior leadership, executives, or a Director’s Office.

As a Project Coordinator at DSC INTERIOR PRIVATE LIMITED, you will play a crucial role in overseeing and managing various interior projects from conception to completion. Your expertise in project management, interior design, MS Excel, MS Office, vendor management, client relationships, document management, scheduling, and effective communication will be essential in ensuring the success of each project.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with internal teams and external stakeholders to develop project timelines and budgets.
* Manage vendor relationships and ensure timely delivery of materials and services.
* Act as the primary point of contact for clients, providing regular updates and addressing any concerns.
* Maintain accurate documentation of project progress, expenses, and client feedback.
* Create and maintain project schedules, ensuring milestones are met on time and within budget.
* Communicate effectively with all project stakeholders, including clients, vendors, and team members.
* Ensure that all projects are delivered to the highest quality standards and meet client expectations.


 If you are a detail\-oriented and organized professional with a passion for interior design and project management, we want to hear from you. Join our dynamic team and help us bring our clients' vision to life through innovative and successful interior projects.
   

  

 About Company: Company Description \- DSC Interiors Pvt. Ltd. brings over 30 years of experience to end\-to\-end interior design and turnkey project solutions across diverse industries. The company is known for customized design, strong project management, and meticulous craftsmanship that align with client requirements and timelines. A client\-centric approach emphasizes transparent communication, collaboration, and responsiveness at every project stage. With a focus on sustainable practices and innovative design, DSC Interiors aims to consistently exceed expectations and deliver high\-quality results. The organization also shares updates on projects, industry trends, and career opportunities through its LinkedIn presence.

title: Operations Excellence Lead
description:
To enable the successful transformation of the business through deployment of operational excellence strategy, by building right capabilities, embedding performance management routines, solving challenges using right tools and ensuring sustainable continuous improvement across business, while acting as a trusted coach and change agent for leaders and teams.
   

  

 Maersk is a global leader in integrated logistics and have been industry pioneers for over a century. Through innovation and transformation we are redefining the boundaries of possibility, continuously setting new standards for efficiency, sustainability, and excellence.
   

  

 At Maersk, we believe in the power of diversity, collaboration, and continuous learning and we work hard to ensure that the people in our organisation reflect and understand the customers we exist to serve.
   

  

 With over 100,000 employees across 130 countries, we work together to shape the future of global trade and logistics.
   

  

 Join us as we harness cutting\-edge technologies and unlock opportunities on a global scale. Together, let's sail towards a brighter, more sustainable future with Maersk.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

* Drive deployment, adoption, and governance of Operational Excellence (OpEx) tools and methodologies, including Visual Management, SQC, A3 Problem Solving, Kaizen, and Action Plans across the assigned business scope.
* Lead the implementation, localization, and governance of the Operating System, ensuring effective adoption of visual management and performance management routines while maintaining alignment with global standards.
* Coach leaders and frontline teams on OpEx principles, standard work, leadership routines, and performance management practices to reinforce operational discipline and continuous improvement behaviors.
* Program manage improvement initiatives to ensure actions are delivered, benefits are realized, and improvements are sustained over time, while providing visibility and governance of progress.
* Identify Operational Excellence capability gaps and develop targeted interventions to build skills, strengthen competencies, and improve organizational maturity in continuous improvement practices.
* Partner with business leaders and cross\-functional stakeholders to embed a culture of Operational Excellence, accountability, structured problem solving, and data\-driven decision making.
* Monitor adoption, compliance, and effectiveness of OpEx tools, routines, and governance mechanisms, recommending and implementing corrective actions where required.
* Leverage technology, automation, analytics, and digital tools to enhance Operational Excellence deployment, simplify ways of working, and improve business performance outcomes.


 Primary Internal Stakeholders:
   

  

* Product Head of Maersk South Asia
* Product, Sales and Execution teams
* Global and Regional OpEx community


**Experience \& Skills**
* 8\+ years of experience in Operations, Continuous Improvement, Operational Excellence, Lean in industries related to Supply Chain, Logistics, Manufacturing, or related disciplines.
* Proven experience in deploying and sustaining Operational Excellence frameworks and performance management systems.
* Experience facilitating improvement initiatives, problem\-solving workshops, and cross\-functional projects.
* Experience coaching leaders and frontline teams in structured improvement methodologies.
* Exposure to logistics, warehousing, transportation, or integrated supply chain operations is preferred.


**Certifications (Preferred)**
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt.
* Lean Practitioner or Continuous Improvement certification.
* Project Management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or equivalent) is an advantage.


 Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.
   

  

 We are happy to support your need for any adjustments during the application and hiring process. If you need special assistance or an accommodation to use our website, apply for a position, or to perform a job, please contact us by emailing accommodationrequests@maersk.com.

title: Human and Consumer Insights Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
 Looking for a role that challenges you while making an impact on products people use every day?
   

  

 IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and health \& biosciences, we deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products.
   

  

 Scent: Harnessing the full emotional power of scent, driven by pioneering creativity, science, consumer expertise and a mindful approach to fragrance design.
   

  

 The role is based in Mumbai, India (Hybrid role). Be part of a motivated, passionate, and open\-minded team where together we can achieve greatness and make a real impact. Your potential is our inspiration.
   

  

**Where You’ll Make a Difference**
* Lead Consumer Research Design by defining the approach to deliver against learning needs or customer validation requirements in collaboration with Commercial and Scent Design teams.
* Proficiently handle in\-depth Statistical Analysis of data (using SPSS / XLSTAT / Internal IFF analysis tools), and manage fieldwork logistics, database management and generation of study results.
* Synthesize research findings into actionable insights and provide recommendations within agreed timelines for creative design next steps and potential customer opportunities.
* Present as well as develop materials incorporating study findings / insights / recommendations for internal team debriefs and customer meetings, workshops or events.
* Engage and liaise with external research agencies for study proposals, negotiation, project briefing, fieldwork \& data quality and project deliverables.
* Interact with consumers on field to understand product \& fragrance feedback and / or category expectations.
* Support / Collaborate with the regional and global CI teams to execute projects in India, Bangladesh and Sri Lanka.
* Support the regional CI team, as and when required, on projects outside of the Indian subcontinent.


**What Makes You The Right Fit**
* Master’s or Bachelor’s Degree in Market Research, Business, Statistics, Psychology, Behavioral Sciences or any other relevant discipline.
* Minimum 10 \- 12 years of 360 project management / work experience in market research at the agency or the client side, preferably in the Fragrance or FMCG sector.
* Experience in a broad range of consumer research techniques with strong working experience in Market Research operations and fragrance and / or product testing research.
* Track record in leading research design \& methodology, executing and reporting for consumer/product research projects.
* Ability to think beyond traditional testing methods; passionate in finding creative ways to test and connect with consumers.
* Expertise in Quantitative research design, methodology and data analysis.
* Well versed with statistical treatment of data with strong analytical software skills (SPSS / JMP / XLSTAT).
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Willing to travel within and outside the Indian subcontinent as needed.


**How Would You Stand Out?**
* Knowledge of Qualitative research will be a bonus.
* Knowledge of fragrance consumer research will be a plus.
* Team player with excellent communication \& presentation skills, with the ability to translate research data into actionable insights for the business.
* Proficient in MS Office applications especially PowerPoint, Excel and Word.


**Why Choose Us?**
* Multinational and supporting environment
* Health insurance
* Training opportunities
* Learning and development programs


 We are a global leader in taste, scent, and nutrition, offering our customers a broader range of natural solutions and accelerating our growth strategy. At IFF, we believe that your uniqueness unleashes our potential. We value the diverse mosaic of the ethnicity, national origin, race, age, sex, or veteran status. We strive for an inclusive workplace that allows each of our colleagues to bring their authentic self to work regardless of their religion, gender identity \& expression, sexual orientation, or disability.

title: Associate Technical Director - Structures (USA)
description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.
   

  

 We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.
   

  

**Role description:**
**Associate Technical Director – Structures**
 We are seeking to recruit an Associate Technical Director for our growing team in India to work alongside our United States (US) counterparts for the technical delivery of structural designs for Transportation projects. The individual shall be conversant with US standards such as those of the American Association of State Highway and Transportation Officials (AASHTO) and multiple state Department of Transportation (DOT) regulations with expertise in the Design\-Build Environment. It is desirable that the candidate hold a Professional Engineer (PE) license in the US, preferably from the states of Georgia, Florida, and/or Tennessee.
   

  

**Role Accountabilities:**
 The role involves managing and supporting the pursuit of business opportunities and the successful execution of projects within the organization. The ideal candidate will have a combination of technical competencies; exposure to US Mobility (Transportation) projects; strategic thinking, people management, and project management skills; and a deep understanding of the project delivery process. The candidate must manage existing teams and is expected to be involved in developing the teams in terms of competency and capacity to cater to the increased demand from the US. The candidate in this role is expected to achieve all expectations of project delivery in terms of quality, schedule, budget, and value addition.
   

  

**Project Pursuit and Delivery:**
* Work with a multi\-disciplinary pursuit team to develop winning bids for projects
* Manage and deliver single and multi\-disciplinary projects, including Design\-Build projects, using US design codes and software packages
* Deliver concept designs, alternative technical concepts, detailed design, and construction phase support on Design\-Build and other projects, including meeting requirements for structural design, Building Information Modelling (BIM), computer\-aided design (CAD), and quantity estimation
* Identify and implement opportunities to incorporate standardization and automation into the design process to improve efficiency and quality of design
* Deliver projects as per business norms in terms of schedule, budget, and quality
* Ensure effective communication and coordination among all team members
* Oversee competency and quality through a robust Quality Management System, and ensure the timely submission of deliverables


**Resource Acquisition Support:**
* Identify resource needs for pursuits and projects, and contribute to strategic resource acquisition plans
* Coordinate with other departments or external partners to acquire resources


**Team Mentor:**
* Ensure development of the team according to market needs in terms of both capacity and capability, thereby setting growth targets
* Identify gaps and provide guidance for developing high competencies within the team for comprehensive project reviews, forecasting, and resource management
* Actively liaise with US offices, connect with US senior leadership, develop growth roadmaps, and drive continuous improvements within the team


**Qualifications \& Experience:**
* Master’s degree in Civil or Structural Engineering
* Minimum 12 years of experience on international multi\-disciplinary projects in Highway, Rail, Civil \& Structural, Metro, and Infrastructure domains
* Experience in a prior senior structural engineering role, with the ability to understand and evaluate the scope of US projects with minimum 10 years of working experience on international projects for highway/railway bridges in delivery various design and modelling tasks including design\-build projects.
* Proficiency in written communication and capability to create project communications
* Familiarity with AASHTO codes, multiple DOT regulations, US construction industry, and Arcadis' service offerings
* In\-depth knowledge of and experience with structural analysis tools such as MIDAS, SAP2000, LEAP Bridge Concrete, etc.
* Strong organizational, coordination, and strategic decision\-making skills
* Ability to collaborate with diverse disciplines and support resource acquisition
* Professional Engineer (PE) licensure in Georgia, Florida, and/or Tennessee is preferred, or the candidate should be able to obtain it within a short timeframe.
* Be able to serve as a role model for Arcadis Values and Principles, especially Health \& Safety stewardship
* Knowledge of Quality Management Systems and the ability to apply Quality Management principles while delivering large\-scale US projects from the Global Excellence Centres (GECs)


**Why Arcadis?**
 We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills\-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.
   

  

 You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.
   

  

 Together, we can create a lasting legacy.
   

  

 Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy.
   

  

**Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion \& Belonging**
 We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day which is why equality and inclusion is at the forefront of all our activities. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. We are an equal opportunity employer; women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply. We are dedicated to a policy of non\-discrimination in employment on any basis including race, caste, creed, colour, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, and gender identity.

title: Continuous Improvement Senior Analyst
description:
**Purpose of the Role**
 The Continuous Improvement Senior Analyst plays a key role in driving operational excellence and best in class ways of working across global Finance Operations by investigating and understanding root cause, optimising and standardising end to end business processes increasing efficiency, reducing waste and improving end to end performance.
   

  

 The Continuous Improvement Senior Analyst role combines data driven analysis with continuous improvement problem solving methodology to identify opportunities, lead end to end process improvement initiatives as well as collaborating with technology teams driving system, automation and transformation change.
   

  

 The Continuous Improvement Senior Analyst is key in building a continuous improvement culture across the wider HH Global organisation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Analyze, map, and optimize end\-to\-end finance processes to identify inefficiencies, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, Kaizen, DMAIC methodologies.
* Use data analytics to evaluate process performance, identify trends, and provide actionable insights.
* Develop KPIs, dashboards, business cases, and benefits tracking to measure improvement outcomes.
* Facilitate workshops and collaborate with stakeholders, process owners, SMEs, and technology teams to drive transformational change.
* Support process transitions through process mapping, SOP development, training materials, and operational readiness assessments.
* Manage improvement projects from discovery through implementation, including planning, documentation, risk management, and stakeholder engagement.
* Coach, train, and mentor teams on Continuous Improvement tools and best practices to build organizational capability.
* Monitor adoption, compliance, and sustainability of process changes.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement by sharing best practices and influencing stakeholders across the organization.


**Overall Scope** 
 : Lead and support process transformation, operational excellence, and data\-driven improvement initiatives across Global Finance while fostering a culture of continuous improvement and delivering measurable business benefits.
   

  

**Knowledge, Skills \+ Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Analytics, or related field.
* Experience in Continuous Improvement, Operational Excellence, and process transformation.
* Certified in Lean Six Sigma (Green Belt minimally), Agile, or similar methodologies.
* Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Excel, Power BI, and data visualization tools.
* Experience in process mapping, documentation, and operational controls (Visio, Miro, Blueworks Live).
* Knowledge of automation technologies (RPA, workflow tools) and change management.
* Experience in process transitions and finance operations or transactional environments.
* Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, communication, and presentation skills.
* Ability to lead cross\-functional initiatives, influence without authority, and manage multiple priorities.
* Continuous improvement mindset with a customer\-focused, collaborative, and proactive approach.


**Ideal Profile** 
 : A Continuous Improvement/Operational Excellence professional with expertise in process improvement, analytics, stakeholder engagement, and change management within a finance operations environment.
   

  

**What Does Success Look Like**
 Continuous Improvement senior analyst will lead strategic CI initiatives delivering measurable operational improvement and financial benefits. Senior analyst will foster a culture of Continuous Improvement across the Finance organisation supporting colleagues with Lean and CI methodologies coaching and facilitating training sessions as well as collaborating with stakeholders across HH delivering standardised global processes ensuring consistent outcomes for internal and external customers.
   

  

**Deliverables**
* Deliver annualised benefits through CI initiatives.
* Lead strategic improvement projects annually.
* Reduce key process cycle times and improve quality and CSAT metrics
* Increase process standardisation and automation across Finance
* Achieve stakeholder satisfaction on improvement projects.
* Coach and support colleagues in Lean and CI methodologies.

title: Engineer Project Associate - Fire Suppression Products
description:
**Job Description**
* Determines project scope, develops a preliminary plan of investigation, and determines project specifications such as cost, time, and sample requirements by analyzing client input, available supplemental data, and product construction.
* Projects may include travel to conduct or witness tests at client sites. Initiates communication with clients to promote and explain the benefits of new and existing services.
* Follows up on contacts from clients.
* Communicates with clients to discuss technical issues, explain UL procedures and requirements, convey project cost, and negotiate completion date and sample requirements.
* Acts to address client concerns and to resolve client issues.
* Provides technical assistance to clients in reference to product inspection and follow\-up services.
* Establishes appropriate test programs by reviewing files and manufacturer's information, examining samples, and applying UL requirements.
* Is familiar with applicable standards, company manuals and appropriate technical literature.
* Examines samples for compliance with UL requirements and notifies client of any areas in which the product is not in compliance or of any changes in project scope or specifications.
* Coordinates laboratory activities by preparing data sheets and instructions to technicians, scheduling and reviewing work of laboratory technicians and engineering support staff and establishing completion dates.
* Coordinates administrative aspects of project management.
* Serves as Project Handler of record and may sign as Reviewer of record as assigned.
* Communicates project status and results to clients through frequent contact and by preparing reports.
* Prepares Follow\-Up Service Procedures and information pages.
* Integrates continuous improvement concepts and techniques into all aspects of the job.
* Resolves engineering issues associated with Variation Notices by analyzing and reporting on the acceptability of the variations.
* Assists in the development of UL requirements.
* Assists in developing special test methods and test equipment.
* Analyzes test program for adequacy and sequence.
* May coordinate and/or perform File Reviews, as directed.
* May represent UL at industry related functions such as seminars and trade shows.
* Read and follow the Underwriters Laboratories Code of Conduct and follow all physical and digital security practices.
* Performs other duties as directed.


**Responsibilities**
* Conduct testing, inspection, and certification activities for fire suppression products including foam concentrates/ extinguishing systems/pumps, and engines.
* Evaluate products for compliance with applicable national and international standards (e.g., UL, EN).
* Perform product assessments as per TIC requirements.
* Prepare detailed technical reports, test documentation, and certification findings.
* Support customers in understanding compliance requirements and certification processes.
* Coordinate with internal teams, laboratories, and external stakeholders to ensure timely project execution.
* Stay updated with evolving fire protection standards, regulations, and industry best practices.
* Ensure adherence to quality, safety, and operational procedures during all testing and inspection activities.
* Provide technical guidance and contribute to process improvements within the TIC function.


**Qualifications**
* 
+ Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Fire Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or related field.
+ Minimum 3 years of experience in fire suppression products, fire protection systems, or TIC (Testing, Inspection, Certification) industry.
+ Basic knowledge of fire suppression systems such as foam concentrates/ fire extinguishing systems/ pumps and engines.
+ Familiarity with fire protection standards and codes (UL, FM, NFPA, EN, ISO) is an advantage.
+ Basic understanding of testing, inspection, or quality assurance processes.
+ Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
+ Good written and verbal communication skills.
+ Proficiency in MS Office tools for documentation and reporting.
+ Willingness to travel for on\-site testing activities.
+ Ability to work in a team\-oriented environment with a focus on quality and safety.


**About Us**
 A global leader in applied safety science, UL Solutions (NYSE: ULS) transforms safety, security and sustainability challenges into opportunities for customers in more than 110 countries. UL Solutions delivers testing, inspection and certification services, together with software products and advisory offerings, that support our customers’ product innovation and business growth. The UL Mark serves as a recognized symbol of trust in our customers’ products and reflects an unwavering commitment to advancing our safety mission. We help our customers innovate, launch new products and services, navigate global markets and complex supply chains, and grow sustainably and responsibly into the future. Our science is your advantage.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our buildings don’t just shape our skylines — they provide the backdrop to our lives. And knowing they’re safe matters. We’ve been helping to create safer structures since 1894, combining our expertise with innovative new technologies to help make sure both people and property are secure. As more people have to deal with extreme weather, we’re on hand to test products and building materials to increasingly rigorous standards. Whether we’re simulating tornadoes or testing smoke alarms, the work we do on our team is used in buildings around the world to — quite literally — help save lives. Join our team and build your skills, build innovative solutions and help build a safer world.

title: Partnership Associate
description:
**Role Summary**
 Raise is built on this core philosophy \- we will bring exceptionally great products, awesome user
   

  

 experience and best in class customer service to our users. We have started with our first step by
   

  

 launching Investment \& Trading platform – Dhan (www.dhan.co)
   

  

 Upsurge.club offers simplified stock market, trading, and investing education, guided by top industry
   

  

 experts to gain confidence \& become a successful trader and investor.. Our goal is to instill a culture of

 passionate about Financial Services and especially the Edutech in India wherein you feel the clients and
   

  

 customers should get the best possible experience, then you are looking at the place where you should
   

  

 apply. This would require you to be excited about the business and work with all stakeholders to drive
   

  

 excellence.
   

  

 We are looking for a proactive and organized Partnerships Associate to support our growing client and
   

  

 content requirements. The role is central to keeping our B2B brand partnerships running smoothly —
   

  

 managing day\-to\-day coordination with clients, content timelines, and creative execution, while building
   

  

 strong, trust\-based relationships with the brands we work with.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Manage day\-to\-day coordination with B2B brands and clients on content and campaign requirements.
* Own content timelines end\-to\-end, and follow up proactively with agencies and editors to keep production on schedule.
* Coordinate creative requirements including thumbnails, videos, and ads, ensuring they meet brand and platform standards.
* Collect, consolidate, and relay feedback between clients and internal/creative teams.
* Conduct quality checks (QC) on content assets before delivery to ensure accuracy and brand fit.
* Drive overall project execution, flagging risks early and resolving bottlenecks quickly.
* Build and maintain strong, long\-term relationships with brand partners, developing a clear understanding of their requirements.
* Resolve client issues and escalations quickly, ensuring a smooth experience throughout the engagement.
* Ensure timely delivery of all content assets, maintaining high standards of quality and consistency.


**Requirements**
* Graduate in any finance background.
* 1–3 years of experience in Content Coordination, Client Servicing, or B2B Partnerships.
* Experience coordinating with clients, agencies, or editors on content or campaign delivery.
* Strong client relationship management, communication, and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in a fast\-paced environment.
* Basic understanding of finance and financial markets preferred.


**Location:** 
 Goregaon West, Mumbai (Preference will be given to candidates residing in Mumbai’s Western suburbs).
   

  

**Apply Now**
 If you believe in making great first impressions and enjoy being at the center of workplace energy, we’d love to hear from you.

 We’re a certified Great Place to Work, and it shows in everything we do \- from how we collaborate to how we celebrate wins. Our culture is built on growth, ownership, and mutual respect. At Raise, you’ll find a flat hierarchy, open conversations, and a team that values passion, humility, and speed over titles and bureaucracy.

* Are obsessed with customer satisfaction.
* Respect their work, teammates, and users.
* Value speed, humility, and thoughtful action.
* Prefer quality over quantity.
* Are hands\-on regardless of role or title.
* Embrace ownership, discipline, and an entrepreneurial spirit.
* Believe in less talk, more execution.
* Are passionate about the work they do.


**Raise is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive workplace.**
**About Raise Financial Services**
 We are building technology led financial products and infrastructure for India’s top 25Mn\+ financially aware and literate users. Our product lines span investments, financing, insurance, payments, and wealth services. We will offer consumer products \& services that cater to these users, and will offer the same technology \& infrastructure to partners in the startup ecosystem willing to take the experience to everyone in India. Our focus is on 3 core aspects \- build great products, deliver awesome experiences and provide exceptional customer services to our users.
