* Prior SAP BRIM CI role is a must
* Should have worked on minimum 1 implementation from scratch as a lead consultant.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience on integration with third\-party applications

* Hands on experience in SAP S4 HANA Platform

title: Senior Engineer - Water Supply Modelling WSPro.
description:
**Responsibilities**
* Leads the technical delivery of a water supply network planning and modelling. Carries out hydraulic calculations, analysis and investigations for clients using Infoworks WS Pro software for modelling projects and tasks, including preparation of reports, figures and other documents to a high level of grammatical and technical presentation.
* Carries out project works in accordance with our Integrated Management System (IMS). Work alongside project managers and junior team members to ensure efficient delivery. Delivers through teams, not individually.
* Demonstrates industry best practice for model build, calibration and system performance assessments, including leakage and demand analysis, pressure management and infrastructure / growth planning.
* Demonstrates how Infoworks WS Pro models can be used to support the development of zone management plans, water supply strategies and demand management plans.
* Uses Infoworks WS Pro in\-built tools to successfully investigate complex water network operational scenarios.
* Applies sound engineering judgement to resolve modelling anomalies to improve overall modelling confidence and communicates all risks and limitations on use of hydraulic models to the project team and the client.
* Works without supervision, direct others and ensures their work is verified by an appropriate professional.
* Leads continuous digital improvement and innovation on water hydraulic modelling and can identify and implement opportunities to streamline processes and data management.
* Successfully supports, coaches and mentors hydraulic modelling professionals to achieve a good standard of hydraulic modelling, embedding a culture of successful project delivery whilst also holding them to account, reducing re\-work and supporting the continuous growth of the WSP water modelling capability.
* Ensures project related quality processes are carried out (technical reviews, verification, approval to release etc.) in a timely and cost\-effectively manner.
* Undertakes appropriate verification of all inputs and outputs on hydraulic modelling projects including GIS, SCADA, field data and growth projections.
* Provides regular feedback to team members in a constructive and timely manner.
* Completes tasks within allocated timeframes and budgeted hours.
* Ensures all technical risks are understood, managed, assigned to the organisation best placed to manage the risk, and these are well communicated with the project team, and/or client
* Solves problems effectively by applying knowledge of hydraulics and engaging sound problem solving techniques and appropriate analysis to find value engineered/innovative solutions.
* Maintains knowledge of appropriate technical standards, legislation, codes of practice and New Zealand standards; Is knowledgeable on industry developments, trends, and processes.
* Applies sound judgement to decisions about technical issues and solves problems for clients to get the best possible outcome for a project.
* Undertakes appropriate verification of projects and team members’ work.
* Considering risks to client’s business or reputation as part of the planning and management of projects.
* Delivering excellent service to clients to promote repeat and uncompetitive work.
* Develops and maintains an extensive network of industry contacts in India and NZ (as a minimum) and is readily able to access key people.

**Team: Research \& Development**

**BUSINESS CONTEXT**
 Home Care Fabric Cleaning is a \~7 Bln Euro Business. Within that, Fabric Cleaning Powders is a \~4 Bln Euro business and continues to drive value creation through superior, sustainable, and affordable products enabled by differentiated technologies from Partner programs, bespoke technical, instrumental, and digital capabilities underpinned by strong consumer insights. Whilst the track record of the Value Creation program has been outstanding over the last several years, we need to ensure this program is “future fit” with a step\-up on these key enablers.
   

  

**ROLE**
 The incumbent will work closely with the Format Director, Technology Lead, and Home Care Digital partners to identify strategic workstreams for the “Future fit” Powders program (2\-3 years) and deliver them through our partnership (S\&T, Supplier and Digital). To do this, (S)he is expected to have a good understanding of technologies and the partnership ecosystem. A solid grounding in digital ways of working and application of digital tools to unlock speed and efficiency for the program is desired.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 The incumbent will deliver to the following key workstreams of the “future fit” Powders program.
   

  

* Digital: Define and drive clear Digital targets for the team (Data capture in LIMS, model adoption). Work closely with DRD partners to identify opportunities for impactful model creation and democratization.
* Technology Readiness: Drive implementation readiness of new technologies, working closely with the technology \& processing team and external supplier partners (as required).
* Technology Roadmap: Work closely with technology leads in GDC and S\&T to identify opportunities for the next wave of technology (including synergies from existing palette of technologies). Execute lead opportunities to drive step change in Ecodesign and Value extraction.
* Be the custodian of technology and partnership knowledge. Create and maintain a technology knowledge bank.


**Skills Needed For The Role**
 Education and Experience: Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering or Master's in Chemistry from a reputed institute. Experience in FMCG formulation design is preferred.
   

  

* Core Skills: Curiosity and willingness to learn and apply new Science \& Technology (including Digital) to the Powders program. Resilient to challenges and consistent focus on the goal.
* Digital Fluency: Ability to interpret complex datasets, data visualization (JMP/BI/Excel), and data\-driven decision\-making. Demonstrated skill in digital and modelling is preferred.

description:
**Job Location**
 MUMBAI GENERAL OFFICE
   

  

**Job Description**
 P\&G was founded over 180 years ago as a simple soap and candle company. Today, we're the world’s largest consumer goods company and home to iconic, trusted brands that make life a little bit easier in small but meaningful ways. We've spanned three centuries thanks to three simple ideas: leadership, innovation and citizenship. The insight, innovation and passion of hardworking teams have helped us grow into a global company that is governed responsibly and ethically, that is open and visible, and that supports good causes and protects the environment. This is a place where you can be proud to work and do something that matters.
   

  

**Dedication from Us:** 
 You'll be at the core of breakthrough innovations, be given exciting assignments, lead initiatives, and take ownership and responsibility, in creative workspaces where new insights thrive. All the while, you'll receive outstanding training to help you become a leader in your field. It is not just about what you'll do, but how you'll feel: encouraged, valued, purposeful, challenged, heard, and inspired.
   

  

**What we Offer:** 
 Continuous mentorship – you will collaborate with peers and receive both formal training as well as day\-to\-day mentoring from your manager dynamic and encouraging work environment– employees are at the center, we value every individual and support initiative, promoting agility and work/life balance.
   

  

**Overview Of The Job**
 We are seeking a Packaging Product Research \& Innovation Leader to drive consumer\-centric packaging innovation. This role involves translating deep consumer insights into superior packaging solutions that meet technical, quality, sustainability, and business requirements. The leader will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams and external partners to identify, develop, and commercialize innovative packaging. This role will require extensive domestic and sometimes international travel.
   

  

**Your team**
 This role will work closely with cross\-functional teams including Product Research/Product Development (PR/PD), Brand, Analytics \& Insights (A\&I), Design, Engineering (P\&E), Supply, Manufacturing, Quality, Purchasing, and Supply Chain teams, as well as external suppliers.
   

  

**Responsibilities Of The Role**
 Develop and bring to life consumer\-centric packaging solutions including:
   

  

* Develop deep consumer understanding to identify unmet needs and opportunities for packaging innovation.
* Partner with PR/PD, Brand, A\&I, and Design teams to translate consumer insights into packaging requirements, design principles, and technical solutions.
* Lead packaging consumer learning plans, consumer testing, and evidence generation to support key business decisions.
* Drive packaging innovation from concept through commercialization, ensuring solutions are consumer\-centric, technically robust, manufacturable, and scalable.
* Build organizational capability by integrating consumer understanding into packaging development and innovation processes.
* Lead IMP projects and packaging technical learning plans from idea generation through qualification and commercialization.
* Identify and implement packaging savings opportunities while maintaining product quality and consumer experience.
* Collaborate closely with P\&E, Supply, Manufacturing, Quality, Purchasing, and Supply Chain teams to deliver business objectives.
* Identify and leverage supplier capabilities, external technologies, and emerging packaging trends to deliver consumer\-centric, new packaging technologies, materials, solutions and competitive advantage.
* Lead technical problem\-solving and drive resolution of packaging, quality, manufacturing, and supply challenges in collaboration with suppliers and multifunctional teams.


**Role Requirements**
* Technical Problem Solving \& Innovative Critical Thinking: Ability to guide technical project direction, critically analyze complex problems, and enable innovation to create new products, processes, or capabilities through packaging expertise.
* Strategic Leadership: Skill in developing and leading iterative learning plans, setting clear priorities for technical plans, and integrating diverse approaches like first\-principle modeling and resource planning.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Influence: Capability to build effective relationships, collaborate across disciplines, and leverage internal/external resources.
* Business Acumen \& Continuous Learning: Understanding of the business context, basic commercialization aspects, and a commitment to continuous learning on P\&G systems and procedural elements.
* Technical Documentation: Skill in thoroughly documenting learnings and insights.


**About Us**
 We produce globally recognized brands, and we grow the best business leaders in the industry. With a portfolio of trusted brands as diverse as ours, it is paramount our leaders are able to lead with courage the vast array of brands, categories and functions. We serve consumers around the world with one of the strongest portfolios of trusted, quality, leadership brands, including Always®, Ariel®, Gillette®, Head \& Shoulders®, Herbal Essences®, Oral\-B®, Pampers®, Pantene®, Tampax® and more. Our community includes operations in approximately 70 countries worldwide.
   

  

 Visit http://www.pg.com to know more.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate against individuals on the basis of race, color, gender, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, citizenship, disability, HIV/AIDS status, or any other legally protected factor

**Job Qualifications**

* Packaging Expertise: In\-depth knowledge of materials, packaging engineering, and translating consumer needs into superior packaging experiences.

title: Program Manager - RLP
description:
**PROGRAM MANAGER — RURAL LIVELIHOODS PROGRAMME**
 Job Title \- Program Manager — Rural Livelihoods Programme
   

  

 Office Location \-Mumbai (field\-based)
   

  

 Job Type \- Full\-Time
   

  

 Reports to \- Senior Rural Livelihood Lead
   

  

 Manages \- Block Coordinators (1\), Field Officers (5\), Divyang Mitras (5\)
   

  

 Salary \- ₹50,000 \- 60,000/month \+ travel allowance
   

  

**About The Project**
 Sol's ARC is a disability inclusion organisation with over 23 years of experience enabling Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) to access education, livelihoods and employment. We work with governments, donors and communities to create systemic, scalable and sustainable change.
   

  

 The Rural Livelihoods Programme (RLP) in Maharashtra is an initiative. The programme aims to strengthen the economic and social empowerment of Persons with Disabilities in rural Maharashtra — connecting 400 PwDs to identity documents, government schemes, SHGs, livelihood training and market linkages across demonstration districts.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Program Manager will serve as the operational backbone of the Maharashtra RLP and facilitate the government and donor interface, the Program Manager will drive field\-level implementation, ensuring that programme activities are delivered on time, to the expected quality, and with meaningful outcomes for PwDs.
   

  

 This is a senior field\-facing role requiring a balance of hands\-on implementation and programme management. The person will spend significant time in the field—observing, mentoring, coaching, verifying data, and resolving implementation challenges—alongside planning, reviewing progress, analysing data, and reporting to the senior team.
   

  

 The role will focus on supportive supervision to maintain the quality and efficiency of field implementation. This will include regular mentoring visits to oversee data collection, assess quality and timeliness, provide hands\-on coaching to field teams where required, and establish a consistent cadence of reviews and check\-ins with the senior team. The Program Manager will proactively identify and address emerging challenges, ensuring timely course correction and minimising avoidable escalations.
   

  

**What Will You Typically Do?**
* Field Delivery and Quality Assurance
* Oversee day\-to\-day programme delivery across demonstration blocks — ensuring Block Coordinators and Field Officers are meeting their weekly and monthly targets.
* Conduct regular field visits to verify data quality, observe field staff at work and provide hands\-on coaching and support.
* Ensure that PwD identification, SHG enrolment, government scheme linkages and livelihood initiation activities are progressing as planned.
* Identify implementation challenges and resolve them — escalating to the State Lead only when necessary.
* Team Management and Capacity Building
* Manage and guide 1 Block Coordinators and 5 Field Officers — conduct weekly team meetings and individual check\-ins.
* Train field staff on PMIS tools, SHG facilitation, household survey methodology, livelihood modules and entitlement documentation.
* Review field staff data submissions for accuracy and completeness — provide real\-time feedback and correction.
* Support Block Coordinators in managing their respective communities and resolving ground\-level challenges.
* Livelihood and SHG Programme Management
* Lead and support the implementation of all necessary skill training sessions to support livelihood activity across the programme area.These may include, but may not be limited to Entrepreneurship Development Program, farm and non\-farm livelihoods, SHG management, among others.
* Oversee SHG formation, monthly meeting facilitation and financial inclusion activities for PwDs.
* Coordinate disability access camps — working with government departments to bring schemes and services to communities.
* Support market linkage development — connecting PwD\-produced goods and services by establishing forward and backward linkages.
* Establishing convergence with livelihood support schemes from departments like NABARD, Agriculture etc to support livelihood activities of PWDs.
* Monitoring, Reporting and Documentation
* Ensure PMIS data is entered accurately and on time by the field team — conduct bi\-monthly data quality checks.
* Prepare weekly and monthly field progress reports for the State Lead.
* Maintain field documentation — SHG registers, livelihood tracking sheets, beneficiary consent forms and activity records.
* Support the M\&E Manager with baseline and endline data collection processes.
* Collate timely narrative and financial reports as per pre\-determined milestones.


**How Will Your Success Be Measured?**
**KPI** 
**Success Measure**
**Team performance** 
 Block Coordinators and Field Officers meet targets with quality
   

  

**Data quality** 
 PMIS data complete, accurate and submitted on time; bi\-monthly quality checks pass
   

  

**Quality assured Programme delivery** 
 All key activities implemented as per applicable SoPs and Checklists.PwD identification, SHG enrolment and livelihood initiation on track against quarterly targets
   

  

**Livelihood outcomes** 
 Minimum 240 PwDs initiating income\-generating livelihoods by Year 3
   

  

**Reporting** 
 Weekly and monthly field reports submitted to State Lead on time
   

  

**SHG functioning** 
 SHGs active, meeting regularly, PwDs attending and contributing
   

  

**Who Are We Looking For?**
* Has 4–6 years of experience in rural livelihoods, SHG\-based programmes or community development — with at least 2 years in a supervisory or team management role.
* Has experience working with government livelihood systems — MSRLM, NRLM or similar — at the block or district level.
* Is comfortable managing a field team across multiple villages and communities.
* Can use PMIS/MIS systems for data entry, tracking and reporting.
* Communicates clearly in Marathi and Hindi; comfortable reporting in english.
* Believes that Persons with Disabilities have the right to participate, earn and make their own choices.
* Is willing to travel regularly across project blocks and districts in Maharashtra.

title: Clinical Trial Manager I - SCP
description:
**Description**
 Clinical Trial Manager I \- SCP
   

  

 Syneos Health® is a leading fully\-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.
   

  

 Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.
   

  

 Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full\-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.
   

  

 Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
   

  

 Why Syneos Health
   

  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.


**Job Responsibilities**
* 7\+ years of onsite clinical monitoring experience
* Good experience of Site selection, site initiation, and site activation
* Client Office based opportunity in Mumbai
* Should be able to act as the primary point of contact for sites
* Strong oncology experience is mandatory
* Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management activities and close\-out visits (performed on\-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH\-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiologic Practices (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site\-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and with guidance develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.
* Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
* For the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP): Assesses site processes, conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records, verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete, applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines, utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical project data review and capture, verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements
* May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
* Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations
* Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow\-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.
* For assigned activities, understands project scope, budgets, and timelines; manages site\-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt, with the oversight of the Lead CRA, to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets.
* May act as primary liaison with project site personnel, or in collaboration with another CRA or Central Monitoring Associate (CMA). Ensures all assigned sites and project\-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements.
* Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
* Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow\-up actions.
* For Real World Late Phase, the CRA I will use the business card title of Site Management Associate I. Additional responsibilities include: Site support throughout the study lifecycle from site identification through close\-out Knowledge of local requirements for real world late phase study designs Chart Abstraction activities and data collection Collaboration with Sponsor affiliates, medical science liaisons and local country staff.


**Get to know Syneos Health**
 Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.
   

  

 No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever\-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.
   

  

 http://www.syneoshealth.com
   

  

**Additional Information**
 Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.
   

  

**Summary**
 Roles within the Clinical Trial Management job family are responsible for overseeing the development, coordination, and implementation of Phase 1 clinical research studies at the organization's facilities. Individuals in these roles collaborate closely with the principal investigator, serve as liaisons between research subjects, client teams, investigators, and clinic operations teams, and meticulously plan logistics and resource usage. These roles require tracking study progress in alignment with project milestones, client deliverables, and budget, while ensuring compliance with applicable regulations globally and by region. May direct the work of lower level professionals or manage processes and programs. The majority of time is spent contributing to the design, implementation or delivery of processes, programs, and policies, using knowledge and skills typically acquired through advanced education. Individual contributor with developing subject matter expertise and responsibility for processes. In\-depth knowledge and skills within a professional discipline, understanding the impact of work on related areas. May be responsible for entire projects or processes within area of responsibility.

title: Principal Project Planner
description:
**About Us**
 Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
   

  

**The Role**
***As a Principal Project Planner with Worley,***
 you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
   

  

* Responsible to lead the team of Planning engineers for Construction planning, scheduling, monitoring, and control of the project.
* Assign/distribute works/work areas to the planning engineers and ensure that.
* Level III Construction Programme for the project is developed.
* Level III Programme is reviewed and modified, as appropriate.
* Level IV schedule for critical areas of the project/critical phase of construction are developed, as may be required.
* Prepare the WBS for construction and the S curves for progress monitoring/Review the WBS structure and the S Curves, in case available, and make modifications as appropriate along with the Planning Engineers.
* Discuss with Customer and finalize the progress reporting formats, in line with the standard formats.
* Review the tender/contract documents to understand the requirements of construction planning and rogress reporting to be fulfilled by the contractors.
* Collaborate with the planning engineers/discipline engineers towards review of the construction programme and resource deployment schedule submitted by the contractors. Consolidate and furnish comments on the submission from the contractors.
* Collaborate with the planning engineers/discipline engineers and the Construction Manager/Resident Construction Manager for approval of the contractor’s schedule and resource deployment plan.


**Additional Responsibilities**
* Align with the contractors for progress reporting formats and frequency.
* Report overall progress of construction periodically as agreed with the Customer.
* Collaborate with planning engineers/discipline engineers in monitoring the work front status in terms of IFC drawings (Issued for Construction Drawings) and availability of Free Issue Materials.
* Collaborate with planning engineers/discipline engineers in monitoring the progress of works and resource deployment by the contractors. Highlight deficiencies through formal communication to the contractors.
* Prepare slide packs for progress review meetings with contractors and customer. Review minutes of meetings, as required.
* Assist the Resident Construction Manager/Construction Manager to monitor the Worley internal budget for Construction Management.


**About You**
 To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
   

  

* Knowledge of sequence of activities, durations, resource requirement and progress monitoring methods. for various construction activities.
* Graduate Engineers with minimum 15 years of experience with minimum 3 years of experience of working as Lead Engineer/Area Manager/Superintendent in Oil \& Gas Sector and Chemicals.
* Graduate in Engineering/Diploma in Engineering in respective discipline.
* Knowledge of safe methods of execution of construction activities for the respective discipline.
* Proficient in MS Office and Primavera.
* Team Player, interpersonal skills.
* Adaptable, open towards learning and development, person of integrity and possess good communication skills.


**Moving forward together**
 We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
   

  

 And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
   

  

 And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

description:
**Consultant – SAP S/4HANA Logistics Transformation Lead** 




**About the Role** 




 Our client, a leading global FMCG organization, is seeking an experienced SAP S/4HANA Logistics Functional Lead with expertise in Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) and Transportation Management (TM) to join a major S/4HANA transformation program in India. This is a full\-time, 12\+ month on\-site assignment in Mumbai.
 



**Position Summary** 




 As the SAP S/4HANA Logistics Transformation Lead, you will play a pivotal role in guiding the client through a significant logistics transformation. You will leverage your deep functional knowledge of SAP logistics solutions and your experience in large\-scale transformations to ensure a successful transition to S/4HANA.
 



**Location:** 
 On\-Site \- Mumbai
 **Work Mode:** 
 Full Time
 **Duration:** 
 12\+ months
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead As\-Is process mapping for Warehouse Management and Transportation Management across India sites and distribution centers.
* Design the migration path from Centralized Warehouse Management (CWM) to Embedded S/4 EWM.
* Lead the migration from SAP TM to S/4 Advanced Transportation Management.
* Configure core EWM functionalities, including warehouse structure, goods movement, inventory management, and RF/Fiori transactions.
* Design the freight collaboration solution using SAP Logistics Business Network (LBN).
* Drive data quality assessment for logistics master data.
* Coordinate with 3PL partners and logistics service providers for system transitions.



**Requirements and Qualifications** 



* MBA in Supply Chain / Operations from a Tier 1 B\-School (e.g., NITIE, IIT Bombay, SP Jain, or other Tier I institutions).
* Minimum 7–9 years of Logistics Operations experience within an FMCG organization.
* 8–12\+ years of SAP functional experience with deep expertise in WM, EWM (Embedded and/or decentralized), and SAP TM.
* At least 2 full end\-to\-end SAP implementations involving warehouse and/or transportation management workstreams.
* Hands\-on knowledge of EWM configuration: warehouse structure, goods movement, RF transactions, Handling Unit Management, and Physical Inventory.
* Proven experience with SAP Transportation Management, including freight planning, execution, carrier collaboration, and freight settlement.
* Total Experience: 10\+ years.



**Preferred Skills** 



* Experience with CWM to EWM migration (Embedded EWM) is strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with SAP LBN (Logistics Business Network) for freight collaboration.
* Knowledge of SAP Yard Management and dock scheduling.
* Experience with RF/Barcode scanning and Fiori\-based warehouse transactions.
* Understanding of India logistics regulations and compliance requirements within the SAP context.
* Exposure to SAP Activate methodology and agile delivery frameworks.



**Industry:** 
 FMCG, IT Services \& Consulting
 



**Additional Skills:** 
 Logistics, SAP Transportation, Supply Chain Operations, CWM, SAP LBN, S4/HANA, SAP TMS, Embedded EWM, SAP Implementation.

 The Role:
   

  





 The CX Mechanical Engineer is responsible for the planning, execution, and management of commissioning activities for mission\-critical
 **mechanical systems** 
 within hyperscale data center environments. This role ensures that all mechanical and thermal infrastructure is installed, tested, integrated, and handed over in full compliance with project requirements, safety standards, and operational objectives, supporting high\-availability and energy\-efficient operations.
   

  





 The responsibilities for this role include, but are not limited to, the following:
   

  





**Commissioning Management**



* Lead and manage the end\-to\-end commissioning process for mechanical systems, from pre\-functional testing through integrated systems testing (IST) and final handover.
* Ensure commissioning activities are executed in accordance with approved commissioning plans, project schedules and quality standards.
* Coordinate phased and systems\-based commissioning strategies typical of hyperscale delivery model



**Mechanical Systems Testing \& Validation**




 Commission and validate critical mechanical infrastructure, including but not limited to:
   

  




* Chilled water systems (chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers)
* Airside systems (CRAC/PAHUs, AHUs, FWUs)
* Direct\-to\-chip, liquid cooling, or hybrid cooling systems (where applicable)
* HVAC distribution systems (ductwork, piping, valves, dampers)
* Fuel oil and lube oil systems supporting standby generation
* Make\-up water, water treatment, and blowdown systems
* Verify system performance under normal, abnormal, and failure conditions.
* Validate thermal performance, capacity, control response, and efficiency against design intent and client requirements.



**Project Coordination \& Oversight**

	+ IT load and white\-space requirements

**Documentation \& Reporting**




 Develop and manage commissioning documentation, including:
   

  




* Commissioning plans and schedules

* Method statements and risk assessments

**Standards \& Compliance**

	+ ASHRAE (including TC 9\.9\)

	+ IEC, ISO, and local authority requirements
	+ Uptime Institute Tier Standards
	+ TIA\-942 and client\-specific hyperscale standards

**Factory \& Site Acceptance Testing (FAT \& SAT)**

* Support rapid issue resolution in live or partially energized data hall environments.

	+ Pressurized systems
	+ Rotating equipment
	+ Chemical treatment systems
	+ Live data center environments
* Ensure all commissioning activities comply with health and safety regulations, permit\-to\-work systems, confined space requirements and lock\-out/tag\-out (LOTO) procedures.

**Leadership \& Team Development**

* Interface effectively with client operations teams to ensure a smooth transition to steady\-state operations.



**Continuous Improvement**

**Qualifications**

 The ideal candidate will bring deep technical expertise in mechanical commissioning within mission\-critical environments, combined with strong leadership, analytical capability, and a disciplined approach to safety, quality, and compliance.
   

  





**Technical Experience \& Expertise**



* Proven track record in commissioning critical mechanical systems within data centers or other mission\-critical facilities, including:
   

  




	+ Chilled water plants (chillers, primary/secondary pumps, heat exchangers)
	+ Cooling towers and adiabatic systems
	+ CRAH / CRAC units, PAHUs, FWUs
	+ Air distribution systems (ductwork, dampers, VAVs)

	+ Air\-cooled and water\-cooled systems

	+ Containment strategies (hot aisle / cold aisle)
	+ Liquid cooling and hybrid cooling systems (desirable)
* Demonstrated experience validating mechanical system performance under normal, abnormal, and failure scenarios, including loss\-of\-power and failover events.
* Solid knowledge of
 **c** 
 ontrols and automation systems, including:
   

  




	+ BMS

* Proven experience developing Functional Performance Test (FPT) and Integrated Systems Test (IST) scripts and leading on\-site teams to successfully execute tests in live data center environments.
* Working knowledge of commissioning Life Safety and critical interfaces, including:

* Demonstrated ability to review mechanical designs, calculations and specifications from a commissionability, operability, and maintainabilit
 **y**

title: Senior Engineer - Carbon Management (Roads)
description:
**Job Description**
 Your Team
   

  

 Our Roads Net Zero team sits within our wider Roads group and guides clients and colleagues through transport and infrastructure decarbonisation, embedding carbon thinking at the heart of our projects.
   

  

 We deliver carbon assessment and management for transport infrastructure projects; quantifying and assessing carbon to inform strategies and plans, provide carbon management reporting and develop carbon management policies and advice for clients.
   

  

 Since its inception three years ago, our Transport Net Zero team has led industry change—authoring the Department for Transport’s Quantifiable Carbon Reduction guidance; working with Sub‑National Transport Bodies to develop baseline emissions models and support regional decarbonisation strategies; advising local authority clients; and developing carbon management policies for major transport programmes and organisations.
   

  

 As one of the largest suppliers of professional services to various clients, we influence change through client engagement, we invest heavily in R\&D to drive innovation across decarbonisation and climate resilience. Our current frameworks and strategic partnerships spanning National Highways (SDF), National Gird (GGP) work and other frameworks provide a strong platform for impact and growth.
   

  

 Joining the team at this critical time for climate action presents a great opportunity to influence transport policies, shape WSP’s and our client’s decarbonisation approaches, and play a meaningful role on the national pathway to net zero.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 You will be responsible for:
   

  

* Leading and support carbon management inputs for highways and multidisciplinary infrastructure projects across all stages of design.
* Acting as the Carbon Lead on projects, embedding PAS 2080 principles, coordinating low\-carbon solutions with the Client, ECI contractors and suppliers.
* Challenging designs to identify opportunities for carbon reduction and climate resilience.
* Developing and apply carbon assessment methodologies, governance and tools.
* Advising clients on low‑carbon innovation and climate‑resilient opportunities. Identifying and implementing innovative processes and materials for projects.
* Contributing Net Zero inputs into strategic pursuits and proposals, including coordinating and preparing technical and commercial responses.
* Helping build WSP Net Zero process, fostering a collaborative, 'carbon conscious' culture across our Roads and wider T\&I teams.
* Supporting technical development and upskilling of colleagues, including technical leadership and assurance of deliverables
* Contributing to continual improvement and business development within the Roads Net Zero team and National Carbon management activities.
* Reporting achieved carbon reductions back to the client through internal WSP carbon processes.


**Qualifications**
 What we will be looking for you to demonstrate…
   

  

* 
* Experience in carbon assessments and management of transport infrastructure, including familiarity with PAS 2080
* Muiti\-discipline Experience in infrastructure projects in design life cycle including construction
* Experience in technical leadership of projects, with an associated client facing role
* An understanding of the principles of Net Zero in a transport context
* Confidence in working in complex project teams (often cross\-discipline) and ability to upskill staff on best practices in carbon reduction

title: Program Manager
description:
**About the company** 




 TinkerLabs is a problem\-solving and innovation consulancy that applies Design Thinking and Behavioral Science to address complex business and social impact challenges. Clients range from Microsoft, Unilever, Tata Group, Mahindra \& Mahindra, Flipkart, and L\&T to the Gates Foundation, UNFPA, and GIZ. Through consulting engagements, sprints, and workshops, TinkerLabs helps teams generate bold, human\-centered, and simple ideas that drive meaningful change. More information about their work and collaborations is available at www.tinkerlabs.in.
 



  





**About the role** 





 Can you turn ambitious project visions into seamless operational reality? We are hiring for a
 
**Program Manager** 

 who can balance high\-energy facilitation with rigorous operational mastery for a very important and elaborate education programme at TinkerLabs. 
 




  






 We’ve partnered with a large corporate to equip students from design and engineering institutes in India to build products and services for a social impact cause using our methodology. The goal is to help students build strong ideas and connect them to an incubator that brings their ideas to life. 
 




  






 We’re looking for a Program Manager who can run this national\-scale design thinking workshop program \- you’ll be the force that turns a complex programme run smoothly for all stakeholders involved. And when a session needs a facilitator, you are able to stand up and run it yourself.
 




  






 This is not a coordination role. You are expected to shape the plan for the year, defend it with the client, and then deliver it.
 




  





**What will you do** 



* **Master multi\-city operations:** 

 Build and manage the end\-to\-end programme roadmap across multiple colleges nationwide. Track milestones, coordinate schedules, mitigate risks and bottlenecks, manage stakeholder and client communications and ensure seamless delivery
* **Organise the chaos:** 

 Drive key activities and keep track of all moving parts \- institutional partnerships, workshop content, facilitators training, workshop sessions, student submissions, feedback loops and important project tasks without missing a beat
* **Manage client trust:** 

 Lead client\-facing communications with poise and empathy. Set clear expectations, navigate bottlenecks seamlessly and bring grounding and ease to complex timelines
* **Streamline team resourcing:** 

 Balance workloads, forecast talent needs and hire the right people
* **Manage hybrid delivery:** 

 Seamlessly bridge the gap between digital learning platforms and in\-person events across various facilitators\- keeping student engagement consistent and the quality of project high
* **Facilitate with high energy:** 

 Lead engaging, interactive design thinking workshops both in\-person and online



  





**What are we looking for:** 




*Must haves:* 



* **Proven facilitation \& coaching experience:** 

 3\+ years of experience leading workshops, teaching, or facilitating design thinking, human\-centered design (HCD), or experiential learning modules.
* **Genuine facilitation ability:** 

 Has ability to command a room independently for 30\+ participants \- adapt on the fly when an exercise isn't landing, and build quick rapport with college students and faculty alike
* **Strong project management chops:** 

 Track record of managing complex projects/programmes with multiple moving parts, stakeholders, and strict deadlines \- nothing goes missing when working with you
* **Solid client management and communication skills** 

 : Comfortable delivering bad news, collaborating on solutions, sending clear emails and being seen as a trustworthy face for the client.
* **Willingness to travel:** 

 Eagerness to travel to college campuses across India (Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3\) for live workshop modules



  





*Good to haves:* 



* Experience
 
**working with colleges, universities or student communities** 

 in India.
* **Comfort using AI tools** 

 as part of workshop delivery and content preparation.
* A
 
**design or education** 

 background.



  





**Besides the work, what is in it for you:** 



* **Ownership from day one.** 

 You won't just follow a playbook \- you will shape how this massive programme journey unfolds and scales.
* **High\-impact learning.** 

 You will watch students transform from passive learners into confident, empathetic problem\-solvers over the course of a full academic year.
* **High Impact, High Velocity:** 

 We move fast and aim high, offering an environment where you do meaningful, rewarding work while respecting personal boundaries.



  





**How to apply:** 





 To help us get a feel for how you think, we’d love for you to respond to one question:
 





 Tell us about a time when you managed a complex, long\-term project with many moving parts. What were the main challenges and how did you pivot from there?
 




  





*Please feel free to share the response in any format you would do justice to \- write it, draw it, record it.* 




  






 Please share your
 
**response, updated resume and relevant work sample/facilitation videos** 

 to
 
**curios@tinkerlabs.in** 

 with the subject line:
 
**Program Manager\_(Your name)** 




  





*As a human will review all the applications, everyone will receive a reply in due time*

* Act as the central liaison across research and development, marketing, sales, finance, compliance, and supply chain; mentor junior team members, standardize processes and systems, and champion scalable continuous\-improvement solutions.
* Champion Run–Improve–Transform frameworks within the PMO organization.


**Minimum Qualifications**

* Experience leading cross\-functional teams and influencing stakeholders across functions and business priorities.
* Strong communication, collaboration, organization, problem\-solving, change leadership, and execution skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

 Location:
   

  

 Mumbai, IN
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Proposal \& Project Manager** 
 to join our team at
 **Innomotics**
**The Industry\- Leader of Motors and Drives**
 Innomotics is an industry\-leading supplier of motors and large drive systems. With a trusted legacy of more than 150 years of engineering expertise, our products power all of the world’s most essential industries. Today, we are bringing the \#EnergyTransition to life with a portfolio that enables our customers to boost energy efficiency, reduce greenhouse gases, and minimize the carbon footprints of plants.
   

  

 Also, Innomotics India Pvt Ltd is focused on Industrial Projects in the Minerals Portfolio Covering Portfolios of Electrification, Automation and Value\-added Portfolio’s like Digitalization, Cyber Security for Core Process Industries like Cement, Mining Material Handling and Metals.
   

  

 Innomotics India Pvt Ltd business is an Independent Organization of Innomotics GmbH \- Germany. It encompasses the full value chain, from Turnkey Solutions, Systems, Products, Manufacturing and Services. Innomotics India Pvt Ltd in India has aspiration to grow its footprint in Industrial Projects, Sustainability \& Digitalization space. This requires close interaction with Industrial Customers to understand their requirements and generate new ideas via co\-creation with the customers.
   

  

**Our Most Powerful Engine: Our People**
 We are a team of more than 15,000 dedicated experts, doers, and innovators. For us, engineering the future means keeping businesses in motion. As a global player operating with the spirit and speed of a mid\-sized champion, the future holds unlimited opportunities for us. If you share our bold mindset to be best\-in\-class, we want you IN.
   

  

**The Role**
**Proposal Engineering \& Estimation**
* Prepare and evaluate techno\-commercial proposals, including technical specifications, cost estimation, and risk evaluation.
* Interpret client specifications, tender documents, and engineering requirements to develop customized technical solutions.
* Manage complete proposal preparation for Cement, Mining, Material Handling, Metals, and related industrial projects.
* Prepare technical submissions including:
+ Sales calculations
+ Material take\-offs / BOMs
+ Procurement specifications
+ Vendor / sub\-supplier coordination

* Collaborate with proposal teams during pre\-bid and post\-bid stages.
* Standardize proposal formats, estimation tools, and documentation processes.
* Drive implementation and effective usage of standardized sales \& proposal tools such as One\-SAM and Proposal SharePoint.
* Coordinate with internal factories, business units, and divisions for detailed costing and pricing of Electrical \& Automation packages.
* Ensure quality management and maximum document reusability through standardization practices.


**Project Execution \& Management**
* Manage end\-to\-end execution of Electrical \& Automation projects for Cement, Mining, Material Handling, Metals, and allied industries.
* Take ownership of:
+ Profit \& Loss (P\&L)
+ Risk management
+ Contract management
+ Stakeholder management
+ Claims \& change order management

* Ensure project execution within approved scope, schedule, budget, and quality parameters.
* Coordinate with internal teams, customers, logistics partners, installation teams, and vendors to ensure timely delivery and successful project completion.
* Support scheduling, expediting, and monitoring activities throughout the project lifecycle.
* Drive customer satisfaction through quality execution and proactive issue resolution.


**Education \& Experience**
**Education**
* BE / B.Tech in Electrical Engineering


**Experience**
* 5–15 years of hands\-on experience in proposal engineering and/or project management in industries such as:
+ Cement
+ Mining
+ Material Handling
+ Metals
+ Pharma
+ Food \& Beverage
+ Chemical
+ Water \& Wastewater (W\&WW)

* Experience in selection and costing of electrical equipment such as:
+ MV \& LV Switchboards
+ Transformers
+ LV Motors \& Drives
+ Lighting Systems
+ MV/LV Capacitor Banks
+ Earthing Systems
+ HVAC / Air Conditioning
+ Fire Alarm \& Detection Systems
+ Spares \& Tools

* Hands\-on experience in costing systems and electrical package estimation is essential.


**Technical Competencies**
* Strong understanding of electrification, automation, and digitalization solutions for Cement, Mining, Metals, and Material Handling sectors.
* Knowledge of industry trends including:
+ Decarbonization
+ Energy conservation
+ Zero\-emission initiatives
+ KPI monitoring \& calculations

* Exposure to New Energy technologies, CCUS, and BESS will be an added advantage.
* Strong analytical, commercial, and project management capabilities.
* Ability to efficiently execute critical project activities while ensuring team delivery and coordination.
* Understanding of Pharma, F\&B, Chemical, or W\&WW industry processes will be an added advantage.


**Soft Skills**
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong problem\-solving mindset with customer\-centric approach.
* Ability to simplify and communicate technical concepts in business\-friendly language.
* Strong organizational, prioritization, and time management skills.
* Proactive, detail\-oriented, self\-driven, and collaborative team player.


**Ready to power the future with us? Join Innomotics and start making a difference now. \#TeamInnomotics \#JoinReliableMotion**
 Innomotics is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status.

title: Program Manager
description:
**Position:** 
 Program Manager
 



**Location:** 
 Mumbai
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



  





**About** 
**Axestrack** 




 Axestrack is a leading provider of Digital Logistics Solutions for Heavy Commercial Vehicles and the only Southeast Asian company recognized in Gartner's Market Guide for Fleet Management. We enable enterprises to digitize and optimize their logistics operations through innovative IoT, automation, and intelligent mobility solutions.
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 The Program Manager will be responsible for the end\-to\-end planning and execution \& implementation of various products like CPL, Swift, ePOD, and so on, ensuring timely delivery, effective stakeholder management, and seamless implementation. The role requires close collaboration with customers, cross\-functional internal teams, and implementation partners to ensure successful deployment, user adoption, and project completion.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead and manage the large programs \& projects from project initiation through implementation, go\-live, and handover.
* Collaborate with customer stakeholders, including IT, Operations, Logistics, Security, Weighbridge, SAP, and Plant teams, to ensure smooth project execution.
* Develop and maintain project plans, implementation schedules, meeting minutes (MoMs), action trackers, and progress reports.
* Govern site readiness activities, including hardware deployment, networking, power, cabling, civil infrastructure, and system integration.
* Coordinate and Liaise with internal Product, Software, Hardware, Networking, Implementation, and Support teams to ensure timely project delivery.
* Monitor project milestones, risks, dependencies, and escalations, and drive timely resolution of project issues.
* Plan and facilitate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), end\-user training, SOP documentation, and go\-live readiness.
* Ensure timely completion of project deliverables, customer acceptance, and formal project sign\-offs.
* Maintain regular communication with customer stakeholders and internal leadership by providing accurate project updates and status reports.
* Ensure adherence to project governance standards, documentation, and implementation best practices.



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline).
* 8\-14 years of experience in Program Management, Project Management, Industrial Automation, Plant Logistics, IoT implementations, or enterprise technology deployment projects.
* Demonstrated experience managing implementation projects within manufacturing, steel, cement, mining, power, ports, or logistics environments.
* Strong understanding of industrial operations, hardware deployment, software implementation, and system integration.
* Familiarity with ERP/SAP integration and industrial automation systems is preferred.
* Excellent project planning, stakeholder management, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively to customer locations across India as required.



  





**Preferred Skills** 



* Strong project and program management skills.
* Knowledge of industrial automation and IoT\-based solutions.
* Experience with hardware and software integration.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to identify, manage, and resolve project risks and escalations.
* Strong cross\-functional coordination and team collaboration abilities.

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Financial Control India is the global delivery footprint of the bank’s Global Financial Control function within the Chief Financial Officer group and is responsible for multiple functions including U.S. and Regional Legal Entity Controllership, Regulatory Reporting, Balance Sheet Reconciliations, Tax Accounting \& Compliance, Treasury, Operational Risk \& Controls Oversight, Finance Change, Production Services and Data Management.
   

  

 In short, our focus is to get the numbers right and to work in support of the company’s goals, most importantly responsible growth.
   

  

**Job Description\***
* We are looking for a highly driven and technically strong professional to lead the design, development, and management of AI\-powered agents and low\-code automation solutions. This role will be responsible for leveraging AI Studio, orchestration frameworks, and low\-code platforms to drive process transformation, enhance operational efficiency, and scale automation across business functions.
* You will work closely with operations, technology, and business stakeholders to deliver intelligent, scalable, and governed automation solutions.


**Responsibilities\***
* Lead the end\-to\-end design and delivery of intelligent agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio, including workflow orchestration, system integrations, and scalable automation use cases.
* Design and manage end\-to\-end automation workflows, ensuring scalability, stability, and measurable business impact.
* Build and manage end\-to\-end orchestration pipelines across systems
* Establish standards for AI ethics, data privacy, and security. Ensure all automation solutions comply with enterprise policies. Implement monitoring, audit trails, and performance tracking
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to translate functional requirements into AI\-driven agent solutions, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, governance, and control standards.
* Stay updated with evolving AI and automation toolsets, enabling scalable and practical AI\-powered workflows
* Lead development of solutions on low\-code/no\-code platforms (e.g., Alteryx, Tableau, automation tools, workflow engines)

 We are looking for an experienced MEP Engineer with 5–10 years of relevant experience in the interior fit\-out and construction industry to manage and execute MEP works at project sites. The candidate will be responsible for coordinating and supervising electrical, HVAC, plumbing, fire\-fighting, and other MEP services while ensuring quality, timelines, safety, and compliance with approved drawings and specifications.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Plan, coordinate, and supervise MEP works for interior fit\-out projects from execution through handover.
* Review and interpret MEP drawings, shop drawings, layouts, specifications, and BOQs.
* Coordinate with architects, interior designers, consultants, contractors, vendors, and project teams.

 o Electrical systems, lighting, power, DBs, panels, and cable management.
 



 o HVAC systems, ducting, piping, FCUs/AHUs, and ventilation.
 



 o Plumbing and drainage systems.
 



 o Fire\-fighting and fire\-alarm systems.
 



 o ELV systems such as CCTV, access control, data/networking, and other low\-voltage services, as applicable.

* Coordinate testing, commissioning, snagging, rectification, and final handover of MEP systems.
* Support quantity verification, material approvals, BOQ reconciliation, and measurement of contractor works.
* Ensure compliance with HSE requirements and site safety procedures.
* Attend site meetings and provide technical inputs and updates to the Project Manager.
* Resolve site\-level technical issues in coordination with consultants and design teams.
* Ensure proper documentation, as\-built drawings, O\&M manuals, test reports, and handover documentation.

* Strong knowledge of MEP services and their coordination with interior works.
* Good understanding of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire\-fighting, and ELV systems.
* Ability to read and interpret MEP/shop drawings and coordinate drawings.
* Experience in site execution, subcontractor management, quality control, and project coordination.
* Knowledge of relevant Indian standards, codes, and statutory requirements.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD; knowledge of MS Excel/MS Office is required.
* Knowledge of Revit/BIM/Navisworks will be an advantage.
* Strong communication, coordination, problem\-solving, and site\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple activities and work effectively under project Deadlines.



**Preferred Experience** 




 Candidates who have worked on commercial office fit\-outs, retail outlets, hotels,
 



 restaurants, corporate interiors, or premium residential projects will be Preferred.
 



**Key Performance Areas** 



* Timely completion of MEP works
* Installation quality and adherence to approved drawings
* Coordination and clash\-free execution
* Effective subcontractor/vendor management
* Testing, commissioning, and snag closure
* Compliance with safety and statutory requirements
* Accurate project documentation and handover

**Role description:**

 The PMO role will mainly support programs within the COO Office but will mainly focus on supporting the Global Quality functions and the Standardization and Automation program.

The Global Program Manager will manage stakeholders, understand their needs and is able to influence outcomes.
   

  

**Role accountabilities:**
  Leading and supporting on delivery of strategic initiatives linked to Global Strategy.
   

  

  Developing structure and plans around key areas of focus and areas of ambiguity, to define and deliver an end outcome
   

  

  Working with stakeholders and Senior Leaders to define and align initiatives and objectives, influence outcomes, drive action and communicate plans.
   

  

  Develop and run the Program Management Office, engage with project owners on progress and objectives, maintain schedules and benefit trackers, create dashboards and reports. Prepare and lead team and network meetings with stakeholders. Follow up on deliverables and actions.
   

  

**Qualifications \& Experience:**
 You are a multitasker with excellent verbal and written communication skills, comfortable with ambiguity, fast paced environments and the complex nature of working at leadership level. You are resilient and good at working collaboratively with all styles of leaders.
   

  

 In addition, you have the following requirements and competencies:
   

  

 2\-3 years of experience in Program Management, PMO, Project Coordination, Business Transformation, Operational Excellence, or related roles.
   

  

 Experience supporting cross\-functional projects and contributing to transformation or process improvement initiatives.
   

  

 Ability to build effective working relationships with stakeholders across different teams and functions.
   

  

 Comfortable working in a dynamic environment and adapting to changing business priorities.
   

  

 Exposure to project governance, reporting, tracking, and performance management processes.
   

  

 Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and identify improvement opportunities.
   

  

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

 Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
   

  

 Eagerness to learn, develop project management skills, and contribute to business improvement initiatives.
   

  

 Why Arcadis?
   

  

 We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills\-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.
   

  

 You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.

**Focus Personal Care, Skincare, \& Color Cosmetics**
**Travel Approximately:** 
 15\-20 %
   

  

 Work
   

  

 Environment: Fast\-paced, Flexible, Startup Culture
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Manager, Packaging Development will be the key technical leader driving all
   

  

 packaging initiatives for new product launches across Personal Care and Color
   

  

 Cosmetics.
   

  

 This role requires an innovator with deep technical knowledge in rigid,
   

  

 semi\-rigid, paperboard and laminate packaging.
   

  

 The candidate must possess exceptional project management and stakeholder management skills, a hands\-on approach to mould development, and a proven ability to perform value
   

  

 engineering while maintaining strong quality standards.
   

  

 Crucially, the manager must have an in\-depth understanding of the cost breakdown for key formats, including glass bottles, PET bottles, Cap/Closures, Labels, Paperboard, and corrugated
   

  

 shippers, to drive maximum profitability and efficiency.
   

  

 This position requires flexibility, strong conflict resolution skills, and the ability to thrive in a high\-growth, startup culture.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
**I. New Product Launch \& Innovation Leadership**
**Drive NPD Process:** 
 Lead the full packaging lifecycle from concept definition to commercialization for a high volume of new product launches in the personal care and color cosmetics segments.
   

  

**Innovation \& Ideation:** 
 Act as a packaging innovator, continuously scouting
   

  

 new materials, formats, and design technologies to enhance consumer experience, improve sustainability, and reduce costs.
   

  

**Mould Development Expertise:** 
 Directly manage and execute the technical development and validation of new tooling and moulds for custom primary packaging components (e.g., bottles, jars, closures).
   

  

**II. Project Management \& Stakeholder Management**
**End\-to\-End Project Ownership:** 
 Utilize exceptional project management skills to define scopes, manage timelines, control budgets, and ensure on\- time delivery of all packaging projects.
   

  

**Stakeholder Alignment:** 
 Serve as the primary liaison, demonstrating strong stakeholder management and communication skills to align cross\- functional teams (Marketing, Operations, R\&D, Procurement).
   

  

**Conflict Resolution:** 
 Exhibit proficiency in critical thinking and managing conflict situations effectively to resolve technical and project\-related roadblocks quickly and maintain positive team dynamics.
   

  

**III. Technical Expertise \& Quality Assurance Costing \& Value Engineering:** 
 Possess deep expertise in the costing of packaging material, including bottles, caps, pumps, labels, paperboard cartons, and glass bottles. Conduct robust cost analysis and value
   

  

 engineering activities.
   

  

**IV. Material Specialization:** 
 Provide in\-depth technical knowledge and troubleshoot issues related to the functional performance of laminates (e.g., tubes) and rigid packaging components.
   

  

**Decoration Mastery:** 
 Maintain a good understanding of decoration techniques (e.g., screen printing, hot stamping, labeling, offset printing) and ensure technical feasibility and quality execution on all packaging.
   

  

**Quality Resolution:** 
 Lead and execute projects focused on resolving complex quality issues related to packaging components or filling line performance, driving effective and lasting resolution.
   

  

**V. Sustainability and Regulatory Leadership**
**Plastic \& Rigid Packaging:** 
 Drive the adoption of Post\-Consumer Recycled (PCR) content in bottles, jars, and closures, setting targets and validating
   

  

 material performance, color, and compatibility.
   

  

**Paperboard Packaging:** 
 Lead initiatives to optimize carton design for material reduction, ensuring all paperboard is sourced from certified sustainable forests (e.g., FSC\-certified) and maximizing the use of recycled fiber.
   

  

**Flexible Packaging (Laminates):** 
 Focus on transitioning complex multi\- material flexible packaging (e.g., sachets, tubes) to mono\-material structures that are designed for recyclability without compromising product preservation.
   

  

**Regulatory Compliance:** 
 Ensure all packaging materials and claims comply with local and international environmental regulations, recycling mandates, and labeling standards.
   

  

**Reporting:**

title: Human Resources Consultant
description:
We're looking for an HR / OD Consultant. But not the "write a policy manual" kind.
 



 This is a 4\-month project assignment. It is not a permanent position.
 



  





 At SHANBHAGS, we are in the middle of an important internal transformation.
 



 The vision is clear. The intent is clear. Now comes the harder part: making it real.
 



 Because organisations do not change because a presentation says they should. They change when intent translates into clear behaviours, operating disciplines, systems and SOPs that people can actually follow — and managers can actually manage.
 



  





 We are looking for a senior HR / Organisation Development Consultant who has done this before — at scale. Someone who can understand the organisation, work closely with leadership and employees, and help build the frameworks and SOPs that make the transformation live every day.
 



 Not just define what should happen. Design it. Implement it. Make it stick.
 



  





 You should bring:
 


* 10–15\+ years of serious HR / OD experience
* Proven experience designing AND successfully implementing organisation\-wide SOPs, operating frameworks and people/culture systems
* Experience working with large and complex organisations
* Ability to translate organisational intent into specific, practical, measurable and repeatable behaviours and processes
* Strong experience across performance management, capability building, accountability, leadership, cross\-functional working, employee development and culture implementation
* The ability to work with leadership while understanding what actually happens on the ground
* A healthy intolerance for beautifully written documents that collapse the minute real life begins



 One thing matters enormously: You must have implemented what you designed.
 



  





 This is not recruitment. Not an HR audit. Not policy polishing. And certainly not another employee handbook nobody reads. It is about helping us build the operating DNA for the next phase of Shanbhag Engineering Company.
 



  





 We also welcome former CHROs, HR Heads and senior OD leaders who may have stepped away from full\-time corporate life but still enjoy solving difficult organisational problems. Perhaps you no longer want the title or a 9\-to\-9 — but still miss rolling up your sleeves once in a while. For someone like that, this could be a very satisfying four months — a chance to solve a real organisational problem and build something that lasts well beyond the assignment.
 



  





 Interested? Write directly to hr@shanbhags.com with:
 


* A brief profile and relevant work experience
* One organisation\-wide system / transformation you designed and successfully implemented
* Your expected professional fee for the 4\-month assignment



  





 Learn more about us at https://shanbhags.com

*Founder's Office \| Mumbai (in\-office)*

 Pepper is building an Agentic AI SEO Platform \- combining strategy, content, technology, and AI to drive measurable organic growth for customers.

 We're hiring a Manager to make the business run the way it's designed to run \- reporting to the Director, Strategy \& Operations, in a small, senior Founder's Office team.  The
 **Citi Advantage Cobrand Acquisitions Risk \& Controls Lead**

This pivotal role drives the "Operating in Control" (OIC) agenda for the Cobrand portfolio, providing comprehensive oversight of issues and escalations, coordinating internal and external exams, and managing the end\-to\-end lifecycle of the Process, Risk, Control, and Monitoring (PRCM) framework—from initial design to annual assessments and ongoing monitoring. Additionally, the Lead owns the end\-to\-end authorship and maintenance of the Cobrand Desktop Manual, a critical cornerstone of OIC documentation.
   

  

 Ultimately, this individual ensures that Cobrand operates in a highly controlled environment across both existing and emerging channels and products. Proactive oversight is critical; without it, channels risk falling short of management expectations across the Cobrand partner portfolios. With aggressive partner commitments and channel growth plans slated for 2026 and beyond, this role serves as the epicenter of our control framework. Success requires cultivating deep, collaborative partnerships with key internal stakeholders and subject matter experts, including In\-Business Control, Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Product/Marketing owners.  As a Manager within the Actuarial AXIS modelling team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
